item.title: Iceblade of Narin: The Icebind: Hotfix 44.1.1
item.description:
The Icebind Changes & Fixes:

  • The Icebind's voting timer no longer starts immediately once all players have selected a Cryobell. Now, the Host will have the option to start the timer, so players can discuss and strategize with the Cryobells available to them.
    • Additionally, the timer will begin automatically if 3 players have voted on a Cryobell.
  • Removed the ability to throw the Cryo Core as it was causing cases of function loss.
  • Tweaked the VFX of the damaging zone around the Entropy Orb.
  • Fixed Orokin Vaults being able to spawn in The Icebind missions, which sometimes would have Side Objectives spawning inside them.
  • Fixed losing a squad member resulting in the mission being progression stopped if a Side Objective was started before they left.
  • Fixed enemy spawning issues when attempting to complete a Side Objective after the mission completion requirements have been met, notably in Excavation missions.
  • Fixed the Indomitable Ice side objective's collision remaining after it disappears.
    • Also fixed cases of players getting stuck in the side objective when it spawns in.
  • Fixed various edge cases of invulnerability states negating Cryo Core health damage.
  • Fixed only Arson Eximus being able to spawn if the Inferno Mission Bind was active.
    • Now other Eximus units can spawn, just at a lower rate.
  • Fixed being able to equip multiple of the same Warframe in The Icebind by changing loadouts during the mission countdown.
  • Fixed certain voice lines in the Glacial Laboratory being incorrectly attributed to Cephalon Melica, instead of another figure. 
    • Also fixed the data pads using the wrong name for the context action.
  • Fixed squadmates being able to interact with Log Data Pads in the Glacial Laboratory before they have unlocked them.
  • Fixed being able to fall through the map into the Glacial Laboratory (treasure room) by using /unstuck.
  • Fixed cases of item priority sorting not applying to rewards from The Icebind in the End of Mission screen.
  • Fixed letting a random Cryobell be selected in the vote (ie. no one voted) resulting in squadmates seeing different Cryobells selected.
  • Fixed the red border remaining around the Cryobell key if a player equipped and then unequipped a duplicate Warframe in the mission start menu.

Riven Splicing Changes & Fixes:

  • Players can now hover over Rivens with no compatible traits in the Riven Splicing screen to see their traits.
  • Fixed Weak Point Damage Spliced Traits not applying the bonus damage.
  • Fixed Rivens with a Spliced Trait incorrectly doubling the Kuva cost when Cycled.
  • Fixed the selected Riven not remaining selected when entering the Riven Splicing menu.
  • Fixed cases of Riven Mods with spliced traits being cut off when swapping between the Splicing and Fusion menus.

Other Fixes:

  • Fixed being able to take 6 player squads into non-Icebind missions.
  • Fixed Security Bypass pathing not always picking the closest Terminal.
  • Fixed Banshee becoming permanently invulnerable due to an interaction with Gaseous Quake.
  • Fixed The Icebind and Archimedea modifiers only applying to the Primary Son when using Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed reviving as Sirius & Orion resulting in them falling through the map.
  • Fixed the skin on the Amir Gemini Skin appearing overly green.
  • Fixes towards the Cryobell Sumdali being blindingly bright in the Drifter Camp.
  • Fixed a crash related to the No Pets modifier in Archimedea missions.
  • Fixed being unable to skip The Hex kissing cutscenes.

Script Error Fixes:
Script errors mean that something went wrong when the game client was executing a script, which can have various outcomes. Usually it means the related content didn’t function properly under specific circumstances — often we don’t actually know what the error outcome was, so we list it as a Script Error fix to indicate it was addressing an unintended behaviour.

  • Fixed a script error related to revival Tombstones in The Icebind.
  • Fixed various script errors related to The Icebind mission start screen (including countdowns, and more).
  • Fixed a script error when opening a chest in The Icebind.
  • Fixed a script error related to Entropic Crystals caused by the Entropic Overload Bind.
  • Fixed a script error related to the Entropy Orb side objective in The Icebind.
  • Fixed a script error related to the Parasitic Light tactical bind in The Icebind.
  • Fixed a script error related to the Signal Chain side objective in The Icebind.
  • Fixed a script error related to a Flare KIM conversation in the POM-2.
  • Fixed a script error if Protea died while ragdolling during Temporal Anchor if an Entropic Overload bind was active in The Icebind.
  • Fixed a script error related to Summulysts.
  • Fixed a script error related to Cascadia Empowered.
  • Fixed a script error caused by an interaction between Kullervo's Collective Curse and certain Duviri Decrees.
  • Fixed a script error when hovering over Abilities and cycling through tabs quickly.

For a list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1523875-known-issues-iceblade-of-narin/

item.title: Iceblade of Narin: Hotfix 44.0.3
item.description:
Narin Changes & Fixes:

  • Increased the duration of Cold Ammo Packs dropped by Narin from 10s to 15s.
  • Nurinarim Mark Changes & Fixes:
    • Narin can now fire projectiles during Nurinarim at targets regardless of whether they are Marked or not.
      • Attacks on Marked targets cost no Ice and do increased damage.
    • Increased Nurinarim's duration from 15s to 20s.
    • Narin can now use Transference during Nurinarim.
    • Parkour Velocity and Dodge stats now apply to Narin during Nurinarim.
    • Mark Changes:
      • The initial Mark is now created immediately upon Nurinarim activation instead of having a delay.
      • Reduced the time between Marks being generated.
      • Increased the likelihood that targets closer to where you are currently aiming will be Marked during Nurinarim.
      • Marks are now placed based on the target’s height to improve readability.
      • Added a pulse VFX to Narin’s reticle when successfully hitting a Marked target during Nurinarim.
    • Fixed Nurinarim’s projectiles not targeting targets beyond 50m even if the target was already Marked.
    • Fixed Nurinarim not dealing damage to The Severed Warden's arms.
    • Fixed Nurinarim being able to target neutral units, like Conservation targets.
  • Fixed Client Narins not gaining Ice when damaging enemies with Hakchum.


Changes:

  • Reduced the Blitz Eximus' shockwave attack's base damage from 250 to 100.
    • This attack was a common mission killer at higher levels if it targeted an objective like a Defense Target or Mobile Defense Terminal. Now their attacks should be less likely to one-shot a defensible objective.
  • The Iceblade of Narin blessing's VFX now only appears when players are in mission with a Melee weapon equipped.
  • Removed the ability for Entropic Eximus to spawn as Nullifier units.
  • Reverted the Research Point changes introduced to Archimedea missions with the Iceblade of Narin.
    • Using a Warframe that matches those in the Individual Parameters rewards 1 Research Point once more.
    • Restored the Research Point reward track to provide the Legendary Reward at 34 Research Points, and Vosfor or Pix Chips at 37 Research Points. 
    • This change had a mixed reception with players, and we ultimately decided to revert it so players didn’t feel “forced” to match their Warframe due to the increased Research Points they offered.
    • Note: the other changes to Archimedea missions introduced with Iceblade of Narin remain untouched. 
  • Players affected by the No Pets Allowed Personal Modifier in Archimedea missions now have an increased innate Vacuum range.
  • The "Hide Owned" toggle now hides Blueprints of crafted cosmetics in the Nightwave Cred Offerings since players can only own one copy of a cosmetic.
  • Removed muffled SFX when players are dead and spectating squadmates.
  • Restored Entropic Eximus bubble hit SFX as it no longer triggers squad-wide.
  • Reduced Grendel's Nourish SFX distance for squadmates, and slightly reduced its volume.
  • Rescue Target downed transmissions are no longer affected by the Mission Tutorial Transmissions toggle.

Top Fixes:

  • Fixes towards players losing function when swapping between Sirius & Orion.
    • There were quite a few different cases causing this, and we hope to have addressed as many as we could find. We’ll be keeping an eye out for reports if this issue persists after this hotfix!
  • Fixed Ash Teleporting to Join the Fray resulting in future casts of Teleport being broken.
  • Fixed being unable to access Operator or Focus menus on Yuvan Peak.
  • Fixed the Energy tint channel not applying to the Opula Armor Set.
  • Fixed Hildryn's Balefire being able to bypass Entropic Eximus bubbles.
  • Fixed Valkyr's Rage VFX flashing on-screen every time a player Transferences back to Valkyr.
  • Fixed various offset issues on Styanax Prime.
  • Fixed Sevagoth's Shadow missing in the Arsenal when attempting to upgrade or customize him.

Fixes:

  • Fixed Temple's Exalted Solo breaking their ability to Wall Jump/Latch.
  • Fixed the Jade Aureolt Helmet not opening when toggling on Glory in the Arsenal.
  • Fixed the metallic elements on the Harrow Profitas Skin no longer appearing metallic.
  • Fixed overlapping Arcane and Exilus Slots when linking a Mod Config for an Exalted Primary or Secondary weapon.
  • Fixed various cases of Entropic Kuva pickup SFX not playing.
  • Fixed additional edge cases of players being able to Emote (and therefore fall out of the map) when attempting to pull Narin's Iceblade on Yuvan Peak.
  • Fixed Cephalon Melica playing a transmission about Narin's Iceblade now that players can successfully pull it from the ice.
  • Fixed suggested Polarity marker bleeding across Mod categories in the Railjack Plexus.
  • Fixed the Pause Menu dissolving if open while going through a Sanctuary Onslaught portal.
  • Fixed Mods popping into view if they are partially offscreen while scrolling through Mods in the Mod Bench.
  • Fixed performance issues caused by chatlinking a Riven if a chat filter is applied.
  • Fixed a filepath in the Headcracker Honoria description.

Script Errors:
Script errors mean that something went wrong when the game client was executing a script, which can have various outcomes. Usually it means the related content didn’t function properly under specific circumstances!

  • Fixed a script error in The Descendia.
  • Fixed a script error related to Narin's Neote.
  • Fixed a rare script error related to Duviri Decree generation.
  • Fixed a script error related to Koumei's Omamori.
  • Fixed a script error related to Oraxia's Scuttlers.
  • Fixed a script error related to Cephalon Simaris' ability restrictions in Sanctuary Onslaught.
  • Fixes towards clipping issues with Narin's skirt during animations.
  • Fixed a script error related to Sirius' Jade Stars.
  • Fixed a script error related to Cyte-09's Resupply.

For a list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1523875-known-issues-iceblade-of-narin/

item.title: Iceblade of Narin: Hotfix 44.0.2
item.description:
Additions:

  • Citrine Prime’s Adornments can now be unequipped as a new Auxiliary Attachment.
    • With Iceblade of Narin’s release, these pieces would be removed if Citrine Prime equipped a TennoGen or the Aphrodita helmet. We fixed that bug, but we have made their functionality permanent with this new Auxiliary!
  • Added various Day of the Dead cosmetics from the Nightwave: Dreams of the Dead series to the Nightwave Offerings. These are permanent additions that will rotate in as the store refreshes each week!
    • Note: We will also be adding these items to Daughter’s Naberus wares when that event launches in October.
    • Okina Day of the Dead Skin
    • Atomos Day of the Dead Skin
    • Taxon Day of the Dead Skin
    • Skaut Day of the Dead Skin
    • Kayota Day of the Dead Mask
    • Monarcierro Day of the Dead Syandana
    • Calaverita Sentinel Mask
    • Calaverita Sentinel Tail
    • Calaverita Sentinel Wing
    • Nora Night Catrina Glyph

Changes:

  • Shotgun Rivens can now roll Zoom stats in anticipation of the Riven Splicer system (which we hope to release soon).
    • The Zoom stat is required to create specific Spliced Traits, as outlined in our Riven Splicer Dev Workshop. 
  • Adjusted the Deimos Genetrix's SFX to be quieter and to play at a shorter distance.

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed the Entropic Eximus' damage reduction being applied twice.
  • Fixed Entropic Eximus spawning in The Descendia missions.
    • These specific Eximus only spawn in the Zariman for narrative reasons!
    • Known Issue: Entropic Eximus can spawn in Sanctuary Onslaught. 
  • Fixed allied barriers (like Gara's Mass Vitrify) blocking line of sight checks for Narin's Neote.
  • Fixed the Galvanized Scope's description incorrectly stating "On Weak Point Hit" (instead of the intended "On Weak Point Kill").
  • More fixes towards golden decorations being too yellow.
    • With our metal shader improvements in Iceblade of Narin we fixed the issue of "gray cast" on metals, which also applied to decorations and caused them to appear as a very saturated yellow instead of the familiar gold tone. The above fixes aim to return the gold closer to what it was before, while also taking advantage of the wider range of colors we now have at our disposal.
  • Fixed Rivens with duplicate traits that were the result of a Riven Cycling bug immediately following Iceblade of Narin’s release.
    • Removed negatives from Rivens that had both a positive and negative value of the same trait. (ex: +80% Reload Speed and -17% Reload Speed)
    • Any remaining Rivens with numerous negative traits have had the extra negative traits removed.
    • Kuva Refund Script: Players who cycled Rivens and were presented with a broken option will have their Kuva refunded.
      • Update 3:30pm ET - the script is complete, affected players should see their Kuva refunded!
  • Fixed Narin and Uriel’s passives granting permanent elemental buffs if applied without a weapon equipped.

Fixes:

  • Fixed Zymos' unique trait not triggering consistently.
    • Known Issue: The seeking spore projectiles from the Zymos’ unique trait are invisible. 
  • Fixed the Dual Toxocyst Incarnon's Neurotoxin evolution not adding Toxin damage.
  • Fixed Entropic Eximus killed by Mirage's Hall of Mirrors not dropping Entropic Kuva.
    • This also fixes Eximus not dropping Riven Slivers if killed by Mirage's clones.
  • Fixed the Archimedea bonus for Ability Strength applying Ability Duration instead.
  • Fixed various offsets for the Opula Shoulder Armor.
  • Fixed offsets for the Spinele Prime Accessories on the Drifter to match the Operator.
  • Fixed cases of the Kerulyst Sentinel Skin's attachments becoming detached when certain Sentinels perform attacks.
  • Fixed Voruna’s growling SFX remaining after exiting Ulfrun’s Descent, causing it to stack loudly after multiple casts. 
  • Fixed placeholder text in the Sharpshooter Mod description.
  • Fixed an issue when attempting to use a Zipline.
  • Fixed a map hole in the mountain pass in The War Within quest.
  • Fixed chat being hidden when viewing a Profile.
  • Fixed being able to perform an Emote while pulling out Narin's Iceblade, causing players to fall through the map.
  • Fixed a rare crash when starting Zariman Ten Zero missions from the Chrysalith, and a squadmate attempts to enter the Dormizone elevator.
  • Fixed a rare in-game chat crash after toggling the Cross Platform Play setting.

Performance Fixes:

  • Fixed performance issues caused by the Latron's Incarnon Form projectiles if modded for a high fire rate while using Mirage's Hall of Mirrors.
  • Fixed performance issues caused by Banshee's Gaseous Quake.
  • Fixed performance issues caused by Aksondol.

Script Errors Fixes:
Script errors mean that something went wrong when the game client was executing a script, which can have various outcomes. Usually it means the related content didn’t function properly under specific circumstances!

  • Fixed script errors related to Sirius & Orion's Passive.
  • Fixed a script error related to Mining Lasers.
  • Fixed a script error related to Narin's Neote. 
  • Fixed a script error related to Zenurik's Tauron Strike ability.
  • Fixed a script error related to Citrine's Crystalize.
  • Fixed a script error related to Banshee's Sound Quake.
  • Fixed a script error when chatlinking Mods.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1523875-known-issues-iceblade-of-narin/

item.title: Iceblade of Narin: Hotfix 44.0.1
item.description:
Hi Tenno!

It’s been just over 24 hours since Iceblade of Narin launched, and we firstly want to thank you all for jumping into the update, and sharing your thoughts and fast bug reports with us! 

Seeing you come together as a community and piece together the clues to fulfill the prophecy was really special, and we recognize that we have many learnings from it.  

The Iceblade of Narin update is a continuation of our attempts to try new things with Warframe. Not every Warframe will come with a Quest, therefore we must adapt. It’s imperative that we experiment and get your feedback to educate us as we move forward to Tau and beyond. Warframe is a game built with our Community, and that Community ebbs and flows with differing desires and playstyles. We will continue to try new things in our updates, and we thank you again for helping us to shape this world together. 

You will see in this Hotfix that we are bringing deeper clarification to some of the hot topic changes, alongside changes/fixes to address critical feedback <3 

Some Clarifications from Iceblade of Narin Patch Notes:

Archimedea Personal Modifier Groups
This is a new system in Personal Modifier generation for Temporal and Deep Archimedea that was missed in our original patch notes. There are some weeks that can almost feel excessively punishing depending on which Personal Modifiers you receive — to avoid cases of this happening in the future, Personal Modifiers have been separated into four different Groups. 

Each week on reset, one Modifier from each Group will be randomly selected to help avoid overly difficult combinations. Due to Archimedea Modifiers being selected at the beginning of the week and Iceblade of Narin launching on a Wednesday, this is not currently live. That said, you will see the first installment of this updated system  apply to Personal Modifiers after this upcoming weekly reset: September 28, 2026 at Midnight UTC.

Group One:

  • Ability Overload
  • Dropped Guard
  • Dull Blades
  • Framecurse Syndrome
  • Hypersensitive
  • Knifestep Syndrome
  • Low Yield
  • Secondary Wounds
  • Undersupplied

Group Two: 

  • Abbreviated Abilities
  • Channeled Greed
  • Constricted
  • Energy Exhaustion
  • Powerless
  • Shortened Reach

Group Three:

  • Ammo Deficit
  • Gear Embargo
  • No Pets Allowed
  • Transference Distortion

Group Four:

  • Anemic Shields
  • Fractured Armor
  • Infected Wounds
  • Lethargic Shields
  • Permanent Injury
  • Untreatable

If you have additional feedback about our Archimedea changes, please use the dedicated QOL Additions Feedback subforum. 

Entropic Eximus Clarifications
With the introduction of our new Entropic Eximus units, we kept our initial patch note description intentionally vague to encourage players to discover the best ways to take them down. An unintended result was player confusion about some of the mechanics and we apologize for any frustration this decision caused. 

To help you in your hunt for Entropic Eximus (and their Entropic Kuva), we’re offering more information on how these enemies work so you can understand a) how to kill them and b) what behaviours are intended. We are also adding this information to the original Update Notes.

Entropic Eximus have a resistance to non-melee attacks, forcing you to get in close and use your melee weapon. Breaking the bubble will enable abilities to target the Eximus, but will not change the Eximus’s damage resistance.

  • Damage from non-melee sources is reduced by 90%.
    • For Operators, damage is instead reduced by 75%.
  • Companions do not target Entropic Eximus

Entropic Eximus bubbles prevent projectiles from entering, and prevent Warframe abilities from dealing damage to the Entropic Eximus, from both inside and outside the bubble! The bubble can be broken two ways:

  • Dealing melee damage with the Iceblade of Narin buff from Neote on Yuvan Peak will break the bubble if either the bubble or the Entropic Eximus is struck.
  • Tauron strikes will break the bubble upon contact.

We hope this clears up confusion around how to best approach taking on Entropic Eximus. If you’re hunting them down, don’t forget to check Void Angels for a few guaranteed spawns! To provide us feedback on Entropic Eximus, please head over to our Update 44 Zariman Updates Feedback Forum.

Necramech Slot Refund Script:
As mentioned in the Iceblade of Narin update notes, we have removed the need for Necramech Slots. The script refunding purchases Necramech Slots has completed, and players should see any Platinum spent on these slots returned to them via inbox message!

Changes:

  • Doubled the weighting of Narin's Blueprint in Zariman Exterminate and Mobile Defense missions following community feedback.
    • Exterminate and Mobile Defense missions are usually not the source of Warframe Blueprints, so we have increased the drop rate to be more forgiving.
  • Narin can now walk on water during Nurinarim!
  • Updated Hydroid and Hydroid Prime’s stats to properly swap Health and Shield values in order to help him make the most out of the armor gained from Plunder.
    • Iceblade of Narin accidentally swapped his Armor and Shield values, instead of the Health and Shield values as suggested by the community.  
    • Hydroid Prime:
      • Health: 650
      • Shields: 370
      • Armor: 290
    • Hydroid:
      • Health: 365
      • Shields: 270
      • Armor: 240
  • Citrine Prime's shoulder details now dissolve when aiming down sights.
  • Removed the hit SFX on Entropic Eximus shields as it was being played squad-wide. This is a temporary change until we can fix the issue.

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed an elevator exploit resulting in ever-increasing Eximus spawn counts in Zariman Ten Zero missions.
    • UPDATE - September 25 at 3pm ET: Players who earned extreme amounts of Entropic Kuva via this exploit have had the exploited Entropic Kuva removed from their account. Knowing that some players may have received elevated Entropic Kuva due to normal play habits, we have only removed values that could be obtained through extremely intentional exploiting. 
  • Fixed being unable to destroy Corrupted Nullifier bubbles by shooting the bubble itself.
  • Fixed longer transmission SFX being cut off early.
  • Fixed Citrine Prime's shoulder armor offsets being upside down.
  • Fixed the Mausolon, Morgha, and Cortege's Alt Fires not charging.
  • Fixed the Dorrclave's unique trait not functioning properly.
  • Fixed certain metals appearing flat when tinted black following our Metal Shader changes (notably on the Frost Harka and Kullervo Apostate skins).
    • This change also restored the ability to create pitch black materials on Voidshell skins. 
    • Also fixed some cases of golden Decorations being too yellow following our metal shader changes. Given the variety of decorations in the game, many still remain affected, so we’ll be keeping an eye out for reports as we continue to work to address this issue. 
  • Fixed the Neo K10 Relic having the Gyre Systems instead of the Gyre Prime Systems. 
    • Replacement Script: We’ll be replacing all claimed Gyre Systems with the correct Gyre Prime Systems via a script later this week. We’ll update this thread with more information once it is complete. 
      • Update - September 25 at 3pm ET: Affected players should see a Gyre Prime Systems blueprint added to their inventories.
  • Fixed cases of players getting both positive and negative values of all rolled Traits when cycling an unlocked Riven. 
    • Also fixed rare cases of players being able to roll a positive and negative value of the same trait.
    • Riven Mod Fixing: This was patched live yesterday (September 23) at around 12pm ET, but some players may have chosen the Riven with the broken stats. For those Riven Mods with a) multiple negative traits or b) a trait that has both a positive and a negative, the incorrect negative traits will be removed in a future hotfix. 
    • Kuva Refund Script: players who cycled a Riven and were presented a broken Riven will have their Kuva refunded via a script, regardless if the broken Riven was chosen. We will update this thread with more information once it is run! 
  • Fixed Narin being able to equip a Heavy Weapon while Nurinarim is active.

Performance Issues:

  • Fixed Clients experiencing a large spotload after travelling from the Yuvan Peak to the Chrysalith.
  • Fixed performance issues related to Narin.
  • Fixed performance issues sometimes leading to a crash in Yuvan Peak when someone attempts to pull Narin's Iceblade.
  • Fixed performance issues caused by Aksondol's reload when using Mirage with Hall of Mirrors active.

Mission and Equipment Fixes:

  • Fixed the Mobile Defense terminal having a misaligned interaction prompt if it spawned in the new Melica's Laboratory tile in the Zariman Ten Zero.
  • Fixed Ivara being able to control her Primary Weapon like a Glaive due to an interaction between Navigator and Wrathful Advance.
  • Fixed missing vortex SFX in the Ryoku fight in Scoria's Angel missions.
  • Fixed the cold mist from Aksonol's reload incorrectly triggering Secondary Enervate.

Cosmetic Fixes:

  • Fixes towards GI lighting over-emphasizing Operator/Drifter pores.
  • Fixed Citrine Prime losing her shoulder piece, skirt, and other prime attachments after equipping the Aphrodita Helmet or a TennoGen helmet.
    • While we are fixing this bug, we will be turning these attachments into an Auxiliary attachment in a future update.
  • Fixed tint colors not applying to the crystal reflections on the Spinele Prime Operator/Drifter accessories.
  • Fixes towards cloth physics issues on Narin's skirt.
  • Fixed the Gothica Signa's cloth not being tattered.

Miscellaneous Fixes:

  • Fixed attempting to pull out Narin's Iceblade while in motion resulting in the animation being misaligned.
    • Also fixed missing SFX when attempting to pull out Narin's Iceblade.
    • Also fixed cases of the VFX being misaligned.
  • Fixed a broken icon and filepath appearing in Cephalon Melica's vendor screen on the Yuvan Peak.
  • Fixed cases of emoting next to Narin's Iceblade causing players to fall through the map.
  • Fixed gifting multiple Relic Packs resulting in each pack containing the same Relics.
    • If you were affected by this issue (as the gifter), we ask that you submit a support ticket for further assistance.
  • Fixed various map holes and texture seams in The War Within map.
  • Fixed minor skybox lighting issues in the remastered The War Within map.
  • Fixed missing SFX when unlocking a Riven Trait and made various minor polish changes to this screen.
  • Fixed a player dying after an attempted but failed revive causing their death message to incorrectly state that they were revived.
  • Fixed missing information in Narin's market blueprint description.
  • Fixed minor polish issues in Narin's diorama.
  • Fixed additional cases of Warframes that were released prior to Oraxia not using colorful status icons for their stats in menus.
  • Fixed a minor typo on the update screen that Gary was unfairly blamed for. Sorry Gary!
  • Fixed a minor grammatical error in the Iceblade Blessing description.
  • Fixed cases text not being localized or placeholder descriptions being used on non-English Clients, notably in Narin's market blueprint description and in Melica's Vendor screen.
  • Fixed various script errors related to Narin's Neote, Hakchum, and Naraemagi.
  • Fixed a script error caused by Commandeered Ember's Inferno ability in The Perita Rebellion missions.
  • Fixed a script error related to Banshee's Sound Quake.
  • Fixed a script error related to Banshee's Sonic Boom.
  • Fixed a script error related to Temporal Archimedea modifiers.
  • Fixed an audio crash happening during sound driver reset.
  • Fixed a crash that could occur when returning from alt tabbing after making a purchase on Steam.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1523875-known-issues-iceblade-of-narin/

item.title: Amir’s Shockwave: Hotfix 43.5.3
item.description:
Changes:

  • Nightwave Radio now plays from the Nightwave console in the Backrooms if the Nora Night Volume slider is not set to zero.
  • Updated the description of Athodai Prime's unique trait Overdrive to specify it triggers on weakpoint kills (previously said headshot).
  • Ally Gemini Skin voice lines are now affected by the Enemy & Ally Combat Volume slider in the Advanced Sound Effects Mixer.
  • Improved handling of corrupt shader caches, which could result in crashing.

Surge Eximus Changes & Fixes:

  • Surge Eximus' electricity ability now has a maximum casting range of 50m. 
  • Fixed additional cases of Surge Eximus units causing Clients to crash in Uranus Proxima and Deep Mines missions.
  • Fixed the Surge Eximus' electricity ability not being affected by Banshee's Silence.
  • Fixed the Surge Eximus' electricity ability dealing damage across two ticks instead of one.
    • The actual damage output from the electric shocks is unchanged.
  • Fixed Surge Eximus being able to target invisible players. 

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed Tempera Amp Skin causing Drifter Amps with an Alt-Fire to sometimes not respond to Alt-Fire inputs or the Fire Manual Trigger Weapons Continuously toggle.
    • Also fixed misaligned VFX when firing.
    • Known Issue: This issue persists for Operators with the Tempera Amp Skin equipped. We recommend using a different Amp skin for the time being if you are affected.
  • Fixed Hildryn being able to stack Void Relic opening Ability Strength buffs if it was triggered while she was in Aegis Storm. 
  • Fixed the Vectis (Prime) not having a fully reloaded magazine after exiting Incarnon Form.

Fixes:

  • Fixed being able to drag tints into a Signa's X and Y axis setting in the Appearance menu. 
  • Fixed metallic elements in the Backrooms appearing black for systems with low graphics settings.
  • Fixed various minor decoration issues in Höllvandeim, including a poster not displaying properly, and Lettie's seat missing her lumbar support pillow. 
  • Fixed being unable to place Dojo Decorations in the portal’s dissolve range of the Courtier's Bliss and Harbinger's Pass Dojo Rooms.
  • Fixed Kubrows and Kavats having a duplicate listing of their default fur pattern.
  • Fixed a crash when interacting with the KIM system.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1519687-known-issues-amirs-shockwave/

item.title: Update 43.5: Amir's Shockwave
item.description:
Image Description: A closeup of Amir’s face in front of an electrified microphone in the opposite orientation of Nora Night’s. A crackling border encloses the Amir’s Shockwave logo as blue and purple arcs of electricity frame the image and Amir’s headset.

UPDATE 43.5: AMIR’S SHOCKWAVE 

Get ready for a shakeup like you've never heard before! Amir Beckett of The Hex is cutting through the airwaves (and across space and time) to bring you a double-dose of 1999-themed content. Not only has he hacked Nora’s airways by hosting his own remixed edition of a Nightwave Mix called Amir’s Shockwave replete with never-before-seen Rewards, but he's also joining the rest of his Hex teammates for a unique KIM narrative adventure, Fables & Frontiers: Running Late. Read on to learn more! 

Transcend the chaos of battle, Tenno… This interim update also delivers the Baruuk Shaoshi Collection! Featuring the Baruuk Shaoshi Skin, Rathan Sword & Shield Skin, Liania Signa and Neviti Ephemera. Get your hands on the new TennoGen: Fables & Frontiers, featuring six new creations from community artists –  including the first TennoGen pieces for Kullervo and Oraxia, two brand new Signas, and more. 

This interim update also includes many changes and fixes (including code!). Some pesky issues such as frozen enemies despawning in Netracell missions, and Nokko’s Reroot Rampage not triggering Archon Continuity or having its first bounce dealing damage have been addressed. We have also added a plethora of quality of life changes for the Nightwave system to make Acts more engaging and removed some longstanding pain points. We also have a dedicated Amir’s Shockwave sub-forum to collect your feedback and bug reports to address in follow-up Hotfixes where we can. 

If any of the terms above are new to you, visit The Warframe Lexicon for Updates to learn more about Warframe’s development cycle. 

Download Sizes:

PC DirectX 11: ~248.94 MB

PC DirectX 12: ~250.68 MB

 

Image Description: Amir smirks while looking at us as he juggles three different dice in his left hand. Behind him is a large tabletop game setup complete with game pieces, dice, maps, and sheets. In the foreground is the logo for Fables & Frontiers.

FABLES & FRONTIERS: RUNNING LATE (MINI KIM ADVENTURE)

Magic! Mayhem! Mystery! Play with Amir as your Fablemaster and the rest of the Hex in a six-day mini KIM text adventure of the popular table top roleplaying game! But be warned, all may not be well in Höllvandeim… Log into the KIM and join the Fables & Frontiers: Running Late campaign! 

NOTE: This is a permanent addition to the KIM system! It is not tied to Amir’s Shockwave Nightwave Mix rotation, meaning it can be experienced at any time once the prerequisites have been met. 

Prerequisites

In order to unlock Fables & Frontiers group chat in the KIM, you must have the following:

  • Complete The Hex Quest & The Hex Finale 
  • Reach Rank 5 (Pizza Party) with The Hex Syndicate 
  • Reach Chemistry Rank 5 (Close) with Amir in the KIM system 

How to Begin

Before embarking on the KIM Fables & Frontiers: Running Late adventure, you must first create your character sheet! Here’s how:

  1. Once you have completed all of the listed prerequisites, travel to Höllvania Central Mall from the POM-2 map. 
  2. Make your way up to the second floor of the mall to the “Höllvandeim” room (read dedicated section to learn more). 
    • You can fast travel to Höllvandeim from the pause menu and from the quick access wheel. 
  3. Ring the bell on the table to call in Amir – he’ll appear with much speed and urgency! 
  4. Interact with Amir to put together a character sheet via dialogue options. You’ll choose your character class and their weaponry/abilities!
  5. Return to the POM-2 to begin the campaign in the KIM! Once you have completed your character sheet and Amir has run off to prepare the campaign, you can return to your POM-2 to begin the campaign in the KIM system. 

 

Image Description: Höllvandeim - a decorated room evoking magic and mystery with desks set up for participants. From left to right we can see the fablemaster’s table with their screen, rule book and notes, then the main table complete with a large map, game pieces and seating for six people.

 

Höllvandeim

Located on the second floor of the Höllvania Central Mall you will find what was once the cafe has been taken over completely by Amir and rebranded it as “Höllvandeim” for his campaign. Gotta love a Fable Master that really prioritizes player immersion! Wonder where he got all the Höllars for these decorations… 

Ring the Bell to Summon Amir! 

A service bell sits on the table near the Fablemaster’s station – ring it to summon Amir to the table! The man will appear with great speed and urgency at your call.

Image Description: Amir stares off into the distance as he stands behind a desk with a pizza box used as his fablemaster screen. To the right in the foreground is a service bell placed atop an upside down popcorn bucket of sorts. 

Interact with Amir to gain access to his wares and other things we won’t spoil at this time! 

NOTE: Amir leaves the Arcade downstairs when rung to Höllvandeim and returns once you leave the room. If he’s downstairs, simply ring the bell again to call him back up. Alternatively, you can jump to him upstairs (using the Höllvandeim option) or downstairs (using the Protoframe, Amir option) using the quick access wheel. Such speed! 

Amir’s Fables & Frontiers Store 

Amir has many Fables & Frontiers goodies and more available for Standing with the Hex in Höllvandeim! Ring the bell to summon him upstairs and peruse his wares. 

For the sake of not spilling all the beans on the kind of mayhem you may get yourself into in the campaign, we chose to not list out each and every unique item in the shop in detail. You’ll just have to complete the campaign to see for yourself! 

  • Fables & Frontiers character Glyphs, one for each Hex member, by community artist ZliDe
  • Character Sheet Posters, one for each Hex member, by community artist Brighan
  • Fables & Frontiers Character Posters, one for each Hex member, by community artist Brighan
  • Several decorations based on the Fables & Frontiers adventure
  • Several Glyphs featuring foes you may encounter in the Fables & Frontiers adventure 
  • A new Somachord track by On-lyne titled “Running Late”

    Image Description: Promotional poster for On-lyne’s new track Running Late with the members running. From left to right are: Harddrive, Packet, Zeke, Drillbit, and DJ RoM.
  • A Fables & Frontiers-themed Somachord track titled “A Byte-sized Adventure” 
  • Running Late Album Cover Display and Promo Poster 
  • Dominion of Höllvandeim Captura Scene
  • The following returned rewards from Nightwave Mix Vol. 8:
    • Big Bytes Pizza Sigil
    • Nightwave Livery
    • Lillian Floof
    • Jillian Floof
    • Battlecry Ink
    • Boltor Kubrow Armor
    • Tammpet Sugatra
    • Aoi Origami Glyph
    • Liset Domestik Drone
  • And so much more!!

What to Expect 

Amir is the Fablemaster, the man at the helm responsible for organizing the campaign and writing the story! He is hosting his latest campaign “Running Late” entirely from a new KIM group chat with you and the Hex, which is available to access from the new Fables & Frontiers Batch tab. 

Image Description: Screenshot of the KIM UI with the Fables & Frontiers Batch tab selected. An unread message from H16h V0l7463 reads “HEY HEY ALL!!”.

You and the Hex will join the group chat and play as your Fables & Frontiers characters:

  • Arthur plays as Cedric Dawnsong 
  • Aoi plays as Morohime Ichigeki 
  • Eleanor plays as Sanguina Kallisti
  • Lettie plays as Ixchel Balam
  • Quincy plays as Lord Reyland Kingsacre

Image Description: Screenshot of the Kinemantik Instant Messenger showing the initial conversation from the Fables & Frontier campaign.

There are six days of adventuring ahead of you, with one session available per day. Amir needs time to plan out what the adventurers will encounter next, so check back after the Daily Reset (0:00 UTC) to continue the story with the Hex! 

This is intended to be a fun role-playing adventure, and for that reason there is no Chemistry earned from the conversations had in the Fables & Frontiers group chat.  

Somewhere along the way in your adventure with the Hex, you will encounter a new enemy… the Surge Eximus! This speedy Eximus unit targets foes with a triple strike of devastating Electric Damage. But where oh where did it come from… 

Rewards 

Completing the Fables & Frontiers campaign will reward you with the following: 

  • Fables & Frontiers: Running Late Poster (Inbox reward)

    Image Description: Poster depicting members of The Hex as a party of fantastical characters such as a Warlock, Knight, and Sorcerer. Looming over them in an ominous manner appears to be Amir.
    • Cover art for the Fables & Frontiers: Running Late adventure. Artwork by community artist Nikki Dawes. 
  • Access to Replay KIM Campaign
    • Like all other KIM batches, you can reset your memories with Fables & Frontiers from the Digital Grimoire to replay the adventure! You may also do this by talking to Amir. Doing so will erase all conversation history from the Fables & Frontiers batch and allow you to take another stab at the campaign.

      Image Description: Screenshot of the Digital Grimoire UI with Amir’s Shockwave Fables & Frontiers selected. The option to reset your memories is shown with a yellow Commit button visible.
    • After resetting your memories you may choose to replay your experience by selecting the same character as before, or you can explore the campaign through the lens of a different character by choosing another one instead. 
    • Please note that resetting your memories will temporarily remove access to Amir’s Fables & Frontiers Store until you talk to him and create a character sheet.

 

  

Image Description: A closeup of Amir’s face in front of an electrified microphone in the opposite orientation of Nora Night’s. A crackling border encloses the Amir’s Shockwave logo as blue and purple arcs of electricity frame the image and Amir’s headset.

NIGHTWAVE MIX: AMIR’S SHOCKWAVE 

BEGINS TODAY @ 11:30 AM ET

New Nightwave Tier Rewards 

With Amir’s Shockwave, complete Nightwave acts to net these new (and returning) tier rewards. 

Like previous editions of Nightwave, we have duplicate protection for items you already own. You will be compensated with Amir’s Shockwave Creds instead of the previous unlocked reward.

Augment Mod Stats shown at Max Rank. 

Image Description: The Drifter poses next to an Atomicycle while wearing the Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia. The orange and black biker suit is accentuated with a white trim on the helmet. Note: The Barracuda Atomicycle Livery pictured is not included in the Regalia. 

Kaneshell Atomicycle Regalia 

Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator. Includes the jacket, helmet, leggings and sleeves.  

Teisatz Oculus

A stylish piece of new age tech with over 9000 different features.

Globakk Syandana

Only the most highly trained - or highly reckless - Scaldra dare to wear this portable Efervon container.

Come Here Emote

An encouraging display for a beloved companion.

Equip this emote using the Gear Wheel tab in the Arsenal.

Entropic Color Palette

A selection of colors for when the usual upbeat charm just won’t do.

Submeower Decoration

Don’t ask where the power cord goes.

Prototype Shock Coils (EFV-8 MARS) 

Adds +90% Electric Damage, and shots have a 20% base chance to apply extra Electric status independent of modded damage types

Overpressured Rounds (EFV-5 JUPITER)

Rifle kills add 120% Falloff Distance and decrease Spread for next attack with Buckshot. Buckshot kills restore 50% of the current Magazine. 

Drippy Floof

In case of waterworks, this cuddly Drippy Floof is here to help.

Drippy Keychain Sugatra

Show off your drip with this drippy Drippy Sugatra.

Drippy Dog Days Glyph

The K.O.L. Summer update includes this new Drippy to help you cool off and enjoy your summer.

90’s Kid Honoria 

|NAME| 90’s Kid 

 

Cred Offerings Store Updates 

Amir’s takeover brings many updates to the Cred Offerings Store! Earn Amir’s Shockwave Creds from the reward tiers and trade them in for both new and returning items. Let’s take a look at some of the new revisions and adjustments below. 

Permanent Cred Offerings

The following rewards are now available at all times in the Cred Offerings Store – in other words, they are no longer part of the store rotations and are now permanent fixtures in the store. These are in addition to the existing permanent offerings, which remain unchanged. 

  • New to Cred Offerings: Nightwave Landing Craft Blueprint & Components (Engines, Avionics & Fuselage)

    Image Description: A Landing Craft ship with winged components on each side and two small “tails” angled outwards at the back. It features a deep purple body, light green emissives, and orange energy with a high gloss shine. 
    • We first introduced the Nightwave Landing Craft in Nightwave Series 3: Glassmaker and from there was rotated back into various Nightwave Mixes tier rewards. Instead of continuing to add it as a tier reward, we have instead decided to add its Blueprint and Components as a permanent addition to the Cred Offerings shop. 
  • Aura Mods 
    • Corrosive Projection
    • Dead Eye

New Cred Offerings

We’ve added the following items into the Cred Offerings store rotations:

  • DJ Shockwave Sigil - A sigil commemorating when Amir took over the airwaves as DJ Shockwave.
  • DJ Shockwave Glyph - A glyph awarded to those who tuned in to Amir’s takeover of the airwaves.

General Cred Offerings Changes

  • 6 Weapon Augment Mods are now guaranteed in each rotation.

    • Recovered Artifacts 
      • Contains permanent store resources (Kuva, Nitain Extract, Orokin Reactor/Catalyst, etc.) and blueprints (Nightwave Landing Craft & Vauban).
