New Nightwave Acts

  • Daily Acts:
    • Whole Arsenal – Get a kill with your Primary, Secondary and Melee weapons within 10 seconds. 
    • Artist – Customize a piece of equipment’s colours. 
  • Weekly Acts:
    • To Ashes – Dissolve an Arcane for Vosfor. 
    • Bow Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Bow. 
    • Rifle Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Rifle. 
    • Sniper Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Sniper Rifle. 
    • Shotgun Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Shotgun. 
    • Void Net – Collect 30 Void Traces. 
  • Elite Weekly Acts:
    • Elementary, My Dear – Complete 3 successful Conversions in the Alchemy game mode. 
    • Going Down – Defeat Roathe in Descendia. 
    • Hold the Mushrooms – Collect 6 mushrooms from the Deepmines. 
    • Battle Hardened – Complete the Perita Rebellion with 6 or more orders completed. 
    • Spider Hunt – Complete an Isleweaver Duviri Mission. 
    • Treasure from the Past – Complete a Netracell. 

 

Nightwave Act Updates

Act Changes

  • The Hunt is On (Daily)
    • Previously: Find 5 Syndicate Medallions
    • Changes:
      • Increased required Syndicate Medallions from 5 to 10 
      • Changed from Daily to Weekly
  • Earth/Venus/Zariman Bounty Hunter (Weekly)
    • Previously:“Complete x/3 different Bounties…” on Earth/Venus or “Complete x/4 different Bounties in the Zariman”.
    • Changes:
      • No longer requires different Bounties
      • Changed Zariman Act from Weekly to Elite Weekly
  • Now Boarding (Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 3 different K-Drive races in Orb Vallis on Venus or in Cambion Drift on Deimos
    • Change: Reduced required K-Drive races from 3 to 1
  • Eternal Guardian (Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 2 Void Armageddon missions
    • Changes: 
      • Progress counts 2 Armageddon round completions instead of mission completions
      • Changed from Weekly to Elite Weekly
  • High Ground (Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 3 Void Flood Missions
    • Changes: 
      • Progress counts 12 Ruptures Sealed rather than missions completions
      • Changed from Weekly to Elite Weekly
  • Finely Tuned (Weekly)
    • Previously: Play 2 different Shawzin songs in Duviri
    • Changes: 
      • Now only requires player to play 1 Shawzin song
      • Updated the description to specify that it requires the Shawzin activity, not the Emote.
  • Cache Hunter (Weekly)
    • Previously: Find 6 caches across any Sabotage missions
    • Changes: 
      • Caches found in non-sabotage missions will count towards progress
      • Updated description and tip to make locations of eligible Caches clearer to players
  • Perplexed (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 3 puzzles in Duviri
    • Changes: 
      • Reduced puzzles from 3 to 1
      • Changed from Elite Weekly to Weekly
  • Day Trader (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Win 3 wagers in a row without letting the enemy score in one match of The Index
    • Changes: 
      • Removed the “without letting the enemy score” stipulation
      • This Act is no longer locked behind The Glast Gambit quest as it is not required to access The Index
  • Elite Explorer (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 8 Railjack Missions
    • Change: Reduced mission requirements from 8 to 6
  • Fallen Angel (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Kill 5 Void Angels in The Zariman
    • Change: Reduced Void Angels from 5 to 3

Act Removals 

Removed the following Railjack Acts: 

  • Confiscated - Hijack a Crewship from the Enemy
  • Friendly Fire - While piloting Hijacked Crewship, destroy 3 enemy fighters

These were removed as they were difficult to complete while playing in a Squad as it required you to essentially compete against your teammates to hijack a Crewship and kill enemies. 

Quality of Life Changes

  • Recovering an Act now prioritizes Acts that are not locked. 
  • Updated various Acts to be locked behind Quest/Junction/etc. requirements. 
    • The main reason for this effort is to play off of the Recovered Act change listed above. Prioritizing unlocked Acts means little if the Act recovered is still uncompletable. We’ve done our best to select minimum Lock criteria to access the content for the Act, to maintain flexibility where possible.
    • Vox Solaris:
      • Conservationist
      • Now Boarding
      • Venus Bounty Hunter
      • Venus Fisher
      • Venus Miner
    • Howl of the Kubrow:
      • Loyalty
    • Duviri Paradox:
      • Beast Slayer
      • Horsin’ Around
      • Skeletons in the Closet
      • I Decree
    • Stolen Dreams:
      • Animator
    • The Archwing:
      • Explorer
      • Flawless
      • Elite Explorer
    • The New Strange:
      • Test Subject
      • Sanctuary Researcher
    • Heart of Deimos:
      • Vault Raider
      • Feed the Beast
      • Mirror, Mirror (also requires MR 3)
    • Mastery Rank 3:
      • Supporter
    • Angels of the Zariman:
      • Fallen Angel
    • Mars Junction: 
      • Unlock Relics (and Elite version)
    • Eris Junction:
      • Vital Arbiter
  • Updated various Act tips to help clarify how to complete them. 
  • The Antiquarian Act now indicates what Relic types have already been unlocked. 
  • Improved Weekly Act scheduling so there should be no more repeating Weekly Nightwave Acts (excluding the Permanent Weeklies) in a series.

 

Image Description: Baruuk Shaoshi poses with his Rathan Sword & Shield, and Neviti Ephemera as if preparing to fight within the Sanctum Anatomica. Emanating from his morningstar-like sword, buckler-like shield, and stole-like ephemera is an almost spectral purple energy.

BARUUK SHAOSHI COLLECTION

Transcend the chaos of battle. Baruuk Shaoshi’s mystic runes show him the path to peace.

This bundle contains the following items, which can all be purchased separately:

Baruuk Shaoshi Skin 

Fear the gaze of Baruuk Shaoshi’s mystic eye. His martial mastery, honed over long ages of defending sacred ground, is once again brought to bear against all enemies of peace.

Rathan Sword & Shield Skin

Baruuk Shaoshi’s signature Sword & Shield skin evokes the ancient arms carried by sacred guardians, those who embraced the balance between defense and attack.

Liania Signa

The dignified drape of Baruuk Shaoshi’s signature Signa is the mark of a warrior committed to defending peace - by any means necessary.

Neviti Ephemera

Encircled by harmonious energy, the shifting balance of conflict reveals itself in Baruuk Shaoshi's signature ephemera.

 

TENNOGEN: FABLES & FRONTIERS 

Six new creations from community artists have arrived, including the first TennoGen pieces for Kullervo and Oraxia, two brand new Signas, and more! 

Image Description: From left to right are three new Tennogen items: Oraxia Agamva Helmet, Haemadys Mask, and the Kullervo Ascophilia Skin.

Kullervo Ascophilia Skin

A brand new Skin & Alt Helmet for Kullervo, designed by Erneix. 

Oraxia Agamva Helmet

A brand new Alt Helmet for Oraxia, designed by led2012. 

Haemadys Mask (Operator/Drifter)

An Infested mask, designed by Vhynnz. 

Image Description: Two new Tennogen items are shown - the Harrow Profitas Skin and the Centurio Signa.

Harrow Profitas Skin

A Corpus inspired Skin & Alt Helmet for Harrow, designed by malaya, Jadie and Noxxr. 

Centurio Signa

A TennoGen Signa, designed by Lubox. 

Acheta Signa 

A TennoGen Signa, designed by blazingcobalt and Ritens.


Image Description: The Memetica Glyph Pack III glyphs are displayed across two rows and three columns. From left to right in the top row are Absolute Cinema, Arthur in the Fridge, and Chassis. While the second row shows Dump It, Kalymos Cone, and Lotus Change of Plans.

MEMETICA GLYPH PACK III

A bundle of glyphs highlighting the very serious history of Warframe, created by Community artist ibumuc.

  • Absolute Cinema Glyph
  • Arthur In The Fridge Glyph
  • Chassis Glyph
  • Dump It Glyph
  • Kalymos Cone Glyph
  • Lotus Change of Plans Glyph

If you missed these glyphs during our TennoCon 2026 Memetica Twitch Drops Campaign in June & July, they are now live in the market to grab! They can be purchased for 90 Platinum in the bundle, or 20 Platinum per Glyph.

 

ADDITIONS

  • New Drippy UI Theme and Background are available to purchase from the “Customize UI Theme” options.

    Image Description: Screenshot of the new Drippy UI theme and background with Baruuk Shaoshi kneeling. The theme evokes a wet feeling with a rainy background, blue ripples that have a Drippy submerged near the center, and a splash of light red graffiti and two Drippies flanking Baruuk.
    • To access: Open pause menu, select Options, select the Interface tab, select Customize UI Theme.
  • Added an X Axis for Signa placement!

    • Image Description: Composite image of two screenshots showing the Mesa Heirloom Signa being placed on Wisp. On the left shows the X-offset with a vertical double-sided arrow indicating the direction the signa may be moved. On the right shows the Y-offset showing the horizontal direction.
  • Added Drifter versions of the Wolf Hood and the Umbra Hooded Scarf. 
    • Players who already owned the Operator version should see the Drifter version in their accounts upon login. 
  • Added various Fishing Stats to player profiles.
  • Added new Honoria for completing certain Challenges:
    • |NAME| Leaves No Witnesses 
    • |NAME| The Demolitionist 
    • |NAME| Angel of Death 
    • |NAME| Plague Doctor 
    • |NAME| It Will Kill 
    • Restless |NAME|
    • |NAME| Was Never Here
    • |NAME| Will Do Anything For Money
    • |NAME| Death from Above
    • |NAME| Parazon Runner
  • Added new Honoria to Roathe in exchange for various resources:
    • |NAME| Cryomancer
    • |NAME| Head Cracker
    • |NAME| It's All Relative
    • |NAME| Master of Minds
    • Doctor |NAME| 
    • |NAME| Conscientious Objector
  • Added new Honoria rewarded upon completing The Hex Quests:
    • The Hex: Marty |NAME| McFlea
    • The Hex Finale: Pizza Time for |NAME|
  • Added a Personal Decorations option to the Dojo Room Console screen. 

 

CHANGES

Sirius & Orion Changes 

  • Sirius & Orion’s Jade Stars now uses (improved) Line of Sight.
    • With our buffs to it earlier this summer, Jade Stars has become an exponentially popular Helminth ability due to its interactions with far-reaching Damage over Time abilities like Saryn’s Spores. Our goal is to keep Jade Stars feeling powerful and impactful, but avoid situations where it can continually wipe the map without actually seeing the enemies it’s killing (ie standing in a corner and triggering Jade Stars on repeat).
  • Sirius & Orion’s Celestial Clash now deals guaranteed Status Effects depending on which Son is Clashing.
    • Sirius deals Heat Damage with a guaranteed Heat Status Effect.
    • Orion deals Slash Damage with a guaranteed Slash Status Effect.
  • Sirius & Orion will no longer swap to the Primary Son when using an item from the Gear Wheel

General Changes

  • Weapons with locked Explosion Radius now display a lock icon on that stat in the Arsenal. 
  • Improved the flow when starting the Chimera Prologue from the Codex if you have another Active Quest.
    • Previously, a certain interaction would not trigger if a different quest was set to Active. Now, starting the Chimera Prologue will clear all Active Quests so the interaction can occur. 
  • Enemy Highlights now apply to the Targets in the Mastery Rank 6 and Legendary Rank 6 tests. 
    • Also improved the visibility of lines between the targets in these tests. 
  • Resetting settings to Defaults now offers players the option to reset All Settings to default, or just the current Tab’s settings. 
  • Improved the dodge hint in the final segment of The Old Peace quest. 
  • Railjack reticles are now solid white to improve their visibility. 
  • Removed an incorrect Electric Shield ability tip for Volt. 
  • Removed flashing VFX from Void Fissures in-mission to address photosensitivity concerns.
  • Made adjustments to the Commandeered Prime spawn SFX and mine explosion SFX in The Perita Rebellion. 
  • The "Mission Tutorial Transmissions" toggle now applies to transmissions in Persto Survival and Hell-Scrub missions.
  • Background transmissions, such as Ordis chatter or start chart notifications, are now muted when viewing the Inbox. 

 

PERFORMANCE & OPTIMIZATIONS 

  • Optimized in-game chat servers to handle larger numbers of players. 
  • Fixed a minor hitch when joining a mission with a Sirius & Orion present.

 

FIXES

Top Fixes

  • Fixed the Vectis Incarnon Form benefitting from Primed Chamber on every shot. 
  • Fixed Nokko’s Reroot Rampage Augment not triggering Archon Continuity. 
  • Fixed Silken Stride’s buff persisting after exiting the Ability if Oraxia does not have a Secondary Weapon equipped. 
  • Fixed Incarnon Challenge progress being reset upon swapping to a channeled Exalted Weapon.
  • Fixed Nokko’s Reroot Rampage’s first bounce dealing no damage. 
  • Fixed cases of Frozen enemies despawning in Netracell missions. 
  • Fixed a method of being able to trigger Mirror Defense waves to start sooner than intended in Tyana Pass. 

Sirius & Orion Fixes

  • Fixed Cephalon Simaris blocking abilities based on the Inactive Son’s casts in Sanctuary Onslaught missions.
  • Fixed swapping between Sons while entering a Nullifier Bubble resulting in the Secondary Son permanently losing access to his Abilities. 
  • Fixed function loss caused by using Transference mid-Clash during Celestial Clash.
    • Now Transference is prevented until the animation is completed. 
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion being able to sustain Void Fissure buffs for longer than the intended duration. 
  • Fixed cases of pickups not being collected after swapping between Sons in Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion remaining permanently invulnerable due to an interaction with the Atomicycle. 
  • Fixed a case of Sirius & Orion being able to equip the Vinquibis in only one weapon slot. 
  • Fixed Arcane Concentration stacking multiple times for Clients with poor connection when equipped on Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed Inactive Son running out of Heavy Weapon ammo resulting in their Melee weapon being disabled. 
  • Fixed a loss of function when swapping between Sirius & Orion right before entering Submersible Archwing.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion being able to become permanently stuck after dodging Vena’s spike ability with Celestial Clash in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed the Arsenal’s Vehicles tab not displaying properly when accessed as Sirius & Orion in a Hub.
  • Fixed swapping to the Secondary Son resulting in Sirius & Orion being able to bypass the Noodletron-only restriction in Floaty of Fury Alerts. 
  • Fixed cases of HUD buff icons not refreshing properly for Sirius & Orion. 
  • Fixed Orion wielding a Melee weapon in non-combat areas (Base of Operations, Relays, etc.) if he has no Primary or Secondary equipped.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son’s Secondary Weapon using the Appearance Config A instead of B.
  • Fixed Orion appearing in the background of the Loadout menu after swapping to a loadout with Sirius & Orion equipped. 

Mission Fixes 

  • Fixed the possibility of getting a function loss when getting teleported to the Orowyrm fight during Duviri Experience activities.
  • Fixed Clients loading into an empty mission following a host migration while loading into a Scoria’s Angel mission.
  • Fixed the Void Hole’s explosion SFX being out of sync in Railjack missions.
  • Fixed cases of players being able to bypass Vena fight stages if they deal enough damage in a short window. 
  • Fixed additional cases of Inaros and Sevagoth not being teleported if they are in their special death state during a transition in Uranus Proxima missions. 
  • Fixed cases of Vena having a yellowish hue instead of the intended red in the final stage of her boss fight in The Kuva Wytch mission.  
  • Fixed Ryoku’s smoke bomb VFX missing for Clients in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed flickering VFX on the Asteroid Field in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed enemies remaining in the boss arena after Vena is defeated in The Kuva Wytch mission. Now any remaining living foes should be killed when she is. 
  • Fixed allies being able to body block the “Collect Artifact” context action in The Kuva Wytch mission. 
  • Fixed cases of being able to skip the Exterminate objective in The Kuva Wytch mission. 
  • Fixed being able to use the Omni Recall with very specific timing during Uranus Proxima missions. 
  • Fixed missing SFX when Vena is hacking in the Scoria’s Angel mission.
  • Fixed allied Scaldra Eradicators sometimes dealing friendly fire with their grenades. 
  • Fixed the Scrofa Attack Drone’s hitbox not covering the majority of its body. 
  • Fixed House Lavan Components not properly applying their unique trait if triggered via the Archwing Slingshot in Railjack missions.  

UI Fixes

  • Fixed waypoints lingering on the screen when an Ally’s Companion is downed. 
  • Fixed issues related to the “Hide Equipped” toggle in the Trading menu. 
  • Fixed the weapon HUD disappearing after unequipping a Mining Laser or Scanner via the Gear Wheel. 
  • Fixed cases of offered items extending off of the screen after using the “select all” option in the Trading Menu. This was a UI-only issue!
  • Fixed the “Repeat Mission” input bringing players to a broken Node selection pop-up in the Navigation screen. 
  • Fixed Styanax Prime’s diorama incorrectly listing Blueprint Details. 
  • Fixed a loss of function when attempting to purchase Platinum via a flow of actions originating from the Arsenal Upgrade screen.
  • Fixed entering a Uranus Proxima mission with a personal Railjack resulting in the Squad HUD using the names of Ryoku or Vena’s Crew. (This was a UI-only issue).
  • Fixed partial function loss when opening and exiting Chat Settings while in the Foundry.
  • Fixed Claw Mods being sorted into the Melee category instead of the Beast category. 
  • Fixed being unable to upgrade Titania’s Dex Pixia via the Loadout selection dropdown in the Navigation menu. 
  • Fixed the squad overlay appearing in the Amp Customization screen. 
  • Fixed the Equipment screen using the term Operator when the Drifter is equipped. 
  • Fixed Sun & Moon appearing in the Uranus Junction end of mission screen, despite it being a reward from The Duviri Paradox. 
  • Fixed the number on the Void Fissure tab in the Navigation menu not updating properly when swapping between Normal and Steel Path. 
  • Fixed the Dojo Teleporter menu not respecting capitalization choices of players. 

Quest Fixes

  • Fixed a missing cinematic when returning to The Drifter Camp in The New War quest.
  • Fixed the incorrect HUD appearing briefly when loading into a mission in The Old Peace quest. 
  • Fixed two Lotuses appearing in The Dark Refractory during The Old Peace quest. 
  • Fixed placeholder text appearing in a pop-up during The Teacher quest. 
  • Fixed a duplicate Vena and Ryoku appearing in their ending boss fight cutscenes in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest. 
  • Fixed cases of Stalker using the incorrect weapon during a cutscene in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest. 
  • Fixed rare cases of the Mission Fail screen appearing when transitioning from a mission in the Heart of Deimos quest. 
  • Fixed a missing confirmation prompt when exiting the Operator customization in The Second Dream quest. 
  • Fixed fast travelling to Palladino in the Iron Wake causing progression issues in the Chains of Harrow quest.

Cosmetic Fixes 

  • Fixed being unable to equip Amp Skins on the Mote Amp and Sirocco. 
  • Fixed Garuda’s Talons never being holstered when equipped as a Melee weapon in-mission. 
  • Fixed Gemini Skin faces being deformed when swapping between Loadouts equipped with Gemini Skins in the Navigation screen.
  • Fixed various Emblem offsets on the Dante Tytonis Skin. 
  • Fixed various Sugatra offsets on the Xoris Elixis Skin. 
  • Fixed various leg armor offset issues on the Ryoku Gemini Skin, Vena Gemini Skin, and on Kullervo. 
  • Fixed various chest armor offset issues on the Mesa Heirloom Skin, Voruna Medeina Skin, Drifter Goth Suit, Drifter Chymerist Suit, and Vena Gemini Skin. 
  • Fixed various shoulder armor offset issues on Khora and Wisp. 
  • Fixed various Daurus Prime armor set offset issues. 
  • Fixed Mesa Heirloom’s Syandana clipping through her legs with the Valkyr Carnivex Noble Animation equipped. 
  • Fixed customizing Merulina resulting in Yareli briefly not using an animation set. 
  • Fixed the Tealtrian Ephemera not properly applying Energy tints. 
  • Fixed Octavia Prime’s skirt not being removed when equipping the default Octavia skin. 
  • Fixed an issue where selecting an Operator/Drifter Complexion Tint before it was fully initialized resulting in it applying at full Tint Vibrancy instead of the default of 0.05.

Misc. Fixes

  • Fixed the Sanctum Anatomica becoming inaccessible when replaying a Quest.
  • Fixed the Archwing Articula decoration breaking if the equipped Loadout is deleted.
  • Fixed changing Dojo Dry Dock polychrome colors also affecting the Vessel. 
  • Fixed walkways in the Dry Dock not being affected by Polychrome.
  • Fixed being unable to chatlink the Exploration Poster.
    • Also fixed issues with its Market Diorama positioning. 
  • Fixed a lingering blocking volume in the Orb Vallis after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest. 
  • Fixed the Backroom using custom Camera Position settings after returning from a mission.
  • Fixed minor typos in a Hex chat and in Mother’s bounty subtitles. 
  • Fixed being unable to chatlink various Operator and Drifter suit pieces. 
  • Fixed a file path in the Bladeswarm Nullifier Crewman Codex entry. 
  • Fixed Sevagoth’s Lullaby continuing to play after exiting its Market Diorama. 

Crashes & Script Error Fixes 

  • Fixed a crash upon reviving as Sirius & Orion. 
  • Fixed a crash upon returning to the Dry Dock with Vena in your Railjack Crew.
  • Fixed a script error in the Operator/Drifter Customization menu.
  • Fixed a script error related to Frost’s Snow Globe. 
  • Fixed a script error in Archwing Pursuit missions. 
  • Fixed a script error when dropping an explosive Power Cell into a Gravity Conveyor while on Merulina during the Raptors assassination mission. 
  • Fixed a script error when browsing through cosmetics in the Arsenal. 
  • Fixed an edge case in the market where having the market open while an item is being retired caused a script error.
  • Fixed a script error related to the Orphix’s anti-Warframe aura.
  • Fixed a rare crash for players that lingered in Relays or Hubs for 24+ hours. 
  • Fixed a script error when subsuming an Ability or installing an Archon Shard in Sirius & Orion. 
  • Fixed a script error related to Railjack component research. 
  • Fixed a script error when killing a Grineer Roller while transitioning from an Open Landscape to the Hub.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: 
https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1519687-known-issues-amirs-shockwave/

item.title: Amir’s Shockwave: Hotfix 43.5.2
item.description:
Changes:

  • Removed the blocking volume around the Fables & Frontiers table in the Dominion of Höllvandeim Scene.

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed various Amps with Alt-Fire sometimes not responding to Alt-Fire inputs or to the Fire Manual Trigger Weapons Continuously toggle.
  • Fixed more Surge Eximus units causing Clients to crash, notably in missions in the Albrecht's Laboratories tileset.
  • Fixed damage of multiple Electric Ammo Packs from Cyte-09's Resupply stacking with another.
  • Fixed the Raptor fight not progressing after dropping an explosive Power Cell into a Gravity Conveyor while in Transference.
  • Fixed Clients not hearing the Surge Eximus' ability SFX.

Fixes:

  • Fixed DJ Shockwave's Radio transmissions in the Orbiter not being randomized.
  • Fixed the POM-2 not displaying an exclamation mark if there are new Fables & Frontiers KIM messages.
  • Fixed another case of being able to equip the Vinquibus in only one weapon slot, or equip disallowed weapons on Companions.
  • Fixed duplicate Höllvandeims appearing in the Fast Travel wheel after entering and exiting the Protoframes category.
  • Fixed a script error when interacting with Eidolon Lures in the Plains of Eidolon if the mission was joined in progress.
  • Fixed a rare script error in The Descendia that resulted in The Shrine Defense mode not working properly.
  • Fixed a crash related to Moa Companions.

Performance Changes & Fixes:

  • Further improved handling of corrupt shader caches in DirectX 11.
  • Made systemic micro-optimizations to DirectX 11 rendering.
  • Fixed spotloading when using a Kubrow or Kavat in Höllvania missions.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1519687-known-issues-amirs-shockwave/

item.title: Amir’s Shockwave: Hotfix 43.5.1
item.description:
Fixes:

  • Fixed Clients crashing when encountering certain Surge Eximus units.
  • Fixed the Cronus Blueprint only dropping once from the Vor fight. 
    • Now it's a guaranteed drop each time you defeat Vor.
  • Fixed Sirius' Light Sanctuary VFX being invisible for players with Particle Quality set to Low (or on platforms without access to this setting).
  • Fixed Vena not using her Talons and targeting enemies as an on-call Crew member.
  • Fixed some cases of "Fable Master" appearing instead of the intended "Fablemaster" in Amir's Fables & Frontiers.
  • Fixed Amir forgetting to clean up a few items from the internet cafe when setting up for Höllvandeim in the Höllvania Central Mall.
  • Fixed minor performance issues related to Orion's Black Hole's VFX.
  • Fixed Orion's Astral Shell ability's VFX sometimes appearing white upon recast.
  • Fixed various script errors related to Sirius & Orion's Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed a script error related to Xaku's The Lost ability.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1519687-known-issues-amirs-shockwave/

item.title: Mesa Heirloom: Hotfix 43.0.7
item.description:
Image Description: Mesa Heirloom poses with her Regulators, cowboy hat-like Signa, and flowing Duster. The red glow from her translucent skin stands in stark contrast to the dark background with tiny floating embers.

MESA HEIRLOOM COLLECTION
LAUNCHES ON ALL PLATFORMS @ 11 A.M. ET

Saunter into the fray and send outlaws to their graves with the Mesa Heirloom Collection. Let her Regulators echo a ballad beneath the high-noon sun.

Image Description: Mesa Heirloom shows off her devilish look with curved horns adorning her helmet. Strapped to her chest are three bullets on either side as she stares off into the distance.

Mesa Heirloom Skin
The legendary gunslinger. The notorious heartbreaker. Better call the undertaker, 'cause Mesa Heirloom just sauntered into town.


Image Description: Mesa Heirloom backs us to reveal the intricate designs of her Duster. Dark black threads punctuated by metal clips and finishings complete this knee-length garment.

Mesa Heirloom Duster
Mesa Heirloom's signature duster.

Image Description: Screenshots of Mesa Heirloom wearing her Duster and without.

You may also set the Auxiliary attachment option to None to remove the duster.

Image Description: Mesa Heirloom tips her Signa like a sheriff. With attachments that match her Duster and slots for her horns, the Signa evokes the feeling of a hellish cowgirl. 

Mesa Heirloom Signa
Mesa Heirloom's signature Signa reveals a dazzling hidden side to the vagabond enforcer.

Mesa Heirloom Regulators Skin
Mesa Heirloom's signature Regulators.

Mesa Heirloom Color Palette
A rodeo of colors honoring Mesa's legacy.

Mesa Heirloom Sigil
Mesa Heirloom's sigil warns outlaws their time has come.

Mesa Heirloom Glyph
These guns don't miss.

Mesa Heirloom Prex Card
The notorious gunslinger.

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed cases of Clients desyncing during Sirius & Orion's Celestial Clash, which could cause Clients to be ineligible for Relic Rewards in Void Fissures, and other effects.
  • Fixed cases of Clients teleporting to previous locations during Sirius & Orion’s Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed Primary Compression not reducing explosive range and increasing damage for the Tenet Envoy while aiming down sights.
  • Fixed dying as the Secondary Son resulting in Sirius & Orion having no Secondary Weapon after reviving.
  • Fixed cases of players in a special state (Last Gasp, Protea's Temporal Anchor, Sevagoth's Shadow, etc.) not being teleported by objective countdown timers in Uranus Proxima missions.
    • Known issue: This issue still occurs for Inaros in his special death state. 
  • Fixed instances of players getting stuck in mission load until restart.
  • Improved handling of crashes caused by running out of memory.
  • Fixed the Imperator Vandal receiving a duplicate entry in player Profiles.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son of Sirius & Orion being able to bypass weapon restrictions in Sortie missions.

Sirius & Orion Fixes:

  • Fixed the Mausolon not consuming ammo when equipped by the Secondary Son.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son being able to enter a Warframe-restricted area, and therefore a cinematic in the Angels of the Zariman quest.
  • Fixed swapping to Sirius & Orion from a Warframe with an Exalted weapon resulting in that Exalted Weapon's icon appearing next to the Secondary Son's name in the Arsenal.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion being tiny in the Jordan Golem Assassinate extraction cinematic if you extracted as the Secondary Son.
  • Fixed cases of Sirius & Orion getting kicked out immediately after entering Points of Interest in Railjack missions.
  • Fixed the Vehicles tab not properly displaying in the Base of Operation's Arsenal if it was swapped to from Orion.
    • Known Issue: this still occurs when accessing the Arsenal in different Hubs.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son appearing in a cinematic during The Old Peace quest.
  • Fixed a certain cinematic fading out to a permanent black screen in The Old Peace quest if Sirius & Orion are equipped.
  • Fixed minor diorama issues in Sirius & Orion's Ability screens.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion having the incorrect Scythes equipped during a segment in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Fixed various chest armor offset issues on Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixing a script error for Sirius & Orion when casting Well of Life.

Uranus Proxima Fixes:

  • Fixed the Vena or Ryoku's fight not starting if a squadmate is dead upon entering the Boss Fight room in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed cases of fog being incredibly bright on low-spec machines in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed cases of the Vault's door remaining open during the Mawbound Director fight, resulting in players being able to get stuck outside the room.
  • Fixed players being locked outside of the Sister fight in The Kuva Wytch missions if they died before it was triggered and revived after it had started.
  • Fixed cases of the Megacoil powercell counter not updating in the second stage of the Ryoku fight.
  • Fixed Necramechs not being disabled after Host Migration in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed Uranus Proxima missions not ending if players run out of revives or the Railjack suffers a catastrophic failure (that is not repaired in time).
  • Fixed Vena missing a hacking animation in Scoria’s Angel missions.
  • Fixed borrowed Railjack using a player's equipped Tactical Mods after a Host Migration.
  • Fixed a case of Excalibur Umbra falling out of the map if they entered the Ramsled while in Transference during Scoria’s Angel missions.
  • Fixed cases of waypoints not appearing for Clients in the "Destroy Captured Ice Blocks" objective in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed Ryoku missing his smoke VFX upon disappearing in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed a lighting issue in The Kuva Wytch.
  • Fixed Sisters using Transmissions that were not context appropriate in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed performance issues caused by Bladeswarm enemies.
  • Fixed a script error related to an enemy ability in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed a crash for Clients at the end of the Ramsled section of the Scoria's Angel mission.

Fixes:

  • Fixed the Base Damage added from the Destreza Incarnon's Evolution I and II not being reflected in the Arsenal stats. (This was a UI-only issue).
  • Fixed toggling "Hide Equipped' in the Mods menu of the Trading screen resulting in the menu resetting to the All tab.
  • Fixed a progression stop in The Old Peace quest if you kill enemies too quickly during a certain segment.
  • Fixed the Glast Gambit quest becoming progression stopped if a specific situation happened while the Warframe was in a special state (ex: Nokko's Reroot, Sevagoth's Shadow, etc.).
  • Fixed sending a Protoframe a birthday message from the 1999 Calendar bringing players to the Hex KIM screen instead of the Protoframe who is celebrating their birthday.
  • Fixed Radiation Barrels spawning in the Corpus Ship tileset following its remaster.
  • Fixed the Obex and Destreza's Incarnon dioramas being too zoomed in.
  • Fixed an infinite mission countdown occurring after using the "Visit Maroo" option in the Ayatan Treasures screen while already in Maroo's Bazaar.
  • Fixed Latrox Une and Jarkar Lar's introductory transmissions not playing in-mission.
  • Fixed the ghostly Drifter disappearing after changing your Drifter's appearance in The New War quest.
  • Fixed players not seeing all newly-unlocked events and nodes until relog after completing the Vor's Prize quest.
  • Fixed offset issues with the Daurus Prime armor set on Voruna's Voidshell skin.
  • Fixed leaking VFX on a Jade idle animation.
  • Fixed a script error related to Mystic Bond.
  • Fixed a script error related to Transference.
  • Fixed a script error related to unmanned Dargyns in the Plains of Eidolon.
  • Fixed a script error related to Nidus' Link.
  • Fixed a script error related to Protea's Dispensary.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Mesa Heirloom: Hotfix 43.0.8
item.description:
Image Description: Towering over the Drifter in the Dry Dock is a Vessel. Pale skin with intricate scar patterns cover this sleeping giant as we see the vastness of space behind.

Our TennoLive 2026 Relay gave players the ability to customize their Vessel as we set sights on Tau. While the Relay is now retired for another year, this hotfix brings Vessel customization for all Tenno!

Additions:

  • Added Vessel customization to all Dry Docks (including those in Dojos). 

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Jade Shadows: Constellations: Hotfix 43.0.6
item.description:
Steel Essence Acquisition in Steel Path Railjack

  • Steel Path Railjack missions now reward 2 Steel Essence upon mission completion.
    • Removed Steel Essence from Eximus drop tables in Steel Path Railjack missions.
    • With the introduction of Steel Path Railjack, we added Steel Essence to Eximus drop tables since Acolytes cannot reliably spawn in Railjack missions. This system unfortunately did not meet our goals: space-only “casual” Railjack missions saw little in terms of Steel Essence acquisition, while savvy players were able to acquire significant amounts of Steel Essence in endless Railjack missions with the right amplified setup. Our aim is to serve all Railjack players, so we’re changing our approach with this hotfix!

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed Sirius & Orion's attacks no longer triggering Jade Stars.
    • Also reduced the SFX of Sirius' Jade Stars.
  • Fixed Combat Discipline not triggering when equipped on Sirius.
  • Fixed Sirius's Coronal Ejection only dealing one Heat Status effect regardless of its modded Status Chance.
  • Fixed the Obex Incarnon "Rapid Conclusion" Evolution treating Mercy and Finisher kills separately, causing stacks to reset from eligible kills.
  • Fixed enemies flying out of the map in Archwing Interception missions, causing players to not be able to complete the mission.
  • Hotdropped: Fixed players receiving an incorrect amount (too low) of Talents at the end of Uranus Proxima missions.

PC Exclusive Changes and Fixes:

  • Improved handling of shader corruption.
  • Improved defenses against drawing with broken shaders.
  • Fixed the launcher's mute button not saving preferences on future game launches.

Fixes:

  • Fixed the Mawbound Director not dealing any damage in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed cases of borrowed Railjacks not being at full health at the start of Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed the Scoria's Angel mission being progression stopped if players enter the Ramsled with a dead squadmate.
  • Fixed Clients rejoining into space if a host migration occurred right after boarding the Scoria Angel in its Uranus Proxima mission.
  • Fixed a script error in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed a script error in the Arsenal.
  • Fixed a script error related to the KIM system.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Update 43: Jade Shadows: Constellations
item.description:
Image Description: Orion’s back is to the viewer with Wrath in hand as he stares down a colossal version of Sirius. Sirius’ aura appears to shake the very space around him as he wields the Pride scythe. 

UPDATE 43: JADE SHADOWS: CONSTELLATIONS 

A new and terrible education awaits on Venus… 

The Jade Shadows: Constellations Quest continues Stalker’s story with an unlikely reality where both outcomes of a past decision are in an endless battle to prevail over the other. Step into this new cinematic Quest as the shadow and put a stop to this eternal conflict.  

Come face to face with Sirius & Orion and their mentors. Orion is guided by Vena, Garuda’s Protoframe, the blood-drenched Wytch. Sirius is mentored by Ryoku, Ash’s Protoframe, the blade swarm assassin. Both sides vying to erase the other in order to secure their future. 

Completing the Quest will unlock access to the Uranus Proxima, where you can play two new Railjack missions: Scoria’s Angel and The Kuva Wytch. Join either Vena or Ryoku with their own Railjack and crew in an epic hunt to take the other down. Completing these missions will reward you with new resources used to trade at a secret vendor in Pontis Tower, a new hub located in Uranus. 

Wield the power of the stars with Sirius & Orion, our 65th Warframe. Two Warframes in one, in a constant duel for supremacy. They bring with them their signature Heavy Scythes, Pride and Wrath, each granting their own Melee buffs for Slam Attacks.

Embrace bloodlust with Vena’s Gemini Skin for Garuda or become a calculated killer with Ryoku’s Gemini Skin for Ash. Each comes with their own Gemini Emote showcasing these rivals' disposition and lethality. 

Vena and Ryoku aren’t the only blade-proficient warriors in this update… Spears are also flying from Styanax Prime! Become the ultimate golden hoplite with Styanax Prime, Afentis Prime, Athodai Prime and his Prime Accessories with Styanax Prime Access. 

The stars aligned and brought you even more to gaze upon in this update, Tenno! Knowledge glides on dark wings with the Dante Tytonis Collection. Railjack missions can now be played on The Steel Path difficulty. The Obex, Destreza, Stug, Ballistica, and Vectis Incarnons are also here. New Warframe Augment Mods for Dante, Nokko, Koumei and Temple have been added to Faction Syndicates. Nidus’ abilities have received a touch up and we’ve packed this update with loads of Quality of Life changes. And so much more to discover! 

Thank you to Sumo Digital for co-developing the Railjack content, as well as the Vena & Ryoku cosmetic items in this update!

 

Spoiler Courtesy

While everyone will find the truth eventually, we ask that you help preserve the mystery for fellow Tenno as they enjoy the update at their own pace. As this is a sequel to Jade Shadows, we also ask to be mindful of spoilers from that quest as well, as some players may be playing it for the first time. Please read our Spoiler Courtesy PSA to learn more about how you can post with best spoiler-free practices!

 

Update 43 is a Mainline Update! 

Meaning that everything the team has been working on since the launch of Update 42: The Shadowgrapher is in this update (with the obvious exception of content that is not ready to be released). It is very likely, as it is with all Mainline updates, that things slip through the cracks so we will be watching for bug reports and feedback in the dedicated Jade Shadows: Constellations subforums to address in follow-up Hotfixes.

If any of the terms above are new to you, visit The Warframe Lexicon for Updates to learn more about Warframe’s development cycle. 

 

Download Sizes:

PC DirectX 11: ~4.87 GB

PC DirectX 12: ~5.76 GB
 

DLSS & FSR Updates

We’ve also updated our DLSS from 3 to 4 and added FSR 3.1 as a replacement to the previous FSR 2.2. FSR 3.1 can also be used with Dx12 AND Dx 11 GPUs! 

With these upgrades you can expect an overall improvement to GPU timings/graphics performance, as well as an improved visual quality compared to the previous versions of these upscalers. 

TABLE OF CONTENTS

We highly encourage you to read the entirety of the Jade Shadows: Constellations patch notes to see everything that’s been wrapped into this update! But if you are looking for something in specific, simply search the following keywords to jump to its dedicated section in the spoilers below: 

  • New Quest: Jade Shadows: Constellations 
  • Uranus Proxima 
    • New Railjack Missions
      • How to Access
      • Gameplay 
      • New Enemies
      • Rewards
      • New Elite Crew For Personal Railjack 
    • New Hub: Pontis Tower
      • How to Access
      • Secret Vendor
      • Visit Ryoku & Vena 
      • Change Primary Warframe: Sirius & Orion
  • Steel Path Railjack Missions 
  • Railjack Changes & Fixes 
  • New Warframe: Sirius & Orion 
  • New Scythes: Pride & Wrath 
  • Styanax Prime Access 
  • New Incarnons Genesis 
  • New Arcanes 
  • New Warframe Augments 
    • New Atragraph Mods: Garuda & Ash Augments
  • Market Additions
    • Constellations Sirius & Orion Bundle
    • Razor’s Edge Salon Pack 
    • Dante Tytonis Collection 
  • Nidus Retouch 
  • Quality of Life Changes 
    • Corpus Ship Relight 
    • Junction Specter Changes
    • New Camera Position Setting
    • Knockdown System Improvements
    • Damage Over Time Preview
    • Other Quality of Life Changes 
  • Additions
  • Changes
  • Performance & Optimizations
  • Fixes 

Image Description: Sirius’ back is to the viewer with Pride in hand and radiating green energy as he floats in space. Towering in front of him is Orion wielding Wrath whose cosmic energy almost appears as though it is burning space and asteroids itself.

NEW QUEST: JADE SHADOWS: CONSTELLATIONS

When a great Sentient summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future, Sirius & Orion, have come calling in this new cinematic quest, and they are not alone. 

Joining them are their mentors: Vena (loyal to Orion) and Ryoku (loyal to Sirius). Each has taken one of the feuding Warframes under their respective wings to find Stalker and ensure the survival of their future over the other.  

Prerequisite: Complete the Jade Shadows quest to unlock the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest in your Codex. 

Quest Duration: The quest will vary from player to player but can take roughly 30-40 minutes to complete. 

Quest Specifics:

  • You will not be able to access other Warframe content until it is complete. 
  • It is worth noting that decisions made in the Jade Shadows quest will be reflected in Jade Shadows: Constellations. But fret not! After completing the Constellations quest, there will be a way to change your decision from the Pontis Tower. More on that in the “New Hub: Pontis Tower” dedicated section. 
  • This quest introduces new Protoframes! Vena (Garuda’s Protoframe) and Ryoku (Ash’s Protoframe). Instead of learning about them from the KIM system, you’ll do so in the new Railjack missions and after recruiting them as crew for your personal Railjack – details on all of that and more available in the “New Railjack Missions” and “New Elite Crew For Personal Railjack” sections. 



Image Description: Screenshot of Orion’s and Sirius’ Swaddle Syandanas both which resemble wings and match the sons’ primary color. On the left is Orion’s who has the Syandana placed on his left shoulder, and on the right is Sirius’ with the Syandana on his right shoulder.

Quest Rewards 

Completing the Quest will reward you with the following (more information in dedicated sections): 

  • Inbox Message Rewards:
    • Sirius & Orion Main Blueprint 
    • Sirius’ Swaddle Syandana 
      • Swaddling cloth of the infant Sirius, worn as a ragged badge of honor.
    • Orion’s Swaddle Syandana
      • Swaddling cloth of the infant Orion, torn in ecstatic fury.
    • New Displays by Eileen Kai Hing Kwan:
      • Orion Alone Display
      • Sirius Alone Display
      • Stay Together Display 
  • Unlocks Uranus Proxima for the following: 
    • Two new Railjack missions:
      • The Kuva Wytch
      • Scoria’s Angel 
    • Pontis Tower (Hub), which grants you access to the following:
      • Access to a secret vendor
      • Ryoku, Vena and their respective Railjacks
        • The new Railjack missions can also be started from Vena and Ryoku’s Railjack Docks in Pontis Tower (more information in the “New Railjack Missions” section) 
  • A new Quest-specific Honoria 
     

URANUS PROXIMA 

Completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations Quest unlocks the Uranus Proxima - where two new Railjack missions and a new hub called the Pontis Tower resides. 
 

Image Description: Vena and Ryoku both stare at us with backdrops of their respective Capital Ship interiors behind them. Vena’s red ship has a spotlight shining overhead while Ryoku’s green ship seems full of smoke.

New Railjack Missions

Pick a side, Tenno. Will you team up with Vena or Ryoku?

Two new Railjack missions are available to play from the Uranus Proxima after you complete the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest: Scoria’s Angel and The Kuva Wytch. Take command of Vena or Ryoku’s fully-equipped Railjacks to aid in their objective of breaking into the other’s Capital Ships and dispatching them. 

Each mission is uniquely tied to aiding either Vena or Ryoku in their skirmishes against one another: 

  • The Kuva Wytch: Skirmish Against Vena. Aid Ryoku with his Railjack and crew. 
  • Scoria’s Angel: Skirmish Against Ryoku. Aid Vena with her Railjack and crew. 

How to Access

You can access the new Railjack missions in the following ways:

1. From Navigation 

  • Enter Navigation and select the Railjack toggle in the top right corner 
  • Select Uranus Proxima 
  • Select The Kuva Wytch or Scoria’s Angel mission node (normal or Steel Path) 
    • More information on Steel Path Railjack in the dedicated section below 

2. From Pontis Tower

  • Enter Navigation and select Uranus (appears in both default and Railjack navigation)
  • Select the Pontis Tower node
  • In Pontis Tower walk or fast travel (from pause menu or quick access wheel) to Vena or Ryoku. The fast travel options are: 
    • Skirmish Against Vena (The Kuva Wytch node) 
    • Skirmish Against Ryoku (Scoria’s Angel node) 
  • Proceed through the portal behind Vena and Ryoku to enter their Railjack Dock 
  • Interact with the console to the right to board their Railjack 
    • If matchmaking is set to Solo prior to entering Pontis Tower, you will also see the option to board your personal Railjack. 
  • Select “Begin Mission” from the Navigation console in the Railjack to start the mission
    • Before beginning the mission, you also have the option to toggle the difficulty between normal and Steel Path. 

Gameplay 

Ally with Vena or Ryoku and embark on a treacherous journey in new Railjack missions that combine the Skirmish and Assassinate gamemodes into one. Each mission begins with a Railjack combat sequence to thwart the opposition Protoframe’s operations and gather intel to board their capital ship. 

Once you’ve breached the ship, you and your ally will fight through hazards, traps and special enemy units to go face to face with their rival in a final epic arena battle. Coming out victorious will complete the mission and reward you for your efforts, including special resources for each mission to purchase goods from a secret vendor in Pontis Tower (more on that in the “Rewards” section). 

Mission Features 

Both missions have the following features:  

  • Difficulty: These missions can be played on Normal or Steel Path difficulty. 
    • We’ve also introduced Steel Path for all Railjack missions! Learn more in the dedicated section. 
  • Matchmaking:
    • Playing With A Squad:  While playing with a squad (premade and public matchmaking),  you use Vena and Ryoku’s special Railjacks, not your own. They are styled to each Protoframe’s aesthetics and come fully equipped with their very own personalized loadouts. 
    • Playing Solo: Follow these steps in order to use your personal Railjack: 
      • Set matchmaking to Solo from your Base of Operations 
      • Open Navigation and select Pontis Tower
      • In Pontis Tower, proceed to the boarding console in Vena/Ryoku’s Railjack Dock 
      • Following the above steps will trigger a secondary boarding option “Board Personal Railjack (Solo)” to appear on the console. Select it to board your personal Railjack.
      • From inside your Railjack, select the “Begin Mission” option from the Navigation console. 
      • Important Notes: 
        • Any changes you wish to make to your personal Railjack before the mission must be done in the Dry Dock. 
        • You must follow the above steps in order to use your personal Railjack. Starting the mission Solo from outside of Pontis Tower will default to Vena/Ryoku’s Railjack. 
  • Crew: 
    • Playing With A Squad: Vena/Ryoku will join you in their respective missions, as well as their own crew if you do not have a full squad. 
      • Like your own crew, each member can be reassigned a role via the Tactical Menu. 
    • Playing Solo: Your own personal crew will be used instead of Vena and Ryoku’s. 
      • Reminder again that any changes you wish to make to your crew must be done from the Dry Dock before loading into Pontis Tower. 
  • Railjack Intrinsics: 
    • Using Vena/Ryoku’s Railjack: Regardless of your personal progress with each Railjack Intrinsics class (Tactical, Piloting, Gunnery, Engineering, Command), when you are playing The Kuva Wytch and Scoria’s Angel missions using Vena/Ryoku’s Railjacks you have access to all the Rank 10 perks.
    • Using Personal Railjack: Your own Railjack Intrinsics ranks are used in these missions. 
      • Intrinsic points can also be earned during Railjack combat. 
  • Archwing Disabled: Since these missions are specifically designed for Railjack and ground combat (once in the capital ships), Archwing is disabled to keep focus on those objectives. 
  • Unlimited Resource Forge: This means that players have unlimited Revolite (for Omni Tool), Ordnance Munitions and Dome Charges. 


 

Scoria’s Angel: Skirmish Against Ryoku  

Vena is out for blood, Ryoku’s to be specific. 

Join her in her Railjack The Marrowbone to sniff out his capital ship by any means necessary, including ramsleeding his ship with blood-infused ice. Locating Ryoku on his home soil means one thing… he and his Bladeswarm units must be taken down! Satisfy Vena’s bloodlust and complete the mission by defeating Ryoku in a final showdown. 

Vena’s Railjack: The Marrowbone

Outfitted for interception and maximum damage, The Marrowbone is as powerful and punishing as the Wytch who commands her. Take flight in this bloody monstrosity and ally with Vena to locate Ryoku and bleed him dry.

It comes pre-equipped with the following:

Plexus Mods (max rank): 

  • Integrated: 
    • Ironclad Matrix 
    • Conic Nozzle
    • Crimson Fugue
    • Forward Artillery 
    • Predator 
    • Cruising Speed 
    • Hyperstrike 
    • Ion Burn 
    • Waveband Disruptor 
  • Tactical:
    • Squad Renew
    • Battle Stations 
    • Flow Burn 
  • Battle:
    • Munitions Vortex
    • Particle Ram 
    • Phoenix Blaze 

Components: 

  • Zetki Shield Array MK III
  • Vidar Engines MK III
  • Lavan Plating MK III
  • Lavan Reactor MK III

Armaments: 

  • Zetki Laith MK III
  • Zetki Pulsar MK III
  • Tycho Seeker MK III

The Marrowbone Crew:

As mentioned above, Vena will join you on the mission, as well as her crew (listed below) who will occupy roles that aren’t filled by squadmates:

  • Slot 1: Corsat Devor 
  • Slot 2: Barnacle
  • Slot 3: Sprigg Khor 


Image Description: Screenshot of Ryoku’s capital ship, a large dark grey vessel of cylindrical design. Green holographic flags adorn the ship which has blue barrel-like attachments both on its underside and on its right-end.
 

Ryoku’s Capital Ship

You won’t only be dodging Ryoku’s blades here, as he’s fortified his warship with many booby traps. A stealth master won’t let you get very far in his own domain. 

Image Description: Screenshot of the interior of Ryoku’s capital ship. Green pools of toxic liquid fill the bottom levels of the ship’s interior and give off a faint haze. In the distance we see a familiar sensor bar meant to detect any intruders.

Within the many laser walls and obstacles a secret room resides. Only those who can embody the quick thinking of an assassin can find their way in to receive the Kyzen Signa – ancient assassin techniques meet future technology.

Image Description: Ryoku poses as if about to punch a foe while wearing the Kyzen Signa aboard his ship. The Signa’s light green energy forms what looks like a scouter or scanner over his right eye.


 

The Kuva Wytch: Skirmish Against Vena

Ryoku is turning the tables, it's Vena’s turn to bleed. 

Join him in his Railjack Santovan’s Oath to take out her operations and put a stop to her for good in her capital ship. Make use of a dangerous weapon Vena has been toying with to break into her ship. Defeat Vena and her Bloodfrenzy units in a final bloody battle to complete the mission. 

Ryoku’s Railjack: Santovan’s Oath

Befitting a master assassin, Santovan's Oath employs cloaking, ranged weapons and regenerative ammunition to strike swiftly with deadly precision. Climb aboard Ryoku's vessel and ally yourself with the Ash Protoframe for the chance to hunt Vena and cut her down to size.

 It comes pre-equipped with the following: 

Plexus Mods (max rank):

  • Integrated:
    • Onslaught Matrix 
    • Ion Burn 
    • Fortifying Fire 
    • Conic Nozzle 
    • Forward Artillery 
    • Predator 
    • Protective Shots
    • Section Density 
    • Cruising Speed
  • Tactical:
    • Intruder Stasis 
    • Death Blossom 
    • Void Cloak 
  • Battle:
    • Blackout Pulse 
    • Tether 
    • Void Hole 

Components: 

  • Lavan Shield Array MK III
  • Vidar Engines MK III
  • Lavan Plating MK III
  • Vidar Reactor MK III 

Armaments: 

  • Zetki Vort MK III
  • Zetki Photor MK III
  • Tycho Seeker MK III 

As mentioned above, Ryoku will join you on the mission, as well as his crew (listed below) who will occupy squad slots that aren’t filled by players:

  • Slot 1: Orphoron 
  • Slot 2: Piliotzi 
  • Slot 3: Domito


 

Image Description: Screenshot of Vena’s capital ship, a large vessel shaped almost like a tuning fork with thrusters at the base. The ship features a mixture of greys, blacks, and reds as its colors. 
 

Vena’s Capital Ship

Crimson pools run through the Wytch’s capital ship, a bloody sight! A lair fit for bloodfrenzied and a potentially deadly end for all those who enter.  

Image Description: Screenshot of the interior of Vena’s capital ship. Sparks fly overhead as a decapitated statue of Parvus Granum stands in the center of the room. At the base of the statue lies red splatter which also is on the face of the statue.
 

Within its bloodspattered walls a treasure is stowed… and only those who have a keen eye can find the way into a secret room to receive the Karotic Signa – A bloodstained gaze washes all in red.

Image Description: Vena models the Karotic Signa, a wide-V shaped mask of flowing blood while aboard her ship. The mask covers her entire face leaving only her lips revealed.
 

New Enemies

Vena and Ryoku aren’t operating alone! You’ll encounter new Railjack and ground enemies to fight off in the hunt to find their commanding officer. They can be scanned for Codex entries to learn about their vulnerabilities and reward drops. 

In The Kuva Wytch, you’ll encounter her Bloodfrenzy units. 

In Scoria’s Angel, you’ll encounter his Bladeswarm units.  

 

 

Rewards 

Completing The Kuva Wytch and Scoria’s Angel missions will reward you with the following:  

Image Description: The Crimson and Emerald Talents are on display with Vena and Ryoku respectively behind them as darkened backgrounds. Text below them indicate that the Crimson Talent is rewarded from Scoria’s Angel and the Emerald Talent from The Kuva Wytch.

Guaranteed: Crimson and Emerald Talent 

Receive the following tokens of Ryoku and Vena’s favor from aiding them in their respective missions. They are used to purchase items from a secret vendor in Pontis Tower (more on that in the dedicated section).

Emerald Talent 

A heavy token from Sirius’ tortured future. Rewarded from The Kuva Wytch mission.

Crimson Talent 

A weighty token from Orion’s broken future. Rewarded from the Scoria’s Angel mission. 

They are earned in the following ways in their respective missions: 

  •  Guaranteed end of mission reward 
    • Normal: 12-16
    • Steel Path: 18-22 
  • Rewarded during travel to capital ship stage (Orowyrm/Ramsled) based on your success shooting the targets 

 

Drop Table Rewards

You will also have a chance at the following drop table rewards per mission: 

  • Scoria’s Angel: 
    • A guaranteed chance at one of the following Blueprints:
      • Sirius & Orion’s Component Blueprints 
      • Wrath’s Main & Component Blueprints 
    • A guaranteed chance at one of the following new Arcanes (details in the “New Arcanes” section):
      • Primary Compression
      • Arcane Sculptor 
      • Secondary Cryogenic 
      • Melee Assimilation
    • During the Ramsled stage you have a chance at the following depending on your targeting success:
      • Railjack Components 
      • Crimson Talents
      • Railjack Resources 
      • Endo
      • Credits 
  • The Kuva Wytch:
    • A guaranteed chance at one of the following Blueprints:
      • Sirius & Orion’s Component Blueprints 
      • Pride’s Main & Component Blueprints
    • A guaranteed chance at one of the following new Arcanes (details in the “New Arcanes” section):
      • Primary Compression
      • Arcane Sculptor 
      • Secondary Cryogenic 
      • Melee Assimilation
    • During the Orowyrm stage you have a chance at the following depending on your targeting success:
      • Railjack Components 
      • Emerald Talents
      • Railjack Resources 
      • Endo
      • Credits 

 For more information on the drop rates, please see our official drop tables.

 

New Elite Crew For Personal Railjack

You can recruit Vena, Ryoku, Latrox Une and Jarka Lar for your personal Railjack from the secret vendor in Pontis Tower using Crimson and Emerald Talents. 

Note: You must have the Rank 10 Command Intrinsic in order to recruit the new Elite Crew Members. 

Each has their own special traits and pre-set competency points. You can assign more competency points in addition to these from the “Configure Railjack” panel in the Dry Dock. 

Vena

STEEL PATH RAILJACK MISSIONS

With the advent of this update, a challenge emerges for Tenno who have fortified their ships and raised a fine crew - Steel Path for Railjack. You may now embark on Steel Path versions of Railjack missions to face more difficult foes. Like Archwing missions, Steel Path Railjack missions have a reduced mission modifier of +50 Enemy Level (instead of +100). Steel Path Railjack will not feature the increased Mod drop chance but all other modifiers on the Steel Path are unchanged. 

That said, the mission difficulty is expanded in other ways, so expect an increased number of Fighters and Crewships to defeat!

Unlocking Railjack Steel Path

If you already have unlocked The Steel Path in the Star Chart, and have completed a Railjack mission in Normal Path then a new option will be presented to you for Steel Path for that Railjack mission.

Railjack Steel Path Trophy

Since each Proxima has a smaller number of nodes than usual planets, Steel Path Railjack has one combined trophy. Complete all Railjack Nodes (this does not include Free Flight, Adversary Confrontations, or Ryoku’s/Vena’s missions) on the Steel Path to earn the trophy and 50 Steel Essence.

Steel Essence

Acolytes cannot spawn in Railjack, so we are adding Eximus enemies to Steel Path Railjack missions exclusively (i.e. they will not spawn on the Normal Path). Eximus enemies in Steel Path Railjack have a chance to drop Steel Essence when defeated as well as Riven Slivers. Since this is our first foray into adding Steel Essence as a drop from normal enemies, we will be closely monitoring acquisition rates when this launches. For more information about our drop rates please see our official drop table.

NEW WARFRAME: SIRIUS & ORION

Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

NOTE: Sirius & Orion are not available in Teshin’s Cave upon launch due to them causing double the trouble in Duviri. Rest assured, we’ll be adding them to the pool of available Warframes in the future once Dominus Thrax learns to handle being outnumbered. 

Swapping Between Sirius and Orion 

Sirius & Orion allow you to swap between two Warframes. Unlike Equinox, who shifts between her Day and Night forms, Sirius & Orion are separate Warframes with their own builds and abilities. Tap to cast your active Warframe’s ability, or Hold to cast the ability of the inactive Son, thereby swapping to him. 

The inactive Son remains on the battlefield, following the Primary Son and attacking enemies in his wake, similar to Wukong’s Celestial Twin or a Specter.

Before we get into their kits, we want to go over how equipment and enhancements are shared between Sirius & Orion so you have a better understanding of how they operate. Please note that this list is not comprehensive, but rather serves as a general overview of their quirks. 

Image Description: Composite image of two screenshots of the Arsenal UI for Sirius & Orion. In the top screenshot we see Orion in the first slot with options to Swap, Upgrade, Appearance, and Abilities. In the bottom screenshot we can see that Sirius occupies the slot below Orion and has all the aforementioned options.

Shared Enhancements and Equipment: 

  • Sirius & Orion use the same Archon Shards
  • Loadout (equipped weapons, companions, etc.)
  • Focus Lens (installable only on Sirius)
  • Mastery Points
  • Helminth Invigorations

Individual Enhancements and Equipment:

  • Warframe Builds, including Mods* and Arcanes
    • * Note: Auras apply to both Sirius & Orion due to their effects being squad-wide. That said, duplicate Auras will not stack when equipped on both Sirius & Orion. 
  • Polarities (including new ones from installed Forma)
  • Helminth Abilities
    • Helminth Abilities can only be Infused on the Primary Son. Even if you swap Primary Sons and infuse an ability on both, the Secondary Son will only have their default abilities available in-mission. 
    • Note: Helminth Abilities with a Hold/Tap mechanic will override the Hold to Swap mechanic of the Ability it was subsumed over. So if you Infuse Eclipse over Orion’s first Ability, you’ll be able to use both the damage reduction and damage buff mechanic of that Ability, but won’t be able to swap to Sirius by holding that First Ability anymore. 

Primary and Secondary Son Mechanic:

When entering a mission, you’ll always do so as the Primary Son — either Sirius or Orion. You can swap between brothers easily in-mission but the Primary Son has access to a few special qualities that the Secondary Son does not:

  • Only the Primary Son can have a Helminth Ability Infused.
    • Even if you swap Primary Sons and infuse an ability on both, the Secondary Son will only have their default abilities available in-mission. 
  • Only the Primary Son can use items from the Gear Wheel.
    • Activating an item from the Gear Wheel as the Secondary Son will forcibly swap you to the Primary Son.
    • This restriction is considered a bug, not a feature — we intend to give the Secondary Son the ability to use Gear with our next Cert cycle.
  • Only the Primary Son will walk around in Hubs and the Base of Operations.
    • Known Issue: Other players will only see Sirius in Hubs even if Orion is selected as the Primary Warframe.

While these restrictions may seem confusing, think of the Secondary Son as an Exalted Warframe (except maybe don’t tell Sirius or Orion that). The team did their best to give players the most agency when swapping between Sons, but there are ultimately limitations on what we could accomplish.

The Primary Son changes depending on your progress with the Jade Shadows storyline:

  • Sirius the default Primary Son if you haven’t completed the Jade Shadows quest*
  • If you have completed the Jade Shadows quest, the chosen name will become the Primary Son 
  • The Primary Son can be changed at any time in the Pontis Tower (after completing Jade Shadows: Constellations)

* Since Sirius is the default Primary Son — and therefore Orion is the default Secondary Son (aka Exalted Warframe) — only one copy of Orion can be owned. Upgrade and Appearance changes to Orion apply to all Orions if multiple Sirius & Orions are owned.  

Sirius & Orion’s Abilities

Passive

Swapping between Sirius and Orion grants 45% Ability Efficiency for the next 2 casts.


When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion steal energy from each other.

First Ability

CORONAL EJECTION (SIRIUS)

Hurl Sirius’ Jade Light infused scythe, dealing Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

GRAVITIC SLASH (ORION)

Repel enemies with Orion’s sinister scythe, dealing Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

Second Ability

JADE STARS (SIRIUS)

Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing Heat Damage and Status Effect. 

ASTRAL SHELL (ORION) 

Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage, the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it’s destroyed.

Jade Stars and Astral Shell are Sirius & Orion’s Helminth Ability. When Subsuming this Warframe, you get access to both Abilities as an option to Infuse in another Warframe (but cannot be used to swap Warframes when Infused).  

Third Ability

LIGHT’S SANCTUARY (SIRIUS)

Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power. 

EVENT HORIZON (ORION)

Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash/Corona Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

Light’s Sanctuary / Event Horizon is Sirius & Orion’s Railjack Ability, depending on which son is Active. 

Fourth Ability: Celestial Clash

Sirius and Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral Blast damage. Match the star’s color to the Warframe’s color to gain increased Critical Chance. The color of the next star will be reflected in your UI, which also corresponds to the input needed to attack — Sirius’ icons appear on the left side, which are triggered by either the Left Click or Left Triggers, and Orion on the right. For those with highly-customized bindings, they are assigned to Primary Attack and Aim Down Sights respectively. 

CONSTELLATION STARS

Constellation Stars start appearing once Celestial Clash is unlocked. Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color/shape* can be added in a row. 

* Sirius’ abilities generate round-base Stars, and Orion’s generate diamond-base Stars. The Constellation HUD will also match the Star color to each Son’s Energy tint channel (default green for Sirius, and red for Orion). 

How to Acquire Sirius & Orion

  • Sirius & Orion’s Main Blueprint is acquired from completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Sirius & Orion’s Component Blueprints can be earned from the Railjack missions in the new Uranus Proxima.
  • Exchange Emerald or Crimson Talents for Sirius & Orion’s Main and Component Blueprints via the Secret Vendor in Pontis Tower on Uranus.
  • Purchase Sirius & Orion from the Market individually or as part of Constellations Sirius & Orion Bundle. Learn more in the “Market Additions” section.
