Image Description: Nidus stares off into the distance with his helmet open while standing among his Ravenous Infestation.

NIDUS RETOUCH

Nidus burst onto the scene in 2016 as the first Warframe to use an alternate cost for Ability casting. While his Mutation Stacks are a cornerstone of his kit, maintaining them has become more and more difficult as Warframe’s gameplay loop has become faster. Our goals with this retouch are to improve his overall rate of Mutation Stack acquisition, and sprinkle in some general quality of life changes as well!

 

Stat Changes:

  • Increased Nidus’ Health from 555 to 675, and Nidus Prime’s Health from 650 to 825.
  • Doubled his innate health regeneration. 

 

Passive

  • Increased the maximum Mutation Stacks from 100 to 200.
  • Improved the Mutation Stack counter’s ability to track rapid Stack growth (as sometimes it would take a while to catch up). 

Abundant Mutation Augment

  •  Increased additional maximum Mutation Stacks from 200 to 300.

 

Ability 1: Virulence

Virulence is often cast over and over to quickly build Mutation Stacks. Our aim with the following changes were to make Virulence more impactful when building Mutation Stacks, while hopefully reducing the need to spam-cast. 

  • Virulence now does damage upon initial hit, and then continues to do damage over time for any enemies touched by Virulence during its duration.
    • This initial damage and the damage over time both contribute towards Mutation Stacks, meaning Virulence won’t have to be spammed to quickly gain Mutation Stacks. 
    • The Energy Refund / Hit still only applies to the initial hit.
  • Virulence’s duration now scales with Ability Duration.
    • Also slightly increased the base Duration of Virulence growths. 
  • Improved Virulence’s ability to move across surfaces of varying heights. 
  • Updated Ability Description to specify damage type (Impact) and clarify Damage done per Mutation Stack. 

Teeming Virulence Augment

  • Increased Primary Weapon Critical Chance from 120% to 150%.

 

Ability 2: Larva

Larva is a crowd control tool that synergizes with Virulence, but it was in need of a slight quality of life lift:

  • Larva’s chance to generate a Mutation Stack now scales with Ability Strength, up to 100% chance.
  • Larva can now be recast, which will remove the previous Larva in the process. 

Larva Burst Augment

  • Now applies one guaranteed Toxin Status Effect for every enemy grabbed.
    • Previously would only apply one Toxin Status Effect to each enemy, but now the number of Effects scales with the number of enemies grabbed.

 

Ability 3: Parasitic Link

The most pressing issue to address with Parasitic Link was its ease of use, especially for controller/mobile players. The goal of these changes is to make Parasitic Link more forgiving to cast and maintain. 

  • Improved the targeting on Parasitic Link, as it would often require too much precision for a fast-moving game.
    • Recasting will also now immediately move the Parasitic Link to the new target.
    • Players can recast Parasitic Link on the same target to refresh duration.
  • Parasitic Link no longer costs Mutation Stacks to cast. It now costs 25 Energy.
  • Added a 3 second grace period before the Link breaks. 
  • Specters and free-moving Companions (like Kavats) can now be targeted. 

Parasitic Vitality Augment

  • Unchanged.

 

Ability 4: Ravenous

Ravenous is a good representation of our technical limitations from 2016 —  and the changes below illustrate how far we’ve come since then. This ability benefits the most in this retouch from our work on other Warframe abilities, namely Uriel, and Vauban’s rework!

  • Ravenous’ radius now scales with Ability Range.
  • Increased Health Regen per second from 20 to 75. 
    • Healing pulses now also cleanse Status Effects. 
  • Maggot improvements:
    • Maggots now trigger Summoner’s Wrath. 
    • Improved Maggot targeting logic and overall speed. 
    • Reduced the Maggot spawn delay.
    • Recasting Ravenous to refresh its duration (while you’re standing on it) will now cause Maggots to explode. 
    • Added damage numbers to Maggots’ attacks. 
  • Fixed newly spawned Maggots not taking Nidus’ updated Mutation Stacks into account for damage scaling.
    • Previously they would use the Stack count when Ravenous was initially cast.

Insatiable Augment

  • Unchanged.

 

QUALITY OF LIFE (QOL) CHANGES

Image Description: Screenshot of the interior of a Corpus ship with a planet visible through a window to the left and a statue of Parvos Granum in the center of the room to the right. Overhead lights create realistic shadows across different areas of the ship and a slight haze can be seen behind the statue.

Corpus Ship Relight

You may have traversed the hallways of Corpus Ships before but you’ve never seen them like this. Corpus Ship levels have been relit with our new GI volume technology, along with a reworked lighting color palette for better pathing and enhanced quality.

With the new GI volume technology, players can expect to experience:

  • New Froxel-based Volumetric Fog which means more realistic and light-reactive fog and god rays within missions.
  • Greater reflection parity for Warframes which results in more accurate reflections on surfaces as you explore the tilesets.
  • Improved visual fidelity for both characters and environments in relit cinematics for the Sisters of Parvos Quest.

Prepare to immerse yourself in our upgraded environments as you squash the Corpus’ means for profit.
 

Image Description: On the left, a Liset flies towards a Junction in space with an azure trail following from its thrusters. A column of energy can be seen throughout the center of the Junction, culminating in a massive energy orb firing a beam out into the distance.

Junction Specter Changes

  • The Venus, Saturn, and Eris Junction bosses have received a refresh — the Volt, Ember, and Mesa Specters have been updated with mechanics from their Prime Vanguard counterparts. 
    • Our goal with this change is to make these fights compelling, while being mindful of difficulty concerns since defeating them is critical for player progression. 
  • Other Specter-specific changes:
    • Halved the damage bonus of the Saryn Specter's Toxic Lash.
    • Valkyr Specter now casts Abilities more consistently.
  • Junction-wide changes:
    • Added Ammo and Energy Pickup generators to all Junction Specter arenas.
    • Standardized damage resistances for Junction Specters to match that of the Primed Vanguard.
    • Removed Shields from Junction Specters, and increased their Health to compensate.

 

Image Description: Screenshot with visual representation of the different positions for the Side and Far Presets. From the Side Preset denoted by a yellow silhouette, Rhino is slightly to the left vs the default position. From the Far Preset denoted by a green silhouette, Rhino is slightly smaller in proportion than the default position and is shifted to the right.

New Camera Position Setting

Added the Camera Position feature to User Interface settings, which allows players to customize their camera offset. This new setting comes with three options:

  • Default: The standard Camera position (what you’re used to with Warframe currently)
  • Side Offset: The Camera is further to the side (this setting also respects your chosen “side” of the screen, if you use the Reverse Camera input)
  • Far Offset: The Camera is further back and higher up, giving you the greatest visibility of the three.

 

Knockdown System Improvements

  • Knockdowns from enemies now use the same animations as the self-stagger system — meaning you’ll no longer be knocked straight on your back from a Grineer Heavy Gunner’s slam.
  • Increased the Knockdown recovery window from 70ms to 433ms.
    • Jumping or rolling during this window will allow you to recover from the knockdown more quickly. 
  • Warframes will now flash briefly if they have successfully recovered from a knockdown.

 

Image Description: Koumei aims at a burning enemy who is afflicted with several statuses. The enemy’s health bar is split into three segments, orange, green, and grey where green represents the new damage over time portion.

Damage Over Time Preview

Damage Over Time (DOT) Status Effects are now reflected by a new “Damage Over Time Preview” indicator on healthbars, showcasing the exact amount of damage they will deal over their duration.

  • This new indicator will display the damage that will be dealt across Health, Shields, and/or Overguard.
  • Damage Over Time that applies lethal damage will result in a black outline around the health bar. 
  • This indicator only applies to DOT from Status Effects, not Abilities that deal damage over time.
    • Ex: Damage from Saryn’s Spores will not be reflected in this new indicator, but damage from the Status Effects dealt by Koumei’s Bunraku will. 
  • Players can change the color of this indicator via the Customize Hud Colors screen in the Accessibility settings. 

 

Other Quality of Life Changes

  • Reworked the level design of the rotating Defense (and Interception variant) tile in Grineer Sealab tileset to improve pathing and overall gameplay flow.
    • The path between objectives is now much clearer, and features easy-to-access ziplines between Defense (or Interception) targets.
    • This reworked tile also features improved lighting and environment art. 
  • Vendors with rotating or purchase limit wares have an updated “Wares Refresh In” description above the ware rotation timer.
    • Previously, the text would say “Time Left to Trade” for all Vendors with a timer, but that was leading to confusion that the store would expire instead. 
  • Introduced a more aggressive Stuck Detection system in Defense, Netracell, and Survival missions to address cases of enemies "idling" outside of active gameplay areas.
  • Added the ability to customize Reticule Enemy Highlight color via the Customize HUD Colors menu in the Accessibility Settings.
    • This allows players to change the tint of the reticule (the current default is red) when an enemy is within its sights.
  • Added drag-to-swap and randomize functionality to individual tint channels in the Appearance tab in the Arsenal.
    • This functionality existed in other appearance screens, but now applies to Warframe and other equipment customization. 
  • Garuda’s Talons Appearance changes:
    • Garuda TennoGen Skins can now be applied to her Prime Talons independent from the equipped skin. 
    • Selecting the “none” option will default her Talons to match the currently equipped skin. 
    • Also fixed Garuda’s Talons playing their open/close animation when customizing colors in Arsenal. 
  • Captura QOL: 
    • Added a “Use original level Post FX” Toggle to Captura settings
      • Toggle on to enable the post VFX from the original gameplay tile instead of the Captura Scene.
    • Added “Spawn At Aim Point” toggle for spawning enemies in Captura. 
      •  Enemies will spawn in facing where your reticle is located. This is enabled by default but can be checked off in the spawn menu. 
  • Removed the randomization on locked/unlocked doors in one the Corpus Outpost objective tiles (ex: Sao, Neptune). 
    • The route to enter this room was randomized based on what doors were open/closed, which also confused the waypoint system and thus the player on how to access it. 
  • Warframes and Companions now will share full affinity for a kill if they dealt damage to the enemy shortly before it was killed by the other party.
    • i.e. if you dealt damage to a Corpus Crewman and then your Kavat killed him a moment later, you would both earn full affinity for that kill.
  • Improve Gas City tile generation to prevent long tiles spawning ahead of the Defense target so players don’t have to run a long distance to get to the objective. 
  • You can now sort by base Parazon mods in the Parazon upgrade screen. 
  • You can now mute the music in the launcher from the speaker icon in the top right corner.

VRAM Utilization Improvements

Historically Warframe was overly conservative with VRAM on Windows and would often leave multiple gigabytes unused on even mid-tier systems. Now, where possible, Warframe will take advantage of unused VRAM on Windows to improve the performance of texture and mesh streaming.

While there shouldn't be much of a difference on arrival, after exploring a mission you are likely to see an increase in VRAM usage (visible either in the in-game FPS display or through some external tool) and in return you might see less micro-stutters due to streaming. This change may also improve stability on older systems with less VRAM to begin with or systems being forced to share VRAM with another program left running.

  • Fixed Clients not triggering alarms from touching the moving lasers in a Lua Spy Vault. 
  • Fixed Facsimiles being immune to Melee damage in Follie’s Hunt. 
  • Fixed Efervon puddles in the H-09 Efervon Tank fight not damaging Clients and Hosts the same way. 
  • Fixed Scaldra Ti-92 APC turrets not targeting players in the Höllvania tileset.
  • Fixed Mesa Prime’s hazard VFX remaining permanently for the rest of The Guilty fight. 
  • Fixed Diploid enemies not performing their melee attacks. 
  • Fixed Ancient Disruptors being able to swat Octavia’s Mallet in the air, preventing enemies from targeting it. 
  • Fixed enemies ignoring Clients in Ascension if the Host is far away. 
  • Fixed Clients seeing a black screen upon returning from a Host Migration if one occurred right after a Technocyte Coda cinematic in the Technocyte Coda Showdown.
  • Fixed missing VFX from the thrown discs that are a part of the Enigma Puzzles in Duviri.
  • Fixed rare case of mission level increasing while idling with the Bounty screen up. 
  • Fixed an occasional function loss when attempting to switch teams in Lunaro if already in a squad prior to matchmaking.
  • Fixed Clients being able to be kicked out of a squad but still load into Bounties in open landscapes.
  • Fixed unintentionally taking damage and dying from a Velocipod after it has been put to sleep through an ability near a slope, ledge, or exocrine. 
  • Fixed a function loss that occurs when trying to mount a Velocipod after putting it to sleep through an ability.
  • Fixed Impact Kuva Liches’ leash attacks knocking Grendel out of the map while in Pulverize form.
  • Fixed Narmer Deacons being counted as enemies in Shrine Defense missions in The Descendia. 
  • Fixed Last Gasp not functioning after a Necramech Floor in Descendia. 
  • Fixed Clients being unable to use Security Bypasses during a Survival mission if they tried to activate one while landing. 
  • Fixed the Tenens XI Phloios challenge not completing for Host if the mission was started via streaming tunnel vs. from Navigation. 
  • Fixed the Capit XIII Sporoi challenge not accounting for the Survival Bypass mechanic, making it difficult to complete. 
  • Fixed Acolyte Malice teleporting players out of bounds in Stage Defense missions. 
  • Fixed various issues related to Kullervo’s teleport in the Confront Kullervo objective in Duviri.

Cosmetic Fixes 

  • Fixed the Revenant Mephisto Skin missing his coat tail spikes.
  • Fixed some attachments not being covered correctly with ink by the Primatura Ephemera. 
  • Fixed cases of VFX missing from Armor and Syandana when combined with certain Ephemeras and other cosmetics. 
  • Fixed Warframe Signa position changing after opening Operator/Drifter Appearance menu. 
  • Fixed offset issues with the Aspirant Syandana on multiple Warframes. 
  • Fixed collision issues with Styanax’s shoulderpads. 
  • Fixed the Operator Atmosphor causing Drifter to end up on the floor after picking up Decree in Duviri while riding Kaithe. 
  • Fixed the Hanteler Prime Syandana not reappearing after it is hidden while aiming down sights. 
  • Fixed Master’s Font statue showing base skin instead of equipped Dex or TennoGen Skins. 
  • Fixed arrow staying attached to bow with Follie’s agile animation set. 
  • Fixed Gyre Prime’s Arcsphere not using her Prime mesh when enhanced. 
  • Fixed Gyre’s Coil Horizon not fully taking tints.
  • Fixed the Triodic Prime Syandana and Kestrel Prime not properly taking energy tints. 
  • Fixed Venari Prime’s prime details not being hidden with the Venari skin equipped. 
  • Fixed Kubrows becoming boneless (i.e. its mesh doesn’t fully load) after entering mission hubs (ex: Cetus) from your Base of Operations. 
  • Fixed Khora Prime’s helmet missing its veil in-mission.
  • Fixed Operator/Drifter using the equipped Warframe’s animation set in Captura after accessing the Operator menu with your Warframe active. 
  • Fixed the offsets of the Syam when sheathed.
  • Fixes towards certain cloth attachments clipping through various Operator/Drifter suits. 
  • Fixed magazines not dropping from Secondaries with Protokol skins equipped while dual-wielded with a Glaive. 
  • Fixed the clear coat on the Archimedean Diadem’s crystal not tinting when changing primary color. 
  • Fixed Clan Sigils overriding Drifter hair color. 
  • Fixed cloth issues on the Lyon Gemini Skin’s skirt.
  • Fixed the Hunhullus Ephemera blocking the pause menu. 
  • Fixed Sigils equipped on the Drifter not appearing in Duviri. 

UI Fixes

  • Fixed cases of minimap waypoint markers bouncing around erratically. 
  • Fixed header overlapping Junction rewards when previewed in the Junction task screen. 
  • Fixed cases where the binding prompt to switch to the next Warframe ability tip is incorrect on controllers. 
  • Fixed being able to select on weapon stats in the Upgrades UI even when they aren’t visible below the search bar. 
  • Fixed picking up Datamass while riding Merulina causing the UI to flicker. 
  • Fixed cases of the end of mission/last mission results screens not showing rewards. 
  • Fixed secondary context actions overlapping over the primary (ex: Dark Refractory’s Perita and Descendia context actions). 
  • Fixed opening Follie’s Shadowgraph wheel right after using the Gear Wheel causing it to pop up again.
  • Fixed UI slider to select multiples reverting to single digits when slid above 1000. 
  • Fixed using the chat settings gear causing overlap with whatever window is open. 
  • Fixed the number on the Void Fissures tab not updating properly when swapping between the Normal Path and Steel Path in the Navigation Screen. 
  • Fixed Tome Mods’ backing escaping containment when swapping between the Tome Mod category and other Mod categories in the Mods Menu.
  • Fixed the channelled ability HUD effect carrying over to the Operator/Drifter HUD after using Transference. 
  • Fixed the Operator/Drifter’s voice changing per appearance configuration. 
    • Now, the chosen voice applies to all Configurations as intended. 
  • Fixed Umbral and Sacrificial Mods not showing their set bonuses when using the Upgrade UI from Navigation.
  • Fixed View Augments button not showing for Vauban while in the Ability menu.
  • Fixed the minimap not following the controlled fired projectile from Ivara’s Navigator ability.
  • Fixed the Relic equip menu from Navigation always displaying as Lith instead of the correlating era listed for the Void Fissure mission. 
  • Fixed incorrectly being able to select a window size that does not correspond to your aspect ratio in the Settings menu.
  • Fixed the “A Halted Excavator Needs A Power Cell” tip sometimes using a Controller input icon instead of the Power Cell icon. 
  • Fixed the Show Base Stats button sometimes overlapping with the 4th ability text in the Arsenal UI.
  • Fixed the Kuva Fortress appearing black and unlit while in Navigation.
  • Fixed Noctua not being counted as a Tome weapon when previewing Tome Skins (resulting in a “this cosmetic is for a weapon you don’t own” tooltip). 
  • Fixed being unable to select the secondary Emissive or Energy channel if the cursor is hovering on the primary channel.
  • Fixed the Helminth Segment Bundle tooltip incorrectly showing both segments as owned in the Market when unowned by the player.
  • Fixed the main Duviri nodes on Navigation not being centered.
  • Fixed Rhino’s Iron Skin Overguard values being different in the chat link window depending on your equipped Warframe.
  • Fixed swapping Customization Slots in the Arsenal breaking the position of the “!” icon.   
  • Fixed the number of remaining imprints saying 2/3 instead of 2/2 after creating a Vulpaphyla.
  • Fixed missing icons for the Copy Suit Colors option in the Operator/Drifter Clothing UI.
  • Fixed various icons not matching the color of the text theme in the Customization UI for Railjack, Atomicycle, and Crew.
  • Fixed the incorrect button callout to Revive after dying in Archwing during a Railjack mission. 
  • Fixed Nora Night appearing extra small when opening the Nightwave menu after viewing an inbox message with a transmission attached. 
  • Fixed a rare case of the Assign Role UI lingering if quickly double-clicking on the selected role for Crew and then exiting that menu.

Quest Fixes

  • Fixed needing to relog in order for the Chains of Harrow quest to properly complete.
    • This was preventing players from receiving the quest complete inbox and being able to begin Quests that require Chains of Harrow to be completed. 
  • Fixed activating and deactivating Hildryn’s Balefire allowing use of Secondary weapons in the Family Reunion stage of The New War Quest (intended to be restricted to the Paracesis). 
  • Fixed freed Ostrons using incorrect animations in The New War quest. 
  • Fixed Techrot Babau being highlighted during The Hex Finale quest cutscenes. 
  • Fixed Landing Craft staying in frame during ending cutscene of The Awakening Quest. 
  • Fixed the hacking minigame in the Awakening Quest mentioning Ciphers despite them not being available to players at this stage. 
  • Fixed some confusing phrasing in Vor’s message to the Grineer Queens in the Vor’s Prize quest complete screen. 
  • Fixed Warframes appearing doubled when viewing the Warframe statues during the Duviri Paradox Quest.
  • Fixed the Features header clipping in the Customization UI when in the Duviri Paradox Quest.
  • Fixed a map hole in a Chains of Harrow quest mission. 
  • Fixed the third investigation spot in the Chains of Harrow quest being hard to see due to the flashlight reflection. 
  • Fixed a redundant waypoint at the start of the Saya’s Vigil quest.
  • Fixed a loss of function in the navigation screen when swapping from The Teacher to the A Man Of Few Words as your Active Quest, and then back to The Teacher.
  • Fixed motion blur being enabled on a decoration in the first stage of The Old Peace Quest. 
  • Fixed being able to escape map boundaries after Void Slinging onto an invisible platform in The War Within quest. 
  • Fixed animation desync issues with the Tomb Protector entering their sarcophagus when affected by Cold Status in the Sands of Inaros quest. 

Level Design & Environment Fixes

  • Fixed the elevator wall being permanently motion blurred in Zariman missions. 
  • Fixed The Golden Cradle Defense target floating in The Descendia.  
  • Fixed the corals on “land” (not submerged) in the Grineer Sealab tileset having blue pollen VFX and emissives. 
  • Fixed issue with a bleeding decal in the Deepmines tileset. 
  • Fixed tables in the Höllvania tileset not being destructible. Commence the table flipping, Tenno. 
  • Fixed a gap in the ceiling of the Orokin Derelict tileset that allowed players to go out of bounds. 
  • Fixed a vertical shaft that doesn’t lead anywhere in one of the Lua puzzle rooms. 
  • Fixed multiple cases of the incorrect materials on Grineer consoles in the Kuva Fortress tileset. 
  • Fixed ending up out of bounds after grappling onto a dropship in the Perita Rebellion. 
  • Fixed tree root clipping through crate in the Grineer Forest tileset.
  • Fixed incomplete and irregular textures at one of the Grineer Outposts in the Plains of Eidolon. 
  • Fixed flickering textures in The King’s Palace area of Duviri. 
  • Fixed crates spawning on top of a water plane in the Grineer Forest tileset. 
  • Fixed texture missing on the floor in the Orokin Derelict tileset. 
  • Fixed crates in the Corpus Outpost tileset being buried in the terrain. 
  • Fixed cases of Survival Bypasses being able to spawn into the ground in the Lua tileset.
  • Fixed material issues on various panels, including Survival Bypass panels, and Co-op doors in the Kuva Fortress.
  • Fixed a large texture seam in the Orb Vallis.
  • Fixed the spikes on top of the Necralisk popping in and out of view in the Cambion Drift depending on player position. 
  • Fixed a flickering texture in the Grineer Sealab tileset. 
  • Fixed unlit Landing Crafts in the Hijack extraction cinematic.
  • Fixed various artifacts with the skybox in the Corpus Outpost tileset. 
  • Fixed the electrical zap from a puzzle in the Albrecht’s Laboratories tileset not appearing for Clients.
  • Fixed the Techrot Matmas getting stuck on a store shutter in an underground tile in the Höllvania tileset. 
  • Fixed a rogue extraction marker remaining on-screen in the Grineer Sealabs tileset. 
  • Fixed pathing issues for Solaris workers in Fortuna.
  • Fixed a rare case on the Zariman where grates appear to float after loading into a mission.
  • Fixed a container in Fortuna having an invisible collision that pushes you unexpectedly when standing on top of it.
  • Fixed an area of The Perita Rebellion map that had a gap allowing players to fall outside of the map.
  • Fixed broken skybox elements and textures in the Corpus Outpost tileset.       
  • Fixed the Arboretum tile incorrectly having loot containers when in Sanctuary Onslaught.
  • Fixed instances where loot crates were floating in the Zariman.
  • Fixed a metal rebar grid at a tunnel entrance on Corpus Ice Planet tilesets having a flickering shadows effect and low resolution.
  • Fixed the terrain in the Corpus Ice Planet tilesets having uneven snow textures.
  • Fixed a small gap in a cave in the Orb Vallis where players could fall out of the map.
  • Fixed some wires clipping through walls and into pipes within the Zariman tileset.
  • Fixed floating decorations after breaking destructible elements in the Marie’s Room Captura Scene. 
  • Fixed broken lighting on several vine clumps in the Orokin Derelict tileset.  
  • Fixed some distracting artifacts in mirror reflections on glass materials. 
  • Fixed several tileset generating issues in the Kuva Fortress and many quests (Whispers in the Walls, Duviri Paradox, Sands of Inaros, The Hex).
  • Fixed the Dog Days and Dog Days Night Scenes being permanently rainy. 

KIM Fixes

  • Fixed unintentionally being loved by both Eleanor and Aoi.
  • Fixed cases where KIM rank and dating status were not aligned such as dating a Protoframe but the rank was reflected as Best Friends or Loved when no longer dating.
  • Fixed Best Friends conversation history with Amir appearing incorrectly after selecting the “Amir, what is this?” dialogue option multiple times. 
  • Fixed players getting the wrong conversation with Roathe after resetting The Devil’s Triad memories and not reloading into one of your Base of Operations. 

Misc. Fixes

  • Fixed multiple issues with Character Highlighting:
    • Uriel’s Gulphagor being affected by enemy highlighting after lunging at an enemy. 
    • Warframe being highlighted after riding Atomicycle/K-Drive even when Self Highlighting is disabled. 
  • Fixed an issue where Garuda's claws could spin like a helicopter when adjusting customization. 
  • Fixed several issues with Razer Chroma only applying a specific preset to the non-prime version of a Warframe. 
  • Fixed Self Highlighting not working for Clients. 
  • Fixed Ally Highlighting not working on Companions for Clients. 
  • Fixed loss of function when backing out of the Shadowgraph screen. 
  • Fixed changing Focus School in Simulacrum activating the new School but retaining the previous one’s abilities. 
  • Fixed the Insign I Sporoi Challenge “Equip an Honoria” completing immediately after exiting the Arsenal if an Honoria is already equipped and not receiving the Insign II Kalika until after returning from a mission. 
  • Fixed Sirocco offset issues when swapping between Drifter to Operator in the Focus School menu while in the Simulacrum. 
  • Fixed entering loading tunnel to return to hub (ex: Cetus) while in Last Gasp causing you to die once loaded after using Transference. 
  • Fixed spamming or holding the Fire Weapon button playing one attack animation instead of the entire attack animation chain on controller. 
  • Fixed the Broadsword Past/Future Sigil missing capitalization on “Future”. 
  • Fixed the Fend-RX Chest Armor missing capitalization in some menus. 
  • Fixed the Malice Acolyte missing textures on their chest armor.  
  • Fixed Drifter pose breaking when customizing Melee weapon in the Dormizone mirror. 
  • Fixed the Grineer Floor Conduit Dojo decoration missing part of its texture. 
  • Fixed being unable to donate the Roathe and Uriel Community Display to the Dojo. 
  • Fixed the Operator borrowing the Drifter’s skeleton in various situations:
    • When recovering from a teleport volume, resulting in them becoming uncomfortably tall for a brief moment. 
    • When accessing the Navigation during a Quest replay that forces players to use the Operator.
  • Fixed the Operator’s teeth lingering too long during the Transference animation. 
  • Fixed Drifter being off-center when in the Customization UI while in the Dormizone.
  • Fixed a brief camera pop when exiting Minerva or Velimir’s wares in the Höllvania Central Mall. 
  • Fixed the squad disbanding in the Relay if the Host invites another player to their Orbiter.
  • Fixed the Scaldra TI-92’s Codex diorama being zoomed in on the turret.
  • Fixed not receiving Nora’s Mix: Time Tempest Creds if you already owned the Naimore Armor Bundle.
    • Players in this state who unlocked Rank 23 prior to Jade Shadows: Constellations should have the missing Nightwave Creds added to their account via script in the coming days. 
  • Fixed Tyro Battalysts missing their arms.
  • Fixed some tabs in the launcher being too zoomed in and not animating. 
  • Fixed being unable to Vanquish Adversary that was generated from Stalker (rare bug that was fixed originating from Belly of the Beast’s “A Shared Purpose?” mode). 
  • Fixed the “Spawn Enemies” option being disabled in some Captura Scenes. 
  • Fixed positioning of the Fibonacci Floof in his market diorama. 
  • Fixed the Platinum’s color being affected by the equipped Warframe’s tertiary tint channel in the Platinum Purchase screen. 
  • Fixed the Archimedean Eye Sumdali creating a blocking volume around Landing Crafts in the Chrysalith. 
  • Fixed the Nightwave Season pop-up appearing on top of The Teacher quest completion inbox. 
    • Now Nora will wait for you to close your inbox before telling you about Nightwave. 
  • Fixed crash-reporter for the launcher on some systems. 
  • Fixed a potential issue with PCs trying to use a PlayStation controller.
  • Fixed the Nightwave Landing Craft causing the camera to clip to Warframe while in Junction.
  • Fixed Nora’s Orbiter Radio music overriding diorama music. 

Localization Fixes

  • Fixed syntax errors for Lith [Exceptional] Relics in Thai. 
  • Fixed some Asian characters not displaying correctly in the Search Clan menu UI and for Clan Ads.
  • Fixed some player’s stats showing as 0 in the UI when language is set to Turkish. 
  • Fixed title case error in the error messages notification when playing in German. 

Crashes & Script Error Fixes 

  • Fixes towards script leak caused by Saryn’s Spores. 
  • Fixes towards script error when returning from Technocyte Coda Showdown mission. 
  • Fixed crash from opening Drifter Intrinsics in Teshin’s Cave. 
  • Fixed crash while idling in the Orbiter. 
  • Fixed several rare crashes that would occur if DirectX 12 failed to initialize.
  • Fixed an ultra-rare crash when running DirectX 12. 
  •  Fixed crash caused by Follie’s Plein Air ability. 
  • Fixed various script errors related to the Confront Kullervo encounter in Duviri.
  • Fixed a script error when a Client loads into a mission with the Hunhullus Ephemera equipped. 
  • Fixed script error when using Follie’s Self Portrait while holding a Coolant Canister. 
  • Fixed script error in Void Armageddon mission. 
  • Fixed a rare script error related to the Stolen Dreams Quest.
  • Fixed a script error caused by closing the game while loading into the backrooms.
  • Fixed a script error caused by logging into the POM-2.
  • Fixed script error in the Sacrifice quest. 
  • Fixed a script error when needing to buy additional Companion slots to then create a Vulpaphyla.
  • Fixed a script error when needing to buy additional Railjack Components & Armaments slots after rushing a repair on a Railjack weapon.

 

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Jade Shadows: Constellations: Hotfix 43.0.5
item.description:
New Addition: MK IV Railjack Turrets
As mentioned in our Steel Path Railjack Reflections post, many Railjack fans have expressed their desire for MK IV Railjack upgrades to incentivize farming Railjack on the Steel Path, and allow them to increase their ship’s power to handle this new difficult content.

With today’s hotfix, this wish is coming true! Steel Path Railjack missions now drop MK IV Railjack Turrets as part of the mission drop tables. These MK IV variants of Railjack Turrets are around 50% more powerful than their MK III versions, and come in every House except Sigma (as this house is Research exclusive). 

Steel Path Railjack drop tables have been adjusted to add these new Turrets —  including the removal of MK I and II Components and Armaments from enemy droptables. Check our drop table site for the full array of changes.

Only Railjack Turrets are getting the MK IV upgrade with this hotfix — we’ll revisit the need for Ordnances and Components in the future. 

Changes:

  • Ryoku and Vena’s Railjacks in Uranus Proxima missions now use the MK IV versions of their Railjack Turrets. 
    • This upgrade to their ships was made following player feedback that they just weren’t feeling as powerful as they should, especially not when playing the Uranus Proxima missions on the Steel Path. Now, they too benefit from the MK IV Turrets being 50% more juiced up than their MK III counterparts.  
  • Increased the Shield Recharge Delay Reduction on the following Railjack Shield Arrays:
    • Lavan MK II: 0.2 to 1.0s (was 0.1 to 0.5s)
    • Lavan MK III: 0.3 to 3.0s (was 0.1 to 1.0s)
    • Vidar MK II: 0.5 to 1.5s (was 0.5 to 1.0s)
    • Vidar MK III: 0.7 to 3.5s (was 0.5 to 2.0s)
    • Note: These changes apply retroactively to existing Shield Arrays, so your Component’s stats should be adjusted accordingly. 
    • Known Issue: Railjack Shield Recharge Delay is being calculated incorrectly in the Configure Railjack screen in the Dry Dock. The values are being subtracted from 3s, instead of the intended 5s. (UI bug only). 
  • Holding Nidus' Parasitic Link will now auto-link to the nearest valid ally in range.
    • Also fixed a bug where Nidus could link to his Sentinel. He can now only link to allies or free moving Companions as intended. 
  • Reduced Ballistica Prime's lens flare intensity when its ghosts die (dying twice has got to suck).
  • Added Community Customizations for Garuda, Sevagoth, and Limbo from Prime Time 481.
  • Improved detection of corrupt shader caches.

Sirius & Orion Changes and Fixes:

  • Increased Sirius' Jade Stars Heat Status Chance from 30% to 100%.
  • Significantly increased the speed at which Jade Stars launch and regenerate.
    • You can see the difference in this before and after video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g8LA8N7R11g 
  • Increased the radius of Orion's Event Horizon from 6m to 8m.
  • Fixed Jade Stars not triggering Arcane Hot Shot.
  • Fixed Orion's Gravitic Slash not reducing shields and armor on enemies with Overguard.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion instantly dying if the inactive Son fell out of the map. 
  • Fixed Celestial Clash becoming very slow after going through Sanctuary Onslaught portals.
  • Fixed being unable to revive in The Index if you died as the Secondary Son. 
  • Fixed Secondary Enervate applying to the inactive Son's weapon, but not resetting when triggered. Now, Secondary Enervate does not apply to the inactive Son.
  • Fixed cases of players being unable to swap the name of their Primary Son.
  • Fixed only the active Son receiving the Uplift buff in Ascension missions.
  • Fixed streaming tunnel doors not closing after returning from open landscape to hub as Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion being counted as two entities when waiting to descend to Inferum 1 at the start of The Descendia.
  • Fixed the inactive Son not spawning during a gameplay segment in The New War.
  • More fixes towards the inactive Son appearing in Cinematics.
  • Fixed a script error related to Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed script error that could occur when Orion's Astral Shell made a decoy holding a coolant canister.

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed Faceoff Squad vs Squad missions failing to start while the Xtra Cheese bonus is active.
  • Fixed multishot affecting the number of ghosts spawned by kills from Ballistica Prime's Incarnon Form, resulting in one enemy being able to spawn multiple ghosts.
  • Fixed Hunhow's Trinket not having 0.5 Riven Disposition that all new weapons receive. 
  • Fixed chatlinked Rifle Riven Mods not showing its specific weapon name and displaying as compatible for all rifles.

Fixes:

  • Fixed explosion kills from the Stug and Vectis' Incarnon Forms not counting towards the "Kill 100 Enemies" challenge.
  • Fixed a certain spoiler character's level and Health HUD appearing in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Fixed the swing trail on Hunhow's Trinket not matching the weapon it is based on. 
    • Also fixed this weapon not having a default secondary Energy tint.
  • Fixed a decision in Jade Shadows not affecting an early cinematic in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Fixed the Thalys missing a swing trail when in Incarnon Form.
  • Fixed a rare progression stop in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed Intrinsics appearing as a white box in Uranus Proxima end of mission screens.
  • Fixed a rare crash that could occur when playing in DirectX 12.
  • Fixed script error caused by Incarnon Evolutions UI.
  • Fixed various script errors related to the KIM system.
  • Fixed a crash related to Excavation objectives in The Descendia.
  • Fixed a script error when exiting out of a Color Palette when customizing tints.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Jade Shadows: Constellations: Hotfix 43.0.4
item.description:
Changes:

  • Restored the Syndir Ephemera's effect applying to Attachments and Syandanas for those with Particle Quality set to Medium or higher.
    • This was removed due to performance concerns in 43.0.2, but we are bringing it back at player request.
  • Reduced the SFX of squadmate Sirius & Orion's attacks in Celestial Clash.
  • Made various polish changes to the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Newly acquired Honoria will now be tagged with the "new" icon (like new equipment in the Arsenal) to help players find them.
  • Added extra support for Camera Position offsets to Hildryn’s Balefire and Gyre’s Rotorswell.
  • Updated the Daurus Prime Armor's tint order to match that of Styanax Prime (swapped the Primary and Tertiary channels).
  • Improved handling of corrupt shader caches on PC when running DirectX 12.

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed Clients not seeing all mission rewards in the End of Mission screen in Uranus Proxima missions.
    • This was a UI-only issue, players were still receiving rewards in their accounts.
  • Fixed Sevagoth and Nokko not receiving the full amount of Emerald or Crimson Talents from Uranus Proxima missions if they extracted while in Shadow or Reroot forms respectively.
    • Also protected against other cases of Clients not receiving full Talents due to End of Mission timing. We are aware of complaints related to Sirius & Orion specifically, and we hope this will address their issues, but we'll continue to watch for reports! 
  • Fixed being able to enter Last Gasp immediately after failing to revive yourself with it, which often led to loss of function or crashing.
    • Also fixed Sirius & Orion being able to enter Transference after failing Last Gasp, resulting in an invisible unkillable Operator/Drifter that is unable to abort the mission. 
  • Fixed the Neo V12 Relic having the Akbronco Prime Blueprint listed twice in its common rewards. The duplicate reward has been replaced with the Paris Prime Blueprint.
  • Fixed Arcane Bellicose causing Nidus's Parasitic Vitality buff to be permanent for allies.
  • Fixed the following Clan Research components dropping from Uranus Proxima missions, resulting in error messages when players attempted to repair them via the Salvage menus:
    • Tycho Seeker MK III
    • Milati MK III
    • Galvarc MK III
    • Note: Players who incorrectly received these Ordnances via mission droptables have had them replaced with other Salvage from the droptables via an account update with this hotfix. 
  • Fixed The Roundtable Protoframes' KIM ranks being changed to "Associate" if you were Best Friends before Jade Shadows: Constellations. Your ranks have been reverted to pre-update values!
  • Fixed Client Sevagoth and Inaros being able to be locked out of the boss arena if they get dragged into it in their special death states in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed cases of Sirius & Orion not being eligible for Relic Rewards despite having 10 Reactant.
  • Fixed various Line of Sight (LOS) issues with Sirius & Orion's Celestial Clash:
    • Fixed LOS checks being done on enemies within 5m of Sirius & Orion — usually LOS abilities do not perform checks on foes within that range to avoid Warframes inadvertently blocking their own attacks.
    • Fixed swapping between the Sons sometimes causing attacks to use non-player LOS checks (instead of the improved LOS system), resulting in foes often getting missed.
      • This helps address the common issue of enemies in Orion's Event Horizon not being hit by Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed the Courier vehicle flying out of mission bounds in Archwing Pursuit missions, causing players to fail the mission.

Incarnon Changes & Fixes

  • Improved performance issues caused by Ballistica Prime's ghosts.
    • Known Issue: Ballistica Prime’s ghost mechanic is being affected by multishot while in Incarnon Form, resulting in players spawning more than one ghost per enemy, often rivalling the King of the Dead’s army. While fun, these Ghosts are often useless and can block player vision, so we are looking to fix this issue in a future hotfix.  
  • Increased the Vectis Incarnon "Lone Enforcer" Evolution's stats as follows:
    • Increased Base Damage from +50 to +75 (+100 to +150 for Vectis Prime).
    • Increased Multishot from 20% to 25%.
  • Increased the Vectis Incarnon form's projectile speed from 200 to 300.
  • Fixed the Destreza Incarnon Evolution III challenge tracking progress off of any Incarnon (instead of just the Destreza).
  • Fixed the Obex Incarnon Evolution I giving 8000% Finisher damage instead of the intended 80%.
  • Fixed Obex's Incarnon Evolution II and III challenges earning progress off of kills with any weapon.
  • Fixed the Stug's Incarnon form being able to hit enemies through Limbo's Rift.
  • Fixed cases of Incarnons not displaying full information when previewed at Cavalero.

Uranus Proxima Changes & Fixes

  • Various "waiting for players" objectives in Uranus Proxima missions will now trigger a teleport timer if half of the squad is waiting at the objective.
  • Improved performance issues in Uranus Proxima missions caused by various enemy VFX.
  • Fixed the "Defeat the Ship's Captain" objective never completing if the Captain was killed while a player was downed in the Scoria's Angel mission.
  • Fixed cases of not enough Guards spawning in The Kuva Wytch mission, resulting in a progression stop.
  • Fixes towards players getting stuck under the Scoria's Angel after being pushed out by one of Ryoku's traps.
  • Fixed a Host Migration during the Orowyrm section of The Kuva Wytch mission causing returning players to be progression stopped.
  • Fixed the Comet Shredder Captain's waypoint sometimes not disappearing when they die.
  • Fixed flickering decals on the walls of Vena's ship in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed buzzing SFX when charging up Forward Artillery rapidly in The Kuva Wytch missions.
  • Fixed performance issues in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed a script error when transitioning between ships in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed a script error in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed a crash during Vena's boss fight in The Kuva Wytch missions.

Sirius & Orion Fixes

  • Fixed Sirius & Orion not receiving Research Points in Archimedea if Orion is the Primary Son.
  • Fixed swapping between Sirius & Orion in a Mastery Rank test causing the test to immediately fail.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son being able to bypass respawn restrictions.
  • Fixed Blessings not applying to both Sons when using Sirius & Orion in The Descendia.
  • Fixed the Inactive Son consuming ammo if a Heavy Weapon is equipped by the Active Son.
  • Fixed cases of Orion losing context actions if a Heavy Weapon is equipped in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed the Hold Sprint setting not being respected when swapping between Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son not spawning during a fight segment in The New War quest.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son being invisible during certain segments of The New War quest.
  • Fixed the Secondary Son running around during a cinematic in The War Within quest.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion's Prex card appearing low resolution.
  • Fixed various script errors related to Sirius & Orion's Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed a script error related to Sirius' Coronal Ejection.

Fixes

  • Fixed "Hunhow's Trinket" missing swing trail VFX (if you know you know).
  • Fixed being able to acquire the Neo V11 Relic via Relic Packs (despite it being vaulted in 43.0.2).
  • Fixed casting Follie's Shadowgraph resulting in D-Pad icons appearing over her ability icons.
  • Fixed cases of players getting stuck on the same login day if they selected a Credits reward.
    • This was patched live on Friday, but we are calling out in patch notes for those who were in this state. 
  • Fixed the Dread and Paris Prime missing weapon stats in the Arsenal if installed with an Incarnon Genesis.
  • Fixed various issues with Stug's stats in the Upgrade Screen:
    • Critical Chance, Radial Status Chance, and Status Chance always displaying as 0%.
    • Blob Embed Damage causing Elemental Damage to appear twice for Quick Shot stats.
  • Fixed Stalker being able to roll out of a cinematic in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Fixed "Primary Son" terminology making it into the name selection screen in the Jade Shadows quest.
  • Fixed the Drifter's right arm turning invisible during the Ryoku and Vena Gemini Emotes.
  • Fixed low SFX from the music puzzle on Lua.
  • Fixed Jade's default emissive tint being unintentionally changed to blue.
  • Fixed being unable to spawn the Exo Gokstad Officer in the Simulacrum.
  • Fixed the Bladeswarm and Bloodfrenzy Domestik Drones having incorrect pathing behaviours in the Dojo.
  • Fixed a crash caused by Arcane Compression.
  • Fixed an issue related to the Anarch Capsarii's shield drone ability.
  • Fixed various script errors related to Xaku's The Vast Untime.
  • Fixed a possible crash in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Fixed a script error related to Whispers in Albrecht's Laboratories missions.
  • Fixed a script error related to Nidus' Link.
  • Fixed a script error caused by enemy Maggots' latching ability.
  • Fixed a crash when looking through KIM Conversation History.
  • Fixed a random crash.
  • Fixed a rare crash that could occur when using DirectX12.
  • Fixed a rare crash on the End of Mission screen.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Jade Shadows: Constellations: Hotfix 43.0.3
item.description:
Happy Friday, Tenno! A rare hotfix sight from us, but we wanted to address some of the more egregious issues before the weekend. 

We’ll continue to investigate and do our best to address the top priorities in our Known Issues List next week. Thanks again for your patience as we continue to work towards stability. 

Fixes

  • Fixes towards players receiving the same Blueprint rewards upon subsequent Uranus Proxima missions.
    • This is our hail mary attempt at a fix for the weekend, there may still be some related issues but we’ll be watching closely for follow up next week. 
  • Fixed Mission Failed Screens appearing at the end of Uranus Proxima missions after aborting a mission and then replaying it again. 
    • As shared in our original PSA, this was a UI only issue and players were still receiving their rewards. But we wanted to get this fix out before the weekend as it was understandably deceiving! 
  • Fixed Personal Railjacks in Uranus Proxima missions using the "loaner" version's Armaments and Crew.
    • Known Issue: Ryoku or Vena's crew names appear in the Squad List, but the actual Crew are your own.
  • Fixed additional issues caused by Sirius & Orion when passing through Sanctuary Onslaught portals.
  • Fixed rare case of being unable to purchase and/or claim new skins (Nightwave rewards). 
    • Players who were in this state should now be able to purchase/receive skins once again. 
  • Fixed SFX being far too loud for those using 7.1 headsets.
  • Fixed filepaths appearing in Protoframe Crew member subtitles.
  • Fixed a crash that could happen if you had Arthur in your Backroom.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread:  https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Jade Shadows: Constellations: Hotfix 43.0.1
item.description:
A Note About Build Stability!
Jade Shadows: Constellations is an ambitious update on many fronts: our most complicated Warframe, earned from a complicated mission type. The release wasn’t to our usual standards, and we want to thank you all for your patience and understanding as we work to improve it.

As a result, the team is working on a script to give additional Crimson and Emerald Talents to our Day 1 “early adopter” Tenno who weathered the Railjack turbulence with us. Details to come on that tomorrow! 

Expect more hotfixes to come! In the meantime, we hope you enjoy all the goodness that shipped with Jade Shadows: Constellations. 

Speaking of goodness: you may have heard that additional Garuda lore was released with Jade Shadows: Constellations. It is true! But you may have been looking in the wrong spot. We advise you to move your searches to Pontis Tower on Uranus, for there you shall find what you seek about our murderous maiden. 

Changes:

  • Increased the Stug's Blob Embed Status Chance to 10%.

Top Fixes: 

  • Fixed Clients being forced into Archwing and losing function during a transition in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed not being extracted properly from Uranus Proxima missions.
    • Now, you should be returned to your Base of Operations or the Pontis Tower upon mission completion.
  • Fixed loss of function for Sirius and Orion Fixed after installing a Forma or swapping polarities.
  • Also fixed this visually duplicating Warframes in the Arsenal. 
  • Fixed Clients stuck in an infinite loading screen when joining a Uranus Proxima mission from the Base of Operations, while the Host is in the Pontis Tower.
  • Fixed a case of becoming permanently invincible as Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed a crash when entering the Personal Quarters in a specific segment of the Jade Shadows quest

Uranus Proxima Fixes:

  • Fixed Ryoku's shadow clones looking black on low settings.
  • Fixed various flickering environment elements in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed ship names in Uranus Proxima missions using the Host's language.
  • Fixed being able to sell a special trinket.
    • If you sold the trinket in question before this hotfix, please contact support to have it returned to you!
  • Fixed transmissions and SFX incorrectly playing during a lockdown segment in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed an incorrect spawn position in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
  • Fixed a Ramsled in the new Uranus Proxima missions displaying a filepath instead of their name.
  • Fixed being able to access a certain character's ability screen in the Jade Shadows: Constellations Quest.
  • Fixed script errors related to Ramsleds and Ryoku's shadow clones in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.

Fixes:

  • Fixed overlapping UI issues when dragging tints to swap them in the Arsenal.
  • Fixed an SFX issue with the Afentis Prime.
  • Fixed placeholder text in the Customize Hud Colors screen.
  • Fixed a script error when transitioning between stages in Sanctuary Onslaught.
  • Fixed a script error in Last Gasp.
  • Fixed a script error related to Nidus' Link.
  • Fixed a script error related to loadouts.
  • Fixed a script error related to the new dragging tints mechanic in the Arsenal.
  • Fixed a script error related to Nokko.
  • Fixed various script errors related to Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed a crash related to Secondary Enervate and Secondary Irradiate.
  • Fixed a rare launcher crash.
  • Fixed a crash.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Jade Shadows: Constellations: Hotfix 43.0.2
item.description:
Future Hotfix Priorities
This is our second hotfix following Jade Shadows: Constellations’ release, and it’s a chunky one at that. While we have been able to tackle quite a few issues in these first few patches, we’re not done yet!

We’re continuing to investigate issues and do our best to ensure overall build stability. The top of our current priority list includes end of mission UI bugs (mission failed or missing rewards) and progression stops, and more. As a reminder, we have a public Known Issues List that tracks priorities on our radar. 

Thank you again for sticking with us, for sending us your bug reports and feedback, and for weathering the proverbial storm, Tenno!

Scripts
Two scripts were run today, each offering goodies to different groups of players. 

Jade Shadows: Constellations Early Adopters Script 
As a thank you (and apology) to those who weathered the storm on Day 1, 100 Crimson Talents and 100 Emerald Talents are being delivered via Inbox to anyone who completed the Jade Shadows: Constellations Quest within the window of June 17th at 11 a.m. ET - June 18th at 12 a.m. ET. This script is still in progress, and we will update the official PSA when it has concluded. 

Nora’s Mix Time Tempests Cred Script
Players who already owned the Naimore Armor Bundle prior to this recent Nightwave Series did not receive 50 Nora’s Mix Time Tempest Creds — a script was run earlier today, and the missing Creds have been added to their accounts!

We fixed this issue with Jade Shadows: Constellations, so future players will not come across it. 

Changes

  • Players now auto-extract after completing The Kuva Wytch and Scoria's Angel missions.
    • This prevents cases of players being stuck in limbo when other squadmates do not move towards the extraction point.
    • Known Issue: Auto-extracting results in Hosts only seeing Credits in their End of Mission screen — this is a UI-issue only!
  • Added the Neo V12 Relic to droptables.
    • This is a replacement to the Neo V11 Relic, which is now vaulted as it contains the Epitaph Prime Barrel. 

Top Fixes

  • Fixed cases of not enough Golden Maws spawning in The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion being able to scale Ability Strength infinitely via an interaction with Diriga.
  • Fixed Sirius & Orion being able to use Gear via Hotkeys in Sanctuary Onslaught.
  • Fixed allied Maggots standing around and not attacking anything (except for those spawned by Nidus).
  • Fixed Drifter facial animation issues when using the Vena and Ryoku Gemini Emotes.
    • Known Issue: the Drifter's right arm now turns invisible when using these Emotes. Fixing nightmare fuel apparently comes with a cost.
  • Fixed Last Gasp teleporting players outside of the boss room in the Scoria's Angel mission.
  • Fixed Railjack Crew sometimes not firing their weapons when assigned as Defender.
  • Fixed Companions affected by Nidus' Parasitic Link permanently sleeping after entering a Nullifier Bubble.
  • Fixed players becoming progression stopped during a section of The New War quest if they started the quest with Sirius & Orion as their equipped Warframe.

Sirius & Orion Fixes

  • Fixed a loss of function when attempting to install a Helminth Invigoration on Orion and then attempting to view that Invigoration in the Helminth Chair.
  • Folks in this state should have their accounts fixed upon login.
  • Fixed loss of function when passing through an Elite Sanctuary Onslaught portal as the Secondary Son while playing Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed being unable to progress in The Teacher quest after installing Vitality on Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed high latency causing Sirius & Orion to be yeeted when dodging during Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed cases of the Primary Son not being teleported between Infernums when using Sirius & Orion in The Descendia missions.
  • Fixed a loss of function when triggering a cutscene as the Secondary Son for Sirius & Orion in The War Within quest.
  • Fixed the inactive Son being partially invisible during gameplay in The New War quest.
  • Fixed various issues with SFX from Sirius & Orion's Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed a script error when casting Subsumed abilities as Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed various script errors related to Sirius & Orion's Celestial Clash.
  • Fixed a script error related to Sentinels when equipped on Sirius & Orion.
  • Fixed a script error when swapping to Sirius & Orion in the Arsenal.

Uranus Proxima Fixes

  • Fixed cases of extra loud SFX in Uranus Proxima missions.
  • Fixed an edge-case of players being able to enter Archwing in Uranus Proxima missions if they joined a mission in progress that was started from the Pontis Tower.
  • Fixed cases of ship names in Uranus Proxima missions using the host's language.
  • Fixed a script error when attempting to open the Railjack Tactical Screen immediately upon loading into a mission.

Jade Shadows: Constellations Quest Fixes

  • Fixed being able to jump over a waypoint and skip a cinematic.
  • Fixed in-game chat channels remaining disabled until relog after completing the quest.
  • Fixed the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest incorrectly listing The New War as a prerequisite.
  • Technically correct, but confusing nonetheless. It now properly lists Jade Shadows as a requirement!
  • Fixed some lighting issues in the first stage of the quest.
  • Fixed a voiceline from Vena in the quest.
  • Fixed ingredients exploding when adding them to the pot in a segment of the quest.
    • Also fixed and polished various issues that could occur during this segment.
  • Fixed a script error in the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.

Performance Fixes and Improvements

  • Improved performance issues caused by the Syndir Ephemera.
  • Improved handling of corrupt files, in particular, when the file system itself is corrupt.
  • Improved stability of the launcher and addressed some rare launcher crashes.
  • Fixed some weapons causing performance issues when shooting the collected asteroid in The Kuva Wytch.
  • Fixed severe hitching during The Kuva Wytch mission.
  • Fixed leaking VFX from the Ryoku Gemini Emote.
  • Fixed spotloading SFX causing hitching for Clients in Uranus Proxima missions.

Other Fixes

  • Fixed Pontis Tower fast travel options appearing in other Hubs.
  • Fixed being unable to chatlink Emerald Talents, Crimson Talents, and Amir's Hairstyle.
  • Fixed the Prime Details toggle not working on Styanax Prime with the Styanax Raevus Skin equipped.
  • Fixed the Garuda Talons customization screen having a "Syandanas" option.
    • Also fixed the Garuda and Garuda Prime Talons customization screen missing a “None" option for skins, which returns it to its defaults.
  • Fixed various offset issues on the Vena Gemini Skin.
  • Fixed Voruna's ability SFX playing twice for clients.
  • Fixed login music overlapping with market diorama music when viewing items from the Update Screen.
  • Fixed the Bladeswarm and Bloodfrenzy Domestik Drones not moving when placed in the Dojo.
  • Fixed offset issues in the Styanax Prime market diorama.
  • Fixed a crash in the Break Narmer Sneaky Sabotage mission.
  • Fixed a rare crash related to video textures from screens (like those in the Backrooms).
    • Also fixed minor visual bugs related to those screens.
  • Fixed a script error for Clients when deactivating Odonata's Energy Shell.
  • Fixed a script error related to stealth finishers.
  • Fixed a script error when exiting the Sol's Fury aura in The Descendia missions.
  • Fixed a script error related to the "Drag to Swap Tint Channels" mechanic in the Arsenal.
  • Fixed a script error related to Articulas.
  • Fixed a script error related to Nidus' Link.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1509550-known-issues-jade-shadows-constellations/

item.title: Update 42: The Shadowgrapher
item.description:
Image Description: Follie emerges from a massive painting known as a Shadowgraph holding two ink covered balloons. Thick black ink covers the Shadowgraph’s frame as tendrils of ink extend in all directions behind it and two additional ink covered balloons float on either side.

UPDATE 42: THE SHADOWGRAPHER

A mysterious painting casts a shadow over the Origin System from the ruins of the Vesper Relay, beckoning you to reveal its secrets. Return to Venus and enter a canvas of chaos, where a tragic history long lost to the shadows is waiting to be illuminated.  

Paint the Relay inky black in Follie’s Hunt, our new game mode! Aspirant Zorba is seeking help finding what happened to his mentor and urges you to seek the truth in the wreckage that is the Vesper Relay. Enter if you dare, and gather paint to complete the scattered canvases throughout. Avoid inky enemies and diabolical traps while being hunted by the devious Follie. Operation: Atramentum will also take place on the Vesper Relay starting April 2nd! 

Our 64th Warframe Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher is here! Bring ink to life with her abilities and customize her Shadowgraph art using her sketchbook. Get her signature beam rifle, the Enkaus, to instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are low health. 

Completing Follie’s Hunt missions will reward you with a new resource, Atramentum, which can be traded for rewards offered by Aspirant Zorba. Zorba can be accessed from any Relay to gain access to Follie and Enkaus’ Blueprints, Chromatic Atramentum (used to create Atragraph Mods, a new cosmetic for Mods) and so much more — but he’ll only appear once you’ve completed The Chains of Harrow quest! 

Slam down on the accelerator and let that maw howl with the new Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis Collections! Get it all in the Eat & Run Collection, featuring their deluxe skins, Syandanas, Signas, Emotes and more. 

Unleash mayhem with three new Adversary Weapons! The Kuva Ghoulsaw, Tenet Quanta and Coda Bubonico are here and can be acquired through their respective Adversaries. Now we’re sure you’re wondering... and yes your Kuva Lich can ride on the Kuva Ghoulsaw. But they will do so as a charge attack, so watch your ankles!

This update’s canvas is saturated with many Quality of Life strokes! Including our new Clan cooperation system which rewards you and your clan mates for playing together through weekly initiatives. Speed up Survival missions with the new Security Bypass pickups and enjoy more resilient Excavators in Excavation missions. We’ve also reduced the grind for many Warframes and weapons that are over 5 years old to make their acquisition a much smoother process. And so much more! Read our Quality of Life Changes section for the full list. 

But that’s not all! You might want to put down some drop cloths to catch all the new goods dripping from the walls. The Awakening Quest has received a top to bottom visual remaster, which has been coupled with flow and tutorial changes to improve the new player experience. Palladino’s Wares have been expanded to include Riven Ciphers, Riven Transmuters, Requiem Ultimatum and more! TennoGen Shadowgrapher brings new community artist creations featuring Styanax and Nova Skins and the first ever TennoGen-created Signas. We’ve added even more Operator and Drifter faces, eyebrows and complexions! Source your next title with a plethora of new Honoria, including Warframe-themed ones. There are also several more pages dedicated to changes and fixes! 

We hope you enjoy all that The Shadowgrapher has to offer! Thank you, Tenno. 

 

Update 42 is a Mainline Update! 

Meaning that everything the team has been working on since the launch of Update 41: The Old Peace is in this update (with the obvious exception of content that is not ready to be released). It is very likely, as it is with all Mainline updates, that things slip through the cracks so we will be watching for bug reports and feedback in the dedicated Shadowgrapher subforums to address in follow-up Hotfixes.

If any of the terms above are new to you, visit The Warframe Lexicon for Updates to learn more about Warframe’s development cycle.

 

Download Sizes:

PC DirectX 11: ~2.39 GB

PC DirectX 12: ~3.04 GB*

*Note on DirectX12 optimizations (expand spoiler):

Spoiler

This update includes substantial optimizations to the DirectX 12 shader cache and VRAM usage. On large levels we saw over a 100MB reduction in total allocations, so when streaming large textures like GI lighting volumes this may reduce small hitches. If you have DirectX 12 enabled in the launcher it will likely offer to optimize your install to save 1GB or more. If you do not have DirectX 12 enabled but would like to try it out, click the cog icon in the launcher and select it from the Graphics API dropdown.

Epic Games Store Account Binding

With the launch of this update all Epic Games Store accounts must be bound to a Warframe account. As we mentioned in our PSA, we will no longer be supporting logging in via email address and password on the Epic Games Store client. Instead, once you have bound your accounts, you will be automatically logged into Warframe when you start it from the Epic Games Store client. For detailed instructions on how to bind your account please refer to our step-by-step guide.

 

Image Description: Three Warframes prepare to investigate the Shadowgraph. Excalibur stands closest to the painting while flanked from behind by Volt and Mag who are ready for action.

NEW GAME MODE: FOLLIE’S HUNT

Look at the blood. Look at the ink. Watch it drip, drip. 

Something… no, someone haunts the ruins of the Vesper Relay. Come face-to-face with Follie, the Shadowgrapher, and complete her Shadowgraphs to uncover the Truth. 

Orbiting around Venus, the Vesper Relay was fully accessible until 2014, when it was destroyed by Councilor Vay Hek and his Balor Fomorian battleships during Operation: Eyes of Blight. While veteran Tenno may recall visiting this locale all those years ago, its now-ruined interior looks considerably different and harbors a shadowy menace…

Image Description: Screenshot of the wrecked Vesper Relay with a Liset docked to the right of the image. Against the rusted ruins of the Relay, a Shadowgraph emits a pale haunting purple light. 

Prerequisite

Complete the Chains of Harrow Quest 

Visit our Quest Guide to help you along your journey to unlocking the Chains of Harrow. 

How to Access 

Once you’ve completed the Chains of Harrow Quest, a new playable node on the Vesper Relay will appear on Venus for you to play Follie’s Hunt. 

Gameplay

In this new game mode, you’ll be seeking Paint to complete various Shadowgraphs (canvases) — and become hunted by Follie as you progress. 

The goal is to complete three Shadowgraphs in order to extract safely with rewards, here’s how: 

 

1 - Find Shadowgraphs 

Upon arriving in the Vesper Relay, enter the Shadowgraph Portal to be taken inside this desolate ink coated nightmare. 

Image Description: Closeup of the Shadowgraph portal in the Vesper Relay. A massive ink covered canvas with an ominous design radiates a soft purple light.

Find the three Shadowgraphs scattered throughout the map, which will be marked A, B, and C once found. 

Image Description: A pristine blank Shadowgraph with a golden frame stands in the center of a dimly lit room in stark contrast to walls covered by large black tendrils of ink. 

The Vesper Relay also has two floors which you can access via the “elevators” located in the main hall. 

Image Description: Two elevators within the ruined Vesper Relay emit energy indicating that they will transport you between the two floors, while a set of inked footprints leading towards the hallway in the center.
 

2 - Find Paint pools 

As you explore, you’ll come across pools of Paint. They have a distinct chime and will be marked with a special icon when entering their vicinity.  

Image Description: Through an archway a large bubbling pool of dark purple paint rises from a golden saucer. In the foreground to the left is an unknown structure covered in thick hardened black ink.

Approaching a pool will force you into your Operator or Drifter and douse you in Paint so that it can be delivered to a Shadowgraph. However, the Paint has a strange effect on Void abilities and disables Void Sling and Transference while you are coated in it. 

Killing enemies has a chance to spawn yellow trailing waypoints, which will lead you to more pools of Paint!

Image Description: Screenshot of the paint trailing mechanic. It is composed of three elements: a gaseous orb of light leading to the paint, a solid light trail beneath it that also charts the path, and a small yellow droplet icon with 11m to indicate the distance from the paint pool. 

 

3 - Deliver Paint to Shadowgraph 

Be prepared to fend off hordes of ink-covered enemies in your wake and flee from Follie as you attempt to deliver the Paint to Shadowgraphs. Getting downed while carrying Paint will clear it from you, so stay nimble, clear dangerous inky hazards and avoid Follie at all cost! 

Standing near a Shadowgraph will automatically draw the paint off of your Operator/Drifter and onto the canvas. The amount of paint required to complete a Shadowgraph increases based on how many numbers of players are in the squad. 

 

4 - Repeat until all Shadowgraphs are completed! 

Progress to completing Shadowgraphs is tracked in the special HUD gauge, each time Paint is delivered, the gauge will fill up. Complete all three Shadowgraphs to extract and be rewarded for withstanding the inky horrors that crawl within the Vesper Relay. 

 

Follie Hunts

Delivering Paint to Shadowgraphs will awaken Follie, an invincible foe who stalks you as you work towards your escape. An aura emanates around her, dealing damage and sapping Energy from any who dare stay near. She can also cast her Abilities and spawn Shadowgraphs including Death Orbs. 

Image Description: Follie taking a step towards us within her domain of the Vesper Relay. All around her is a red aura of energy that refracts as it covers the ink structures behind her.

As the mission progresses, Follie will up the ante with various ink-infused aberrations and modifiers to stop you in your tracks. 

  • Polyopia: Additional Follies spawn throughout the Relay. These clones can cast her Abilities, but are killable!
  • Sticky Ink: Tentacles reach out of ink structures and puddles to deal damage and slow players.
  • Splattering Touch: Enemies will instantly explode to deal damage when contacted by players.
  • Drip, Drip, Drip: Large walls of ink create permanent barriers that change the layout of the level.
  • Gigantism: The enemies increase in size and health. Their innate explosion also increases in size.
  • Draining Effigies: Statues of Follie called Facsimiles are scattered around the level. They have the same aura as Follie, which deal damage and siphon energy while you are standing in its radius. They will also summon Follie if the player is carrying Paint. They can be destroyed and damaging them will temporarily shrink their aura radius. 
  • Ink Balloons: Balloon mines spawn and explode with ink damaging and staggering nearby  players. They can be popped with weapon damage! 
  • Ink Mires: These gloopy globs of ink can appear on doors and lock them down. Damage them to regain access to the door. 
  • Deimos Tendril Drones: These perky tentacled menaces can also spawn and latch onto you, causing you to stagger. Roll to shake them off! 

Mission Restrictions:

  • Air Support Charges are disabled in Follie’s Hunt. 

Star Chart Considerations

Any new node on an existing Planet comes with its own rules to fit within existing systems —  namely Steel Path and Resource Drones. 

  • Completion of Follie’s Hunt is not required for deploying resource Extractors on Venus.
  • Completion of Follie’s hunt is required to unlock the Steel Path.

Rewards

Completing Follie’s Hunt will guarantee you the following rewards: 

  • Atramentum (new resource) 
    • Normal Path: 5
    • Steel Path: 10
  • 1 Steel Essence (Steel Path only) 

As well as a chance at the following drop table rewards: 

  • Follie’s Main and Component Blueprints
  • Enkaus’ Main and Component Blueprints
  • Faction Syndicate Medallions
    • Normal Path: 
      • Insignia 
      • Medallion 
      • Datum 
      • Quittance
      • Mark 
      • Seed 
    • Steel Path: 
      • Defender Insignia
      • Lawful Medallion 
      • Intriguing Datum 
      • Honored Mark
      • Executive Quittance 
      • Bountiful Seed
  • Credits Cache
  • Endo 

New Resource: Atramentum 

This deep black ink has the power to reveal hidden truth. 

Atramentum can be traded at Aspirant Zorba in Relays for wares (read dedicated section for more information). 

How to Acquire Atramentum:

  • Completing Follie’s Hunt missions. 
  • Popping Atramentum Balloons (with weapon damage) in the Vesper Relay during Follie’s Hunt missions.

    Image Description: A lone pink balloon hovers in an ink covered room within the Vesper Relay. A slight shimmer can be seen on the upper right corner of the balloon
