NEW WARFRAME: FOLLIE

Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.

Follie’s Abilities 

Passive: Inkblot

Follie’s abilities coat enemies in ink that slows their movement up to 50% for a few seconds. Afflicted enemies have a 20% chance to drop Health and Energy Orbs.

Ability 1: Forced Perspective

Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.

Ability 2 : Shadowgraph

Bring shadowgraphs from Follie’s sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs also splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created. 

HOLD the ability to open the Shadowgraph wheel and release to cast the selected Shadowgraph. Once a Shadowgraph has been selected, it can be recast by simply TAPPING the ability. 


Shadowgraphs (and the ability to customize them in the Sketchbook) unlock progressively as you rank up Follie. At Rank 30, all Shadowgraphs are unlocked. 

Select from the following Shadowgraphs:

  • Explosive Barrel: Follie summons an explosive barrel with a random elemental damage (icon will appear above the barrel). It will explode upon contact with enemies and can also be detonated by damaging it. 
  • Arc Trap: Follie summons a single Arc Trap to temporarily disrupt and control enemies with Electricity Damage. 
  • Thermian RPG: Follie summons a Thermina RPG to pick up – a devastating Scaldra rocket launcher with three rockets per spawn.
  • Amphors: Follie summons three Amphors of random elemental affinity to pick up and use as grenades or for Alchemy missions. 
  • Death Orb: Follie summons a single Death Orb that inflicts Radiation status and damages enemies. Follie’s Death Orbs also grant Prime Warframes Energy! 
  • Corralizer Armament: Ensnares enemies and slows them down with Cold damage. 
  • Lohk Surge: Follie summons one Lohk Surge that can be activated to receive a random buff. 
  • Universal Ammo: Follie summons an ammo crate that automatically dispenses Universal ammo. 
  • Launch Pad: Follie summons a single launch pad that provides additional upward mobility when jumping in it. Three can be active at a time. 
  • Lost Spirit: Points the way to nearby treasure. 
  • Life Support Capsule: Follie summons a Life Support tower to provides extra support in Survival missions. 
  • Power Cell: Follie summons a Power Cell to grant power to Excavators in Excavation missions.
  • Defense Capsule: Follie summons a Cryopod to distract enemies and draw fire. 
  • Conduit Key: Follie summons a random conduit key to speed up Disruption missions. 

Shadowgraphs can also be moved around the wheel to your liking, similar to the gear and emote wheel. Simply select and drag to a desired spot!

Read the dedicated “Follie’s sketchbook” section below to learn how to customize Shadowgraph’s art. 
 

Ability 3: Self Portrait 

Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie’s effigy and its ink puddle.

Self Portrait is Follie’s Helminth ability – altered Damage Reduction cap at 75%, and Inkblot will not be applied on enemies. 

Ability 4: Plein Air

Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing ink on nearby enemies.

Plein Air is Follie’s Railjack ability. 

 

Follie’s Sketchbook 

Each of Follie’s Shadowgraphs can be customized as many times as your heart desires from the Arsenal! Your creations are projected upon casting Shadowgraph. 

How to Access Sketchbook: Equip Follie, select Shadowgraph in the Arsenal menu and select which Shadowgraph item art you’d like to customize. Reminder that you must rank up Follie to unlock her Shadowgraphs.

Her sketchbook will open up the canvas where you can customize the selected Shadowgraph from simply changing the color to completely reworking the piece from scratch. Let the ink flow, Tenno! You may even find some inspiration to get started from these pieces created by Digital Extremes staff! 

Image Description: 15 Follie Sketchbook creations made by the Digital Extremes team showcasing the versatility of designs that can be created. Some include popular memes, cute animals, anime characters, and of course Warframe characters.

How to Use Follie’s Sketchbook: 

For the purposes of explaining the sketchbook’s features, we’ve provided you with the following steps to give you an idea of how you can get started. But they can be done in any order you see fit, let your creativity flow! 

1. Prepare your canvas:

  • If you wish to start from scratch, select the “Clear Canvas” button – This will remove all existing layers from the canvas. 
  • If you wish to use the existing layers, continue on to the next steps! 
  • Select your preferred canvas state using the two options below the Brush Strokes window: Canvas Light Mode or Canvas Dark Mode

    Image Description: Screenshot of the Shadowgraph UI editing the Arc Trap sketch. Highlighted is the Canvas Dark Mode toggle which shows a red crescent moon to indicate that it is active.
    • This can be changed at any time and can be rather helpful in seeing how your art piece will appear when cast against either light and dark backdrops. 


Image Description: Screenshot of the Shadowgraph UI showing 8 of the Brush Strokes available for use in sketches across two columns. The first column has solid strokes in the form of a square, circle, triangle, and curve. Whereas the second column has hollow versions of those strokes with the curve being replaced with a line.

2. Select Brush Strokes 

The sketchbook comes with a set of Brush Strokes for you to create your masterpiece. 

  • Select and drag Brush Strokes of choice onto the canvas, doing so will create a new Layer.
    • You can create a maximum of 16 layers per Shadowgraph in the sketchbook. 

Image Description: Screenshot of the sketchbook UI with the layers section of the UI highlighted. 9 of the 16 total layers are visible showing the brush stroke and color used on each layer. 4 orange layers and 5 black layers are shown.

3. Adjust Layers 

  • In order to move and/or change a layer, it must first be selected from either the canvas or the Layers list.
  • To move a layer around on the canvas, select it from the Layers list and then grab and drag it around to the desired spot.  
  • Make adjustments to a selected layer using the following tools: 
    • Transformation Box: Change the scale, width, height and rotation of a layer using the blue transform box around it. 
    • Reset Scale: Scale can be reset to default. 
    • Mirror Horizontally/Vertically: Layers can be mirrored horizontally and vertically. 
    • Change layer order: Select and drag a layer from the layers list to change the order of how they appear on the canvas. 
      • If you’d like a layer to appear behind another, drag it below said layer. And for it to appear in front of a layer, drag it on top. 
    • Change color of layer: Select the color box of a layer you wish to change from the Layers list. Choose a new color for your layer from your owned color palettes.

      Image Description: Screenshot of the sketchbook UI showing a selected circle brush stroke layer of the Arc Trap sketch. The cursor is highlighted to show a square to the right of the selected layer indicating the color of the layer, which is purple.
      • Use the dropper icon to copy a layer’s color onto the currently selected layer.

        Image Description: Screenshot of the sketchbook UI for the Arc Trap sketch with a highlight on the eye dropper icon. The icon sits on the far right of the layer section of the UI and is present for each layer.
    • Copy Selected Layer: Create a duplicate of the selected layer in the Layers list. 
    • Delete layer: Delete a selected layer. 
    • Undo/Redo: Take a step back or forward on a selected layer.  
  • If you wish to restart the following options are always available to you:
    • Clear Canvas: Clear all layers from canvas, blank slate!
      • Note: There is no way to undo clearing a canvas, so be absolutely sure you want to clear it before committing! 
    • Reset Canvas: Reset all layers to their default state. 

4. Preview

At any time you can preview your creation using the “Preview” button at the bottom of the screen. From here you also have the option to change the background color for some great screenshots! 

5. Save and Exit 

Once you are happy with your creation, select the “Save and Exit” button to save changes before exiting back to the Arsenal. 

  • Attempting to save when there are no layers in the canvas will reset to the default. 
     

IMPORTANT NOTE ON USING SKETCHBOOK

  • Shadowgraphs must abide by the Community Guidelines: Any art created in Follie’s sketchbook must abide by the Community Guidelines. Be respectful to other Tenno with your creations. If you see sketchbook art from other players that violate the Community Guidelines, report the player by selecting their name in chat > “Report Player” > "Offensive Image” > write why you are reporting them in the text box. The sketchbook image will be reviewed by the team. 
    • Note: If the Sketchbook is being widely misused with sketches that violate the Community Guidelines, we can adjust and/or remove access to it however we feel is appropriate. So please abide by the Community Guidelines so that everyone can continue enjoying this incredibly fun tool! 
  • Shadowgraph Settings: Shadowgraph visibility can be changed using the following: 
    • “Creator Mode” toggle in the Social options. Toggling this mode ON will disable custom Shadowgraphs (yours and others players) and revert them to their defaults. 
    • Adjusting the “Reduce Teammate Visual Effects” slider in the Video options

NEW BEAM RIFLE: ENKAUS

Turn the enemy’s worst nightmare into reality with Follie’s signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.

Unique Trait: Alt fire sprays ink that will stain enemies. Shooting ink stained foes with Enkaus draws ink back into the weapon to reload and dissolves enemies when their health drops below 35%. When wielded by Follie, foes are also inflicted with Inkblot. 

How to Acquire Enkaus

  • Enkaus’ Main and Component Blueprints can be earned from Follie’s Hunt reward drop tables.
  • Purchase Enkaus from the Market individually or as part of The Shadowgrapher Bundle. Learn more in the “Market Additions” section. 

 

NEW ADVERSARY WEAPONS

Three Weapons have gotten the Adversary treatment, with new Kuva, Tenet and Coda versions for you to unleash mayhem aboard the Vesper Relay and beyond. Rip and tear with the Kuva Ghoulsaw, eviscerate with the precision of the Tenet Quanta, and let loose the devastating pestilence of the Coda Bubonico.

Kuva Ghoulsaw

The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.

The Kuva Ghoulsaw has been added to the list of Kuva weapons that can be generated from Kuva Larvlings. 

Tenet Quanta 

Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta’s lethality even further. Alternate Fire cubes now apply Status Effect on impact.

The Tenet Quanta has been added to the list of Tenet weapons that can be generated from Sister Candidates. 

Coda Bubonico 

With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.

The Coda Bubonico has been added to Eleanor’s Batch B Coda Weapon rotation in the Höllvania Central Mall, which is currently live now! To make the Coda Bubonico available immediately with the update release, we rotated Eleanor’s store to Batch B early (original PSA).  

Adversary Weapon Changes:

  • The bonus Valence Bonus percentage roll on Kuva Lich and Sisters of Parvos Adversary Weapons is now properly randomized! 
    • Previously, the roll was weighted towards lower values, meaning a lot of progenitor runs for slim chance at a high percentage Valence Bonus. 
    • Now, it is entirely randomized to give players equal chance across the bonus range.

CLAN COOPERATION SYSTEM 

We mentioned some exciting changes coming to Clans with our Clan QoL Dev Workshop. We are calling this collection of changes the Clan Cooperation System as it is our intention to incentivize more cooperative play between Clanmates. We are going to get into greater specifics in the section below.

Clan Vault Resource Bonus

As part of a new incentivized structure to support playing with your Clanmates, this update introduces a new Clan Vault Resource Bonus. By playing with other Clanmates you now generate bonus resources that are deposited into your Clan Vault at the end of your mission. This bonus is in addition to whatever you collect, so your personal resources amounts are not affected. The resources eligible for this bonus are only those that can be stored in your Clan Vault. Some of these resources are not currently required for Clan use (for example in Dojo decorations) but may be used in the future!

The Clan Vault Resource Bonus works as follows:

  • Each player in a squad from the same Clan increases the bonus % of additional resources that will be deposited into the Clan Vault at the end of the mission. 
    • Two players results in a 10% resource bonus per player
    • Three players results in a 15% resource bonus per player
    • A full squad results in an 20% resource bonus per player
  • The bonus % of additional resources is applied to all eligible resources collected by you and your Clanmates.
  • All bonus resources are immediately deposited into the Clan Vault upon mission completion.
  • You can view the resources that your squad has added to your Clan Vault in the end of mission screen.

We believe these bonus resources in your Clan Vault will make it easier than ever to complete Research, fund Dojo rooms, and decorate your Dojos!

Weekly Initiatives

Earn additional rewards for yourself through your bonus resource contributions to the Clan Vault via the new Weekly Initiatives system.

Similar to other weekly activities, these Weekly Initiatives will reset every Monday at 0:00 UTC!

Weekly Planet Bonus

New Matchmaking Mode: Clan Only

To make it easier to connect and play with Clanmates, we are adding a “Clan Only” matchmaking option. 

Image Description: Screenshot of the matchmaking UI showing all the options available. From top to bottom are Public, Friends Only, Clan Only (currently highlighted), Invite Only, and Solo.

“Clan Only” connects you with fellow Clan or Alliance members. QUEST CHANGES

Awakening Remaster 

For generations you’ve slept. No purpose. No call to wake you. 

The Awakening is players first quest in Warframe, where they learn the basics of combat and movement and meet some key characters. This quest is crucial to the new player experience, which is why we’ve made improvements to the flow, tutorial elements, and completely remastered it from top to bottom for a truly exhilarating and visually stunning introduction to the game!  

A reminder that the Awakening can be replayed from the Codex for those who are looking to experience the remaster and relive their early Tenno days. 

New Quest Completion Reward: Completing the Quest will now reward The Awakening Somachord track! It is automatically added to your account to be played from the Somachord in the Personal Quarters. It is immediately available for those who have already completed the Quest and have access to (or will eventually have access to) their Personal Quarters.

Visual & Environment Changes

  • Added entirely new tiles throughout the quest and updated level design to improve progression experience through quest. Awaken and fight through remastered Earth tiles that transition from your start at the decrepit Orokin tower into an Ostron town ablaze by the Grineer. 
  • Added new skyboxes!
  • Updated the entirety of the Quest with GI lighting and volumetric fog.
    • Note: The daytime lightning we showed on Devstream 192 was returned to nighttime for better parity with the intro cinematic before gameplay. 
  • Added dynamic weather changes in the intro sequence with rain. 
  • Added destructible objects throughout. Because who doesn’t love to break stuff. 

 

Quest Flow & Tutorial Changes

The following changes were made with the goal of making each moment feel exciting and punchier, while also ensuring we are properly teaching new players the game in a fun and rewarding way. We want players spending less time running around to get to the next waypoint and more time fully immersed in the action as they learn. So we’ve made the following changes to achieve that:

  • Moved the sprint and jump tutorial popup earlier upon exiting the Orokin tower and moved the Melee weapon selection closer to the entrance, so that new players have a more immediate interaction with the movement system and combat. 
  • The first instance of combat in the Melee tutorial now happens much closer to where new players pick their Melee weapon. 
    • Also improved visual cues to communicate that combat has begun with the drop ship flying into the scene within the player's view, instead of at a distance in the previous version. 
  • Spaced the jump tutorial stages further apart to better explain single and double jumps.
  • Shortened the path from the slide tutorial sequence to attacking an enemy to really make that moment feel heroic! 
  • Improved the overall combat sequence during the Secondary weapon tutorial with the new Ostron village arena that tightens engagement distance to the enemies, which was previously too far. 
  • Shortened the trek from the Ostron village to the bullet jumping tutorial significantly. 
  • Changed the bullet jumping tutorials to occur in areas that are more conducive to bullet jumping: 
    • The basic Bullet Jump tutorial now occurs in an area (with many beautiful waterfalls might I add) where you bullet jump from platform to platform. 
      • Within this area, we also added a new tutorial popup to explain how to Bullet Jump UP to reach platforms above you. 
    • The Bullet Jump + Slide tutorial area now occurs on a flat surface instead of slope. 
      • Previously, the Bullet Jump + Slide tutorial popup occurred in an uphill tunnel, which made it feel sluggish and didn’t properly communicate how beneficial it is.
      • Now, in the updated area, players will get a proper feel for the momentum you get by accomplishing this set of movements. 
    • Added tutorial popup to teach players that Bullet Jumping repeatedly will help them move faster. 
  • Moved the “release the lockdown” console closer to the doors upon exiting the Captain Vor fight and made it a single button interaction instead of needing to hack it.  
  • Added more exploding barrels to the combat segment that follows acquiring a Primary weapon for a fun impact moment. 
  • Ship defense segment changes:
    • Added Lotus transmission upon seeing the Liset Landing Craft to explain that it needs power and needs to be activated via the marked console. 
      • Previously, only the marker appeared without explanation as to what the player was doing by activating it before doing so. 
    • This segment now takes place in an entirely new tile with a layout that improves visibility of enemies and engagement distance.
      • The previous tile took place on a platform with various surfaces of different elevations around it, which made combat feel distant and wasn’t conducive to players testing out all the new skills they just learned. 
    • Added the following tutorial messages while defending the ship to remind players what they’ve learned: 
      • How to swap between weapons 
      • How to melee 
      • How to use your first ability

QUALITY OF LIFE (QOL) CHANGES

Survival QOL: Security Bypasses

Survival has been a tried and true game mode in Warframe for the last 13 years, and we wanted to add a little extra to the game mode without changing its identity! When a Life Support tower spawns, a Security Bypass will spawn nearby for you to find. 

Image Description: Screenshot of a closeup of the Security Bypass. A white and blue object of intricate design, its lower section has a blue lighting structure reminiscent of the the top of the Life Support Tower.

 

You may have to go searching, but once you’re in close proximity a waypoint will show you precisely where it can be found. You can also use treasure hunting abilities, such as Golden Instinct or Orokin Eye to help find Security Bypasses!

Image Description: Composite image of the HUD for the Security Bypass marker in mission and the indicator in UI when activated. The marker is a yellow iconized version of the actual Security Bypass with 5m to indicate distance from it. When activated a stopwatch icon with speed lines appears under the Life Support System HUD with a “time x 2” counter.

 

Once you have a Security Bypass, a console will be marked with a waypoint for delivery. Insert the Security Bypass into the console, and for one minute time will move twice as fast! This functionally acts as a 1-minute time save for every Security Bypass you insert!

Additional Notes:

  • Please note that the new Security Bypass system does not affect Duviri versions of Survival, Hell-Scrub missions in Höllvania, or Survival missions in Albrecht’s Laboratories.
  • Reactant drops in Survival Fissure missions are doubled for the duration of the Security Bypass. 

 

Excavation QOL

Excavator Survivability

We’ve heard your feedback on Excavators being too weak, and are happy to say they’ll survive better than ever before! Excavators across the Origin System have had a few improvements to help keep them alive longer:

  • Excavators spawn with 3 seconds of temporary invulnerability, ensuring the Excavator is fully initialized before it becomes vulnerable.
  • Excavator Shields now apply shield-gating, making them survive longer by default and making delivery of Power Cells to restore shields more impactful.
  • Excavators have increased base Health (from 1500 to 2000), and scale much more aggressively to enemy levels. This should mean your Steel Path Excavators have significantly more health!
    • Duviri Excavators already had increased health, which has now been standardized to match Excavators in the Origin System.

Player Cold Status & Arctic Eximus Rework

In this update we adjusted Arctic Eximus enemies to make them less punishing and make it easier to engage in counter-play. This led to some changes in the way that Cold Status affects players.

Player Cold Status Changes*

Before: Getting afflicted with Cold Status would result in a 25% slowdown with no stacking for a 6 second duration.

  • Now: Cold Status results in a 10% slowdown with an individual 6 second duration per stack, stacking up to 4 times for Players. (Players remain unable to be frozen solid)

This change results in an overall potential of having up to 40% speed reduction but does not halt player movement completely.

* These changes only apply to Cold Status against players (from sources such as environmental hazards and enemies), and does not alter how Cold Status affects enemies.

Arctic Eximus Changes

The Arctic Eximus has a unique application of the Cold Status effect. Under the previous system, the Arctic Eximus’ slowdown aura was invisible and much larger than their Globe suggested. Multiple Arctic Eximus auras could also overlap and apply their slowdown exponentially which made playing against them frustrating. To address this and to add more clarity to how their effects function we have made the following changes:

  • Arctic Eximus enemies no longer have an invisible slowdown aura, instead the area of effect of their Cold Status is limited to the inside of their Globe.
  • Arctic Eximus enemies now apply one stack of Cold Status per second if a player is inside their Globe.
  • While inside of their Globe, Cold Status will stack up to 4 times for Players without duration.
  • Cold Status from the Arctic Eximus is immediately removed if you leave the Globe, destroy the Globe, or kill the Eximus.

We believe that these changes will make taking on these enemies more engaging and will also reduce the frustration that may arise from being held in place by status effects. As with any change we are open to your feedback on this rework.

 

Mantle Animation Improvements 

We’ve made improvements to mantling over surfaces so that it is faster and much more fluid! 

  • Added new mantle animations to Warframes to improve the transition to mantle surfaces. 
    • These new animations are Warframe-only and do not apply to Drifter/Operator as they do not have the same parkour speed and capabilities as their Transference counterparts. 
    • Improved vault up/over logic to better detect if there’s a ledge to mantle and automatically give a small jump to get up to the ledge. 
    • Improve the speed at which a mantle triggers so that there’s less delay between reaching a ledge and starting a mantle. 
    • Mantle animation can now be canceled by crouching/sliding. 
      • It will only interrupt the mantle at the time the binding is used and not while it is being held. 
    • Improved how and when mantling triggers when performing other parkour movements around mantle surfaces. 
    • Mantling is now possible while aim gliding. 
    • Fixed an issue where the mantle animation would occur during ability casting animation and teleport you back to where the mantle occurred. 
      • To prevent this, mantles will not trigger during casting animations anymore. 
  • Drifter mantle improvements: 
    • Drifter no longer plays that front flip up animation when mantling. 
      • This animation would occur randomly and could make the transition feel clunky. 
    • Fixed Drifter getting stuck up high when mantling.

CHANGES

Warframe & Equipment Changes

  • Harrow’s Thurible energy per kill channeling now benefits from damage-over-time kills that were triggered by shooting an enemy in the head (similar to Cyte-09’s Evade). 
  • Oraxia’s Scuttlers and Inaros’ Swarm Kavats now scale to the level of the enemy they were created from instead of defaulting to the mission level. 
  • Tauron Strikes now break destructible environment objects! 
  • Made the following changes to Volt’s abilities: 
    • Speed’s increase to squadmates’ movement speed is now capped at 150% (remains uncapped for Volt). 
      • This change was made after seeing consistent complaints from players about receiving the buff when they do not want it. We will however be watching for feedback to gauge player preference.  
      • Friendly NPCs are not affected by this cap. 
    • In addition to picking up Electric Shield with the context action, you can now also hold to cast for the shield to spawn in its mobile mode. 
      • If this is done while already holding a shield, you will drop the existing one and it’ll be replaced by the new one. 
  • Made the following changes and fixes to Vauban’s passive:
    • The damage bonus now applies to all Electricity and Heat Status Effects!
      • Electricity:
        • Previously, with the launch of Vauban’s retouch the passive only applied to the Electricity Status from his Tesla Nervos, but we intended for it to apply to other forms of incapacitation. 
        • Now, when enemies are actively in the Electricity stun animation from any source, the passive will apply. 
      • Heat: The passive triggers from enemies incapacitated by the panic animation. 
    • Clarification on how Cold Status triggers the passive: Enemies need to be frozen solid (10 stacks) for the passive to consider them incapacitated.  
    • The HUD buff will now show as x1.25 instead of percentage.
    • As mentioned with the Vauban Heirloom release, our hope was to ship the full version of his Passive changes with his Retouch, but due to technical constraints we have released them now!      
  • Made the following changes to how Elemental Ammo is prioritized between Warframes with associated abilities. 
    • Oraxia’s Toxin buff from Silken Stride is now prioritized over Cyte-09’s Resupply and Uriel’s Runes. 
      • This also fixes the issue of Silken Stride’s Toxin buff getting removed and not being restored after Uriel’s Demonium Rune buff expires. 
    • Cyte-09’s Resupply is now prioritized the same as Uriel’s Demonium. 
      • Previously, Demonium would completely override and clear the selected Elemental ammo from Cyte-09’s Resupply. 
      • Now, whichever one you picked up last will decide the active Elemental buff. 
        • So if you pick up a Rune and then a Resupply pack, it will swap from the Rune buff to Resupply’s buff and vice versa. 
        • Additionally, if you pick up a Resupply pack while Uriel’s Demonium Rune buff is active, it will swap to Resupply’s Elemental damage. But if the Rune buff is still active at the time that you reload/empty the clip, it will apply once more. 
      • Known issue: Clients using Sobek’s Acid Shells Augment do not apply Resupply’s elemental damage. This requires further investigation from the team to address.  
  • Updated Vauban’s Bastille ability description to better explain the rework.
    • Now reads: "Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.”
  • Made the following changes to the audio muffling effect when using invisibility Warframes (Cyte-09, Oraxia, Loki, and Ivara) with player feedback that it can be irritating over a sustained period of time:
    • Slightly reduced the intensity of the invisible audio muffling across the board. 
    • Player weapons (Primary, Secondary, and Melee) will no longer be muffled while invisible. 
  • Updated the description of Zid-An Asheir Arcane to specify that you get the Status Chance buff from Operator OR Tauron Strike kill (previously said “and”, which was causing confusion).

Graphic Improvements

We have made the following game-wide graphics improvements! Note that these changes will not appear if shaders are set to low. 

1. Improved Sharpening
We replaced our previous sharpening system with AMD’s robust contrast aware sharpening, which as you can see in this before & after picture of Roathe has improved the look and realism of many details (less aliasing, skin looks more detailed, lips are more defined, etc.) Note that this is through the TAA Antialiasing mode, which needs to be enabled to see the sharpening improvements. 

This also fixes issues with dark halos, which is most noticeable in this picture by the gold details, which have a more visual pop now!   

 

2. Improved Specular Area Lighting 
This also brings specular area lighting and indirect lighting sharpening, which as you can see in this before & after picture of Korffel. 

We’ve also improved reflections on metals to be sharper so that the objects reflected on those surfaces are more visible/identifiable.

    • For some time it has been our white whale to hunt down and while we can not offer a complete fix at the moment, we’ve added extensive logging that should help find us get rid of it once and for all. We were able to locate the cause of recent Moonwalk issues relating to Warframes using Vinquibus and Mesa using Mesa’s Waltz with this method and are hoping to find a general fix that catches all iterations of this issue.
    • Should you encounter a loss of function where your character walks funny and you’re locked out of properly playing the mission, please do the following:
      • Take an F6 screenshot - This will print some useful information in your log.
      • Save your ee.log
        • Can be found at %localappdata%\Warframe\EE.log
        • These are overwritten every time you restart the game, so ideally save it as early as possible
      • Send in the log and the F6 Screenshot in a Support ticket: https://support.warframe.com/

    • Now reads: “Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take Radiation Damage.” 
  • Fixed incorrectly being able to sell the Vinquibus if it is the last melee weapon on your account.
  • Fixed Oberon’s Renewal making him invincible when running out of energy while equipped with the Phoenix Renewal Augment.
  • Fixed Nyx being able to slide and bullet jump during Assimilate Absorb after casting Brightbonnet. 
     

Mission Fixes

  • Fixed Nightmare Defense missions being 6 waves instead of 3. 
  • Fixes towards Clients spamming push inputs in Enigma Puzzles in Duviri resulting in function loss.
  • Fixed Viktor appearing permanently surprised in his Höllvania mission transmissions.
  • Fixed Clients not triggering laser alarms in Lua Spy. 
  • Fixed entering the Void Angel arena as a rotation ends resulting in players being unable to select a Relic reward in endless Zariman Void Fissure missions.
  • Fixed Operator/Drifters appearing during the Sanctuary Onslaught Conduit transition animation. 
  • Fixed Drifter being stuck in a broken state after entering a teleport volume in Last Gasp in Descendia missions.
  • Fixed Clients being unable to see the VFX in the “Reconnect the Power Lines” Isleweaver objective.
  • Fixed simultaneous teleports in Railjack (ex: fast travelling within the Railjack and then teleporting to a player) resulting in function loss. 
  • Fixed the Thermian RPG and enemy waypoint markers remaining on-screen when the H-09 Efervon Tank is stabbable at the end of Stage 1 of the fight.
  • Fixed the Financial Stress debuff in The Index remaining active upon delivering points while in Nokko’s Reroot form or Sevagoth’s Shadow.  
  • Fixed an unintended Lotus transmission at the start of the Eris Junction boss fight.
  • Fixed dying by interacting with a Velocipod if it is tranquilized near a slope, ledge or exocrine.
  • Fixed status icons being hard to read in Alchemy if Alchemical Invulnerability is active.
  • Fixed the VFX of the glyphs in the Steel Path Captain Vor mission disappearing after activating them.
  • Fixed Clients not having sound effects for the cinematic intro of The Descendia.
  • Fixed being unable to Archwing Slingshot into enemy ships on Railjack.
  • Fixed the Xata Requiem Obelisk not dropping rewards after successfully killing enemies.
  • Fixed selecting Repeat Mission for a Railjack mission while in the Base of Operations loading into a mission without UI and resulting in function loss.
  • Fixed the Voidburst Keyglyph effect not applying after picking it up twice in Netracell missions. 
  • Fixed the moving pillars in one of the Descendia tiles pushing players and NPCs under the map. 
  • Fixed a Tauron Boost Convergence Orb (blue) that had no duration appearing regardless of if you have reached the daily Focus Cap or not.  
  • Fixed the camera becoming detached in Void Cascade missions if a Warframe enters the radius of Possessed Exolizer with the pause menu opened.
  • Fixed a very rare case of a black screen appearing when attempting to play a Kuva Fortress mission.
  • Fixed the Railjack Tactical Menu becoming disabled if players died during a Technocyte Coda showdown and repeated the mission right afterward. 
  • Fixed the Health Conversion mod not functioning in the Circuit. 
  • Fixed Host teleports to Blinkpads being cancelled if a Client initiated a teleport to the same location in open landscape missions.
  • Fixed Steel Path Void Fissure missions launched from the Sanctum Anatomica or Chrysalith resulting in enemy levels being an extra 100 levels too high. 
  • Fixed Necramechs being able to spawn out of bounds during the Technocyte Coda Showdown.
  • Made fixes towards Yareli clipping through areas of The Perita Rebellion tileset. 
  • Fixed a spot where players were able to avoid Hunhullus ground attacks in The Perita Rebellion missions. 
  • Fixed the HUD countdown timer in The Perita Rebellion not continuing countdown after pausing and resuming the game in solo mission. 
  • Fixed being able to run on top of Orokin dropships in The Perita Rebellion after grappling to them. 
  • Fixed The Perita Rebellion’s primary and secondary objective texts overlapping each other in certain languages. 
  • Fixed firing SFX persisting if Clients exited an Anarch Turret while shooting. 
  • Fixed an invisible floating platform unintentionally existing in The Perita Rebellion.
  • Fixed the context action to begin the Legacyte hunt disappearing when close to Kalymos.  
  • Fixed context action for the Targeting Array in The Perita Rebellion disappearing if the player gets too close to it. 
  • Fixed the Head Stompers Penance in Descendia killing Marie/Lyon (as defense targets) and other friendly NPCs. 
  • Fixed Zariman mission not loading upon returning to Arbitration mission after aborting a previous one, causing players to get stuck in the elevator. 
  • Fixed enemies having issues pathing all the way up the stairs in the Descendia tileset. 
  • Fixed more cases of Alad V’s transmissions playing over cutscenes in his Assassination mission. 
  • Fixed Archon Hunt Defense mission transmissions still triggering based on the old 5 wave rounds. 
  • Fixed some enemies not pathing to the Defense objective in The Circuit. 
  • Fixed a progression stop when Host Migration occurs right after the Technocyte Coda Showdown cinematic incorrectly leaving the original Host’s Lich in the fight.
  • Fixed a function loss for Clients if Host triggers an event that pulls Clients out of the Owl Recon Puzzle (like Kullervo’s fight).
  • Fixed exiting the Grineer Galleon ship incorrectly having a Skip Cinematic prompt that would lead to a function loss and black screen if selected.
  • Fixed Arbiters of Hexis Operative Arbitration defense target getting stuck in elevator. 
  • Fixed case where Vault A’s door in the Cambria Spy mission on Earth would open automatically instead of requiring console hacking. 
  • Fixed rare issue where Host could get stuck transitioning from hub to Open Landscape while Clients attempting to join the in-progress mission. 
  • Fixed Arbitration Drones appearing in regular Zariman missions after aborting a Zariman Arbitration mission through the elevator.
  • Fixed issue where multiple bosses in Descendia could spawn on the same spawn point. 
     

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Dagath Yfari Skin fixes:
    • Fixed Dagath Yfari’s tassels being excessively stretched while flying in Archwing. 
    • Fixed Dagath Yfari’s VFX not taking proper energy tints in the Navigation Menu. 
    • Fixed Dagath Yfari Skin having a texture hole on the pack of her neck. 
    • Fixed disjointed pinkies on the Dagath Yfari Skin. 
  • Fixed Vauban Heirloom having some Syandanas clip into his lower back when his Overcoat is removed.
  • Fixed being unable to customize the Venato Prime’s VFX. 
  • Fixed missing chains and cloth detail on Roathe’s Gemini Skin.
  • Fixed the skinning around the Roathe Gemini Skin’s neck to help with head movement. 
  • Fixed Gyre Prime’s skirt not lifting while using her Rotorswell ability with the Gyre Kuvael Monarch Skin equipped. 
  • Fixed Coil Horizon and Rotorswell not using Gyre Prime’s ability prime VFX while other skins are equipped. 
  • Fixed Alternox Prime’s VFX incorrectly being visible through Gyre Prime’s body.
  • Fixed the interruption of Khora Urushu’s idle animation in the Arsenal causing her whip to remain onscreen.
  • Fixed some facial animation issues for Lyon’s Gemini Skin when removing his Mitre.
  • Fixed the TennoCon 2023 Syandana’s textures breaking occasionally after a Void Sling.
  • Fixed left-only shoulder armor not appearing on Operator while the “Customize Left/Right Separately" toggle is off. 
  • Fixed Gauss Profitas skirt using the incorrect material.
  • Fixed Wukong and many of his skins missing tail physics. 
  • Fixed the cloth on the Insign Medals stretching while flying around in Archwing.  
  • Fixed the cloth portions of the Insign Medals floating while wearing the Rota Syandana. 
  • Fixed neck deformation issues with Lyon’s Gemini Skin. 
  • Fixed the barrel on the Tau Dax Archgun Skin not rotating correctly. 
  • Fixed a visual bug when previewing the Wukong Qitian Sigil in the Arsenal.
  • Fixed the right shoulder clipping into the arm for Chymerist Gloves, Kukri Prime Armor, and Lodestar Shoulder Plates.
  • Fixed Vauban Heirloom’s jacket clipping through his body when riding Atomicycle. 
  • Fixed Bloodshed Sigil not applying custom Sigil colors when equipped on Operator.
  • Fixed Dagath’s Rakhali’s Cavalry Kaithes on her Yfari Skin not applying custom energy colors. 
  • Fixed several armor offset issues on the Gyre Vortengeist Skin. 
  • Fixed offset issues with certain leg armors on Cyte-09. 
  • Fixed Lettie, Eleanor, and Aoi Gemini Skins having their mouths open in Navigation. 
  • Fixed Gemini Skins’ skin looking shiny in Navigation.   
  • Fixed being unable to customize the Sun & Moon’s Holster Style. 
  • Fixed the Marie Gemini Skin’s skirt clipping into her behind.
  • Fixed Nunchaku Standard Holster being able to put weapons in unintended places.
     

UI Fixes 

  • Fixed Clients not seeing the Heartcell pop-up if they were dropped by the Quick Correct mod after stabbing their Technocyte Coda Duet.
  • Fixed Custom UI Themes not loading upon login if the Base of Operations is set to Drifter Camp or Backroom.
  • Fixed subtitles remaining on-screen after skipping a Hex kiss cinematic.
  • Fixed |Count| appearing instead of the number in Höllvania Exterminate secondary objective text for various languages.
  • Fixed “Hostage Rescued” stat appearing in the End of Mission screen of Sortie Defense missions that have an NPC Defense Target.
  • Fixed Vauban’s Abilities screen missing the “View Augments” button while in the Simulacrum.
  • Fixed a case of LShift text appearing outside of the input button in the Railjack Intrinsics menu.
  • Fixed inconsistent Alignment placement on player Profiles across various platforms. 
  • Fixed the “No Self Revive” tooltip on the Temporal Archimedea screen mentioning Void Angels, despite that mechanic not applying in this mission.
  • Fixed Corrupted Specters appearing to be usable in Descendia (UI only issue, they could not be selected via the Gear Wheel).
  • Fixed the test timer disappearing while in hacking screens in the Legendary Rank 5 test. 
  • Fixed Amp Ammo count disappearing after casting Caustic Strike or Void Snare. 
    • Also fixed Sirocco’s HUD UI disappearing after using Operator abilities.
  • Fixed the Grimoire having a Magazine stat in the Upgrade Screen. 
    • The Grimoire has infinite ammo and does not have a magazine. 
  • Fixed binding callout to open Decree selection disappearing after opening Acrithis’ Shop in Duviri.   
  • Fixed issues where UI elements in the Arsenal would overlap. 
  • Fixed status effects being unclear by showing them on their own line under enemy names.
  • Fixed Nightwave Cred Offerings and reward preview screens overlapping after pressing R3 twice on controller. 
  • Fixed using the “Defaults” button after using the search bar to filter out options resetting all settings, instead of just the ones pulled up and visible from searching. 
  • Fixed being unable to customize Drifter’s Melee weapon via the mirror in Teshin’s Cave or the Dormizone. 
  • Fixed Clients having “Reactant Collected” UI stuck onscreen after aborting a Void Storm mission.
  • Fixed the “Equip Focus Lenses to charge Tauron Strike significantly faster” notification still showing up even though you have a Lens equipped on an Amp. 
  • Fixed the Overleveling tooltip appearing too low in the Upgrade screen. 
  • Fixed the Arsenal grid list to equip items having alignment issues. 
  • Fixed video settings not being respected upon login if Dynamic Resolution is disabled. 
  • Fixed a room in the Höllvania tileset missing a proper outline in the minimap. 
  • Fixed players being able to select outdated Duviri Circuit Rewards if the screen was open just before weekly reset, resulting in an error message. 
    • The screen should now properly update once the reset happens!
  • Fixed having “Switch Weapon” unbound in the controller layout resulting in players being unable to access the Dark Refractory. 
  • Fixed Dethcube Prime’s and Shade Prime’s names being cut off in the mission HUD.
  • Fixed incorrect stats in UI when equipping the Vinquibus and when swapping to an Incarnon weapon.     
  • Fixed offset issues with Syandanas clipping through Vauban Heirloom’s skirt. 
  • Fixed Vauban’s Minelayer ability stat text overlapping in some languages.
  • Fixed boss fights with multiple targets (ie. Prime Vanguard) sharing the same Overguard bar and Status Effects in their HUD health indicators, instead being visually distinct from one another. 
    • Also fixed vertical alignment issues between bosses’ health bars when changing resolution.  
  • Fixed the Initial Charge stat in the Tektolyst Artifact upgrade screen displaying the incorrect value after re-entering the screen. 
  • Fixed Polarity icons in upgrade screen flashing and Mod icon sticking to cursor after fusing a Mod using a controller. 
  • Fixed controller cursor snapping to resource icons in Tactical menu instead of actual interactable UI elements when navigating with D-pad.  
  • Fixed Clients not seeing elemental ammo UI after picking up mushrooms in Undermind Bounties. 
  • Fixed The Perita Rebellion memory selection screen overlapping the previously selected mission when switching between missions to matchmake for.
  • Fixed the Tauron Strike Charge gain UI incorrectly displaying when collecting Convergence Orbs.
  • Fixed a non-functional passive buff incorrectly displaying in the HUD when interacting with the Arsenal in the Simulacrum as Citrine.
  • Fixed [PH] tag appearing in Descendia boss names in their intro cutscene. 
  • Fixed Riven Mod and Upgrade UI appearance breaking when unveiling Riven by equipping it. 
  • Fixed the mouse cursor continuously being pulled towards the bottom menu bar if you were using WASD directional keys to place a camera and continued to hold them slightly after confirming the camera position.
  • Fixed having to clear the “Max enemy count reached” popup multiple times in the Simulacrum. 
  • Fixed the Syndicate Radial Effect tooltip on Syndicate mods not popping up in the Syndicate offerings screen. 
  • Fixed equipped gear not appearing in the Individual Parameters in Deep/Temporal Archimedea while Operator/Drifter.  
  • Fixed the following Somachord songs having placeholder icons:
    • Crash Course
    • From the Stars
    • Alive Again
    • Below Zero
  • Fixed the Quatz displaying the wrong unique trait icon.
  • Fixed Gyre Prime Armor having the incorrect shoulder icon.
  • Fixed the Perita Rebellion recall nodes transitioning abruptly in the UI when hovered on and off. 
  • Fixed reward thumbnail overlapping border in the Events tab when multiple event alerts are live. 
  • Fixed case of the “Baro Ki’Teer has Returned” inbox message breaking and not including the location he’s arrived at. 
  • Fixed weird gaps in the event panel UI around the Thermia Fractured event icons. 

 

Level Design & Environment Fixes

  • Fixed a map hole in a Corpus Gas City elevator.  
  • Fixed players being able to get behind a wall in the Corpus Ice Planet tileset. 
  • Fixed players being unable to summon their Necramech South of Asta Crater in the Orb Vallis. 
  • Fixed browsing Roathe’s Honoria in the Necralisk moving the camera to his position in La Cathédrale. Now the window will open where he is standing.
  • Fixed players being able to get stuck in Treasure Rooms in the Orokin Tower tileset. 
  • Fixed obstructive collision in a pipe in a Grineer Forest spy vault.
  • Fixed Clients being unable to see the electricity VFX from a puzzle in Albrecht’s Laboratories tileset. 
  • Fixed some obstructive collisions in a Treasure Room in the Orokin Tower tileset. 
  • Fixed minor texture flickering on the Ambulas spawn pads in the Ambulas Assassination mission on Pluto. 
  • Fixed enemies in the Höllvania Courtyard Simulacrum getting stuck in an animation loop attempting to use a lift pulley. 
    • We removed the pulley to fix this issue, enemies are like a dog with a bone when it comes to those things I guess. 
  • Fixed players getting teleported through the Dojo’s Harbinger's Pass and Courtier’s Bliss portals from Domestik Drones driving by the trigger volume. 
  • Fixed a wall incorrectly appearing black in the Grineer Shipyard tileset.
  • Fixed snow banks in missions with Corpus Outposts having jagged edges.
  • Fixed some mismatched ground textures in Descendia.
  • Fixed an unintended visual at the side of a bridge in Isleweaver.
  • Fixed stage elements not being removed after destroying the stage in the Solstice Square.
  • Fixed a map hole in the Grineer Sealab tileset. 
  • Fixed an area near the Space Port in Orb Vallis that would cause the map to become transparent.
  • Fixed wonky volume collision at the extraction ring in Lua tileset that was causing players to get stuck in it. 
  • Fixed map hole in Marie’s Sanctuary room in the Descendia. 
  • Fixed a few floating rocks in the Cambion Drift. The only things supposed to be floating are the fish!
  • Fixed missing collision on some environment elements in a Corpus Outpost tile. 
  • Fixed clipping issues and map errors in the Grineer Forest tileset. Fixed K-Drive sinking into the roof of certain buildings in the Orb Vallis. 
  • Fixed some floating rubble in the Descendia. 
  • Fixed hitbox of a small ledge in a vent in the Corpus Ship tileset that players would often get caught on. 
  • Fixed players clipping into terrain in an area of Duviri. 
  • Fixed a confusing waypoint marker in the Grineer Asteroid.  
  • Fixed wind issues with overgrowth hanging vines in the Höllvania tileset. 
  • Fixed light rays appearing under a table in the Drifter Camp. 
  • Fixed floating foliage and map holes in the Orb Vallis caves. 
  • Fixed a terrain blending issue in between Grineer Forest tiles. 
  • Fixed a floating light bar in the Höllvania tileset. 
  • Fixed a floating rock in the Grineer Settlement tileset. 
  • Fixed culling issues with wall plates in the Grineer Galleon Defense tileset. 
  • Fixed a console floating/poking out of terrain in the Cambion Drift. 
  • Fixed a terrain gap in the Corpus Outpost tileset. 
  • Fixed terrain issues in the Murmur tiles in the Albrecht’s Laboratories tileset. 
  • Fixed a map hole in Marie’s Descendia floor. 
  • Fixed Somachord in Descendia clipping with furniture. 
  • Fixed clipping issues with a pipe on an Efervon tank in Höllvania tileset. 
  • Fixed a large gap above the garage door in the Höllvania tileset. 
  • Fixed eye ball deco in Descendia tileset only following the Host and not Clients. 
  • Fixed ground textures appearing as solid colors in the Drifter Camp and Teshin’s Cave. 
  • Fixed the small tree branches in the Plains of Eidolon behaving weirdly with the wind. 
  • Fixed a map hole in the Grineer Sealab tileset. 
  • Fixed Titania with Razorwing Blitz Augment getting launched out of the map after dashing into the Extraction elevator in Zariman. 
  • Fixed using /unstuck command spawning player underneath platform in Kela de Thaym fight. 
  • Fixed Nokko ending up outside the Kela de Thaym arena after Reroot times out.   
  • Fixed enemy pathing issues in the Corpus Ice Planet caves. 
  • Fixed cases of certain alarm terminals not working in Kuva Fortress tileset. 
  • Fixed chandeliers in Albrecht’s Laboratories tileset incorrectly falling to the ground.
  • Fixed a map hole in the Cambion Drift.

 

Codex Fixes

  • Fixed Higasa Serration and Amanata Pressure not being listed in the Codex.
    • Also fixed them not being chat-linkable. 
  • Fixed both Doppelganger Codex entries displaying the Melee variant.
  • Fixed being unable to complete the Narmer Buzzard Dropship and Narmer Condor Dropship Codex entries.
  • Fixed the Juno Geminex Moa having a duplicate Codex entry.
  • Removed an incompletable Techrot Galliflex Eximus Codex entry. 
  • Fixed Choralyst scans not counting towards their Codex entry.
  • Fixed being unable to complete Deimos Leaper, Deimos Swarm Mutalist Moa, and Deimos Swarm Mutalist Moa Eximus Codex entries.
  • Fixed being unable to complete the Scrofa Light Trencher Eximus Codex entry.
  • Fixed the Conculyst and Battalyst not having arms in the Codex diorama.
  • Fixed scans of the Fortress Scanner not counting towards its Codex entry.

 

Misc. Fixes

  • Fixed Uriel’s Infernalis flight SFX continuing to play during extraction.
  • Fixed being able to swap between different Warframes when previewing Gemini Emotes in the Arsenal. 
  • Fixed cases of stretched VFX when performing Melee Slam attacks. 
  • Fixed players missing their landing SFX in the Descendia intro cinematic. 
  • Fixed Client being unable to accept/decline Dry Dock invites after leaving and re-entering the Railjack. 
  • Fixed Secondary Arcane switching to Primary Slot in Archgun Mod Config after duplicating Config with only a Secondary Arcane equipped. 
  • Fixed Clients invited to Host’s Backrooms not seeing the Melee weapons on the Warframe Displays. 
  • Fixed the Decree SFX playing incorrectly when context actions appear if one is pending.
  • Fixed Amps being unequipped when the Operator menu is opened in the Simulacrum.
  • Fixed Operator teleporting erratically to different spots when attempting to Customize in the Simulacrum.
  • Fixed a function loss caused by Bleeding Out without any remaining revives and returning to the Dojo.
  • Fixed the Xenoflora, Domestik Caliber Drone, Infernum Throne, M-09 Efervon Tank Domestik Drone and Timelost Artifact decorations appearing in the Vendor’s tab in the Base of Operations decoration selection window. 
    • They have been correctly moved to the Market tab! 
  • Fixed decorations not being placeable under the Market desk in the Orbiter.
  • Fixed the Reliquary Drive being vacant in Railjack missions that weren’t started in a Dry Dock. 
  • Fixed the Zariman Staircase (Right and Left Spirals) decorations having small gaps.
  • Fixed Lich crew members remaining as crew after they have been traded away.
  • Fixed music switching erratically between combat and ambient while playing as Uriel. 
  • Fixed the A Lost Time decoration not matching the selected natural complexion tint of Operator Config A.
    • Also fixed the mother’s hair not matching the Operator’s hair color. 
  • Fixed the enemy Translocator device in The Index having a huge VFX field. 
  • Fixed camera funkiness when running into a gate in Marie’s Room Scene as Titania in Razorwing mode. 
  • Fixed an untranslated objective description in Descendia missions.
  • Fixed the Digital Extremes logo animation unintentionally replaying if the application window is manually resized while it plays.
  • Fixed Amalgam Osprey’s orbs not disappearing after the Osprey’s death or after time has passed.
  • Fixed loss of function in Mastery Rank 22 test while in Nokko’s Sprodling form. 
  • Fixed pickups (ex: data mass) not disappearing from hand while playing Shawzin. 
  • Fixed case of the third month of POM-2 Calendar generating with only one reward instead of two. 
  • Fixed the following mods not being chat-linkable:
    • Peculiar End
    • Primed Cleanse The Murmur
    • Primed Counterbalance
    • Primed Bane of The Murmur
    • Primed Stabilizer
    • Primed Steady Hands
    • Primed Quickdraw
    • Primed Venomous Clip
  • Fixed Market packs that can be purchased for real world currencies and Platinum not appearing in their usual non-paid categories.      
  • Fixed being unable to move through certain areas where the Maw should fit while fishing in Duviri. 
  • Fixed an issue where Maw could have erratic movement near the water surface in Duviri. 
  • Fixed Railjack Crew spinning on the spot and walking into walls when customizing the interior of the Railjack. 
  • Fixed laser beam end points not properly disabling when you're not hitting something (they would linger in the last spot hit). 
  • Fixed Somachord songs that have autoplay turned off still playing, instead of skipping them when jumping from song to song. 
  • Fixed Archwing using default colors when playing as Uriel with the Roathe Gemini Skin equipped. 
  • Fixed no Necraslisk Bounties appearing available if the screen was open when the refresh occurred. 
  • Fixed Uriel’s Brimstone VFX not being affected by the Visual Effects Intensity slider. 
  • Fixed being unable to fall through two platforms in a row in Caliber Chicks 2. 
  • Fixed the starting spawn point in the Cambion Drift using the Heart of Deimos Quest location instead of spawning players outside of the Necralisk gates as intended. 
  • Fixed Host migration related issues that could occur in the Hunhullus fight. 
  • Fixed flickering issues that would occur while panning. 
  • Fixed the controller button callout above the Observe eye icon in the Railjack Tactical menu not cycling between Crew Members. 
  • Fixed Clients in Last Gasp after Host Migration incorrectly hearing the heartbeat SFX twice.
  • Fixed players inadvertently being able to see outside of the Liset when entering Decorate mode from the Operator backroom.
  • Fixed Baruuk’s Desert Wind VFX not appearing in the Arsenal. 
  • Fixed some Ephemeras and Syandanas Market dioramas being super zoomed in. 
  • Fixed Lyon getting stuck typing forever if you ask him for help with [redacted]. 
  • Fixed the “Transmissions through Controller” audio option being off on new accounts instead of being on. 
  • Fixed face animations missing for bow, speargun and melee weapon idle animations. 
  • Fixed Clients Wukong’s Iron Staff missing its VFX. 
  • Fixed the Saturn Six Emblem not appearing when equipped, also fixed its icon missing in the UI. 
  • Fixed being unable to purchase the Void Adornment Bundle (with prorated price) if you already own the Saryn, Rhino, or Volt Voidshell Collection. 
  • Fixed Client Drifter having two Excalibur Umbras after Host migration. 
  • Fixed Drifter’s body stretching when using Guiding Hand in Duviri. 
  • Fixed aborting Railjack mission while dead in Archwing causing the mission to soft lock and not send the player back to Dry Dock.
  • Fixed typos in Roathe, Lyon, and Marie’s KIM conversations. 
  • Fixed being unable to chatlink the Valkyr Heirloom Collection and Khora Prime Larqum Helmet. 
  • Fixed missing collision on Father Lyon’s offered orbiter decorations.
  • Fixed players being able to sell their last Melee weapon if they owned the Vinquibus. 

 

Crashes & Script Error Fixes 

  • Fixed a rare crash related to The Arcanist Honoria.
  • Fixed rare crash in the Simulacrum caused by Host migration. 
  • Fixed a script error related to casting Jade’s Glory On High.
  • Fixed a script error related to a Railjack ability.
  • Fixed a script error that occured when viewing the Demolisher Juggernaut’s Codex entry.
  • Fixed a script error related to Tauron Strikes.
  • Fixed script errors related to logging out while accessing the Star Chart.
  • Fixed crash caused by pickups. 
  • Fixed a script error when Oraxia’s Scuttlers are killed by Jackal’s Grid Wall.
  • Fixed a script error related to using Mesa’s Regulators against Mesa Prime in The Perita Rebellion.
  • Fixed script errors related to Yareli’s Merulina.
  • Fixed a script error related to hovering on player names in the Stats screen of the end of mission results.
  • Fixed rare crash in The Perita Rebellion. 
  • Fixed script error caused by Excalibur’s Radial Javelin. 
  • Fixed script error caused by looking at an enemy and not having any weapons equipped. 
  • Fixed rare crash caused by opening Clan chat while a Clan invite was pending. 
  • Fixed a script error that occurs when talking to Loid from behind in the Whispers in the Walls quest.

 

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1497599-known-issues-the-shadowgrapher/

item.title: Voruna Prime: Hotfix 42.0.11
item.description:
Changes:

  • The Gear Embargo personal modifier in Archimedea missions will now allow for Heavy Weapons and Atomicycles.

Fixes:

  • Fixes towards Ascension missions not ending when the Mote Collector reaches extraction.
  • Fixed the Velox Conclusion augment's buff being consumed upon Transference.
  • Fixed the Balor Fomorian event node taking players to the incorrect mission.
  • Fixed various edge-case issues when attempting to matchmake into Belly of the Beast missions via "A Shared Purpose".
    • Also fixed player loadouts being changed if they attempted to join a Belly of the Beast mission via "A Shared Purpose" but did not matchmake into a session.
  • Fixed hair clipping through the back of the Escuchon Hood.
  • Fixed a script error when loading into a mission as a Client with the Hunhullus Ephemera equipped.
  • Fixed a script error following a Host Migration in Ascension missions.
  • Fixed a crash in The Descendia.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1497599-known-issues-the-shadowgrapher/
